## **FAQs**

### **Can I use my own branding in the membership emails?**

Answer: Yes, you can customize your membership emails' branding to match your branding. This includes adding your own logo, color scheme, and other branding elements.

### **How do I make sure my membership emails don't get marked as spam?**

Answer: To prevent your membership emails from getting marked as spam, follow best practices for email marketing, such as using a clear and concise subject line, avoiding spam trigger words, and only sending emails to contacts who have given you permission to contact them.

### **How do I track the effectiveness of my membership emails?**

Answer: You can track the effectiveness of your membership emails by using analytics tools. This allows you to see how many people opened your emails, clicked on links, and took other actions. You can then use this information to improve the effectiveness of your emails over time.

### **What should I include in my welcome email?**

Answer: Your welcome email should include information about the benefits of your membership program, instructions on how to access the program, and any other important information your members need to know. You can also include links to resources, such as tutorials or FAQs, to help your members get started.

### **Can I add the product title and offer title to the welcome email in the Memberships customizable emails feature?**

Answer: No, the product title cannot be added to the welcome email as it is sent out when offer access is granted, and one offer can have multiple products. Only the offer title can be added to the welcome email. However, the product title can be added to drip emails.

title_en: Fix Google and LinkedIn Campaign Errors Before Publishing
source_md:
HighLevel Ad Manager now makes it easier to find and fix campaign issues before publishing Google and LinkedIn ads. Instead of showing one error at a time, HighLevel can display multiple problems together, explain what needs to be fixed, and help you jump directly to the affected field. This reduces repeated publish attempts and makes campaign setup easier to troubleshoot.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Campaign Publishing Checks?](#What-are-Campaign-Publishing-Checks?)
- [Key Benefits of Campaign Publishing Checks](#Key-Benefits-of-Campaign-Publishing-Checks)
- [What Happens When You Click Publish?](#What-Happens-When-You-Click-Publish?)
- [View Multiple Errors at the Same Time](#View-Multiple-Errors-at-the-Same-Time)
- [Jump Directly to the Field That Needs Attention](#Jump-Directly-to-the-Field-That-Needs-Attention)
- [Google Campaign Pre-Publish Checks](#Google-Campaign-Pre-Publish-Checks)
- [Google Demand Gen Campaign Checks](#Google-Demand-Gen-Campaign-Checks)
- [LinkedIn Campaign Error Improvements](#LinkedIn-Campaign-Error-Improvements)
- [What Happens After You Fix an Error?](#What-Happens-After-You-Fix-an-Error?)
- [Pre-Publish Errors vs. Google or LinkedIn Rejections](#Pre-Publish-Errors-vs.-Google-or-LinkedIn-Rejections)
- [Validation Errors vs. Opportunity Score](#Validation-Errors-vs.-Opportunity-Score)
- [How To Fix Campaign Publishing Errors](#How-To-Fix-Campaign-Publishing-Errors)
- [Troubleshooting Campaign Publishing Errors](#Troubleshooting-Campaign-Publishing-Errors)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Campaign Publishing Checks?**

Campaign publishing checks review your campaign for missing or incorrect information before it is sent to Google or LinkedIn. These checks help you fix common setup problems earlier so you can publish with fewer failed attempts.

For example, HighLevel may check for issues such as:

- Missing headlines
- Missing descriptions
- Missing Website URLs
- Missing keywords
- Invalid campaign dates
- Missing creative assets

If HighLevel finds a problem, it can stop publishing and show you what needs to be corrected first.

---

## **Key Benefits of Campaign Publishing Checks**

The improved campaign checks make it easier to understand what is wrong and fix several issues at once. This helps reduce repeated publish attempts and gives you clearer guidance before the campaign is submitted.

- **See multiple errors at once:** Review several campaign issues in one list instead of discovering them one by one.
- **Get clearer error messages:** Understand what is missing or incorrect and where the problem is located.
- **Jump directly to the problem:** Click an error to go to the field or section that needs attention.
- **Fix errors faster:** Resolve several issues before trying to publish again.
- **Better Google checks:** Google campaigns now go through additional checks before submission.
- **Clearer LinkedIn errors:** LinkedIn carousel and creative issues now identify the affected item more clearly.
- **Better publishing feedback:** Status messages make it easier to understand what HighLevel is checking during publishing.

---

## **What Happens When You Click Publish?**

When you click **Publish**, HighLevel checks the campaign for supported setup issues before sending it to the advertising platform. If problems are found, publishing pauses so you can fix them.

The basic flow is:

1. Finish setting up the campaign.
2. Click **Publish**.
3. HighLevel checks the campaign.
4. If errors are found, the **Fix errors before publishing** prompt appears.
5. Open the error list.
6. Review the issues.
7. Fix the affected fields.
8. Publish again.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079923352/original/MRPAlpJ2GJvpiCH9-OtnKenOeMMBYfogDw.png?1788358087)**

---

## **View Multiple Errors at the Same Time**

HighLevel now groups multiple campaign problems together so you can review them in one place. This is useful when a campaign has several missing fields or setup problems.

For example, the error list may show:

- Missing ad headlines
- Missing descriptions
- Missing Website URL
- Missing keywords
- Invalid schedule dates

Instead of fixing one issue, publishing again, and then discovering another issue, you can work through the full list in one pass.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079923592/original/E9-sc3A50NRwW4YG77yOcBDy0BdYxGMgQg.png?1788358175)**

---

## **Jump Directly to the Field That Needs Attention**

Clickable error messages help you find the exact place that needs to be fixed. This is especially useful for larger campaigns with multiple ads, ad groups, creatives, or carousel cards.

To use an error shortcut:

1. Open the error list.
2. Click the error you want to fix.
3. HighLevel takes you to the related field or section.
4. Correct the issue.
5. Return to the review screen and continue fixing any remaining errors.

This reduces the need to search through the campaign manually.

---

## **Google Campaign Pre-Publish Checks**

Google campaigns now include an additional review process before submission. These checks help identify supported campaign and creative issues before the campaign is sent to Google.

The process can include:

1. **Validating campaign fields**
2. **Checking advertising requirements**
3. **Verifying platform requirements**

You may see progress messages while these checks are running.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079923885/original/18YZNcb_EQohQ8XGE16yn6l2uHNFg5K_ZA.png?1788358310)**

---

## **Google Demand Gen Campaign Checks**

Demand Gen campaigns can require several types of creative content. HighLevel now provides clearer checks for missing or incomplete Demand Gen assets before publishing.

Depending on the campaign format, HighLevel may check for items such as:

- Images
- Logos
- Videos
- Headlines
- Descriptions
- Long headlines
- Carousel assets

HighLevel also provides clearer messages for missing Website URLs and duplicate creative content.

For full Demand Gen setup requirements, refer to the dedicated Google Demand Gen article in the Related Articles section.

---

## **LinkedIn Campaign Error Improvements**

LinkedIn campaigns now provide clearer error messages for creatives and carousel cards. This makes it easier to understand which part of the ad needs to be fixed.

For carousel ads, HighLevel can provide better context when a specific card is missing required information such as:

- A headline
- A destination URL

This is especially useful when several carousel cards are included in the same ad.

---

## **What Happens After You Fix an Error?**

After you correct campaign details, HighLevel refreshes the campaign checks so fixed issues no longer remain incorrectly listed.

A simple workflow is:

1. Open the error list.
2. Fix the first issue.
3. Continue working through the remaining errors.
4. Save your campaign changes.
5. Click **Publish** again.
6. HighLevel checks the campaign again.
7. If no blocking issues remain, publishing can continue.

---

## **Pre-Publish Errors vs. Google or LinkedIn Rejections**

Passing HighLevel's campaign checks does not guarantee that Google or LinkedIn will approve the campaign. The advertising platform may still return an error or rejection after submission.

There are two different types of issues to understand:

**Pre-publish errors:** Problems HighLevel finds before the campaign is submitted, such as missing fields or incomplete ad content.

**Platform errors or rejections:** Problems returned by Google or LinkedIn after submission, such as policy violations or platform-specific requirements.

If the campaign passes HighLevel's checks but is later rejected, review the feedback returned by the advertising platform.

---

## **Validation Errors vs. Opportunity Score**

Validation errors and Opportunity Score serve different purposes. Understanding the difference helps you know which items must be fixed and which are recommendations.

**Validation errors:** Problems that may prevent the campaign from publishing until they are fixed.

**Opportunity Score:** Recommendations that can help improve campaign readiness or setup but are not the same as

blocking publishing errors.

A low Opportunity Score does not necessarily mean the campaign has a publishing error.

---

## **How To Fix Campaign Publishing Errors**

Following the error list in order can help you correct campaign issues quickly and avoid repeated publish attempts. Start by opening the campaign review screen and fixing each issue shown.

1. Open the Google or LinkedIn campaign in **Ad Manager**.
2. Review the campaign, ad groups or ad sets, and ads.
3. Click **Publish**.
4. If prompted, click **Fix errors**.
5. Open the error list.
6. Review all identified issues.
7. Click an error to go directly to the affected field or section.
8. Correct the issue.
9. Repeat until all required errors are fixed.
10. Save your changes.
11. Click **Publish** again.
12. For Google campaigns, wait for the pre-publish checks to complete.
13. If the campaign passes the checks, continue with submission.

---

## **Troubleshooting Campaign Publishing Errors**

Most publishing problems can be resolved by reviewing the error list, checking required campaign fields, and trying the publish process again after saving changes.

**The Publish button does not complete the campaign**

Open the error list and check for required fields that still need attention.

**I fixed an error, but it still appears**

Save the campaign changes and run the publishing checks again. The list should refresh after the campaign is rechecked.

**I see several errors for one ad**

One ad can have more than one missing or incorrect field. Work through each error shown for that ad.

**Google or LinkedIn rejected the campaign after HighLevel showed no errors**

HighLevel's checks do not replace Google or LinkedIn's own platform and policy review. Review the rejection details returned by the advertising platform.

**A LinkedIn carousel error does not make sense**

Review the specific carousel card mentioned in the error and check its headline and destination URL.

**My campaign start date is in the past**

Update the campaign schedule to use a valid future or current start date, then publish again.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can HighLevel show more than one campaign error at a time?**  
A: Yes. The improved error list can show multiple campaign issues together.

**Q: What happens when I click an error?**  
A: HighLevel takes you to the field or section related to that error so you can fix it faster.

**Q: Do Google campaigns receive extra checks before publishing?**  
A: Yes. Google campaigns can go through additional checks for campaign fields, advertising requirements, and platform requirements.

**Q: Does this work with Google Demand Gen campaigns?**  
A: Yes. Demand Gen validation includes clearer checks for supported creative requirements such as images, logos, headlines, descriptions, videos, and carousel assets.

**Q: Are LinkedIn carousel cards checked individually?**  
A: The improved LinkedIn error experience provides clearer context about the specific carousel card that needs attention.

**Q: Will fixed errors disappear from the list?**  
A: After campaign details are corrected and rechecked, resolved errors should refresh correctly.

**Q: Can Google or LinkedIn still reject a campaign after it passes HighLevel's checks?**  
A: Yes. The advertising platform can still return policy or platform-level errors after submission.

**Q: Is Opportunity Score the same as a publishing error?**  
A: No. Opportunity Score provides recommendations, while publishing errors identify issues that may need to be fixed before the campaign can be submitted.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Create a LinkedIn Ad Campaign in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006452)
- [Creating and Managing LinkedIn Ads in HighLevel Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006444)
- [Google Demand Gen Campaigns in HighLevel Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007405)
- [How to Use Opportunity Score in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008180)

title_en: How to Send HighLevel Forms Through WhatsApp Flows
source_md:
WhatsApp Flows lets you send supported HighLevel form fields directly inside WhatsApp, so customers can complete and submit information without being redirected to an external page. You can use an existing form or create a new one, preview the WhatsApp experience, configure the message template, publish the Flow, and send it through Conversations, workflows, or Bulk Actions.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are WhatsApp Flows?](#what-are-whatsapp-flows)
- [Key Benefits of Forms in WhatsApp Flows](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How to Send HighLevel Forms Through WhatsApp Flows](#send-forms)
- [Where to View Form Submissions](#form-submissions)
- [What Happens When the Original Form Changes?](#original-form-changes)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#frequently-asked-questions)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Are WhatsApp Flows?**

WhatsApp Flows provide an interactive experience directly inside WhatsApp. Customers tap a button in a WhatsApp message to open a guided form, answer questions, and submit their information without leaving the app.

HighLevel uses the supported fields from your form to create the WhatsApp experience. The complete web form is not embedded exactly as it appears on a website.

Forms via WhatsApp Flows can be used for **lead qualification, customer onboarding, feedback collection, registrations**, and other information-gathering workflows. Completed submissions are associated with the corresponding contact in HighLevel.

---

## **Key Benefits of Forms in WhatsApp Flows**

Forms in WhatsApp Flows make it easier to collect information while keeping the customer inside the WhatsApp conversation.

- **In-app form completion:** Customers answer and submit supported form questions without opening an external page.
- **Reuse existing forms:** Select an existing HighLevel form or create a new form for the Flow.
- **Live preview:** Review how supported fields will appear inside WhatsApp before publishing.
- **Contact association:** Completed submissions are associated with the corresponding contact.
- **Flexible sending:** Send approved templates through Conversations, workflows, or Bulk Actions.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Before creating a form-based WhatsApp Flow, confirm that the required WhatsApp connection, permissions, and form content are ready.

- Confirm your WhatsApp account is connected in the relevant HighLevel sub-account.
- Make sure your user has access to the required **WhatsApp** and **Forms** settings.
- Review the information you want to collect before selecting a form.
- Unsupported form fields are excluded from the WhatsApp Flow experience.
- Before sending business-initiated WhatsApp messages, ensure you have the appropriate permission to contact the recipient.

```
Note: Always review the WhatsApp preview before publishing to confirm which form fields customers will see.
```

---

## **How to Send HighLevel Forms Through WhatsApp Flows**

Follow the steps below to select a form, review its WhatsApp experience, configure the associated template, and send the published Flow.

### **Step 1:**Open WhatsApp Flows

1. From the relevant HighLevel **Sub-Account**, navigate to **Settings → WhatsApp → Flows**.
2. Click **Create Flow**.
3. Give the Flow a descriptive name, such as **New Customer Inquiry** or **Lead Qualification**.
4. Continue to the form-selection step.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084110993/original/xGJYRHNLuopx4ZXhtgN0sgRh0ALk-VV7gQ.png?1792825223)

### **Step 2:** Select or Create a Form

Choose **Form submission** when configuring the WhatsApp Flow. You can use an existing HighLevel form or create a new form from the Flow setup experience.

### **Use an Existing Form**

Select the HighLevel form you want to use. The Flow builder reviews the form fields and displays the supported content in the WhatsApp preview.

### **Create a New Form**

If you need a new form, use the form-creation option available from the Flows screen. After creating the form, select it for the Flow and continue to the preview.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083375146/original/0esj886t_Q7gFHbk_bc2N-U49__YoxxRcQ.png?1792050843)

```
Tip: Build the form around the information you actually need to collect. Always review the WhatsApp preview before publishing the Flow.
```

### **Step 3:**Review the WhatsApp Preview

The WhatsApp preview shows how the supported form content will appear to customers. Review the questions and available inputs before publishing.

Unsupported field types are excluded during Flow creation. Use the preview to confirm that customers can provide all the information required for your process.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083375849/original/sDyfzDHB0Gidq95G4vnB8GIC9051Hfg7Tg.png?1792051243)

```
Important: A field appearing in the HighLevel form builder does not guarantee that it will appear in the WhatsApp Flow. Review the WhatsApp preview before publishing.
```

### **Step 4:**Configure the WhatsApp Template and Publish

After reviewing the supported form fields and WhatsApp preview, configure the WhatsApp message that customers will use to open the form.

1. Continue to the WhatsApp message template configuration in the Flow builder.
2. Enter the message content, including the **Header**, **Body**, and **Footer**, where available.
3. Configure the **Flow button** customers will tap to open the form.
4. Enter the **Button text** when prompted.
5. Review the message and confirm that the button opens the intended form-based WhatsApp Flow.
6. Select **Publish** when the Flow is ready.

![WhatsApp template configuration with Flow button](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084110934/original/TuuLwTITezmYBNLNmpygLwYi6vvYqvR86A.png?1792825127)

```
Important: Publishing a WhatsApp Flow does not automatically send it to contacts. The associated WhatsApp message template must complete the applicable Meta approval process before it can be used as an approved template message.
```

### **Step 5:**Send the Form Through a Template

Once the Flow is published and its associated WhatsApp template is approved, you can send the form through **Conversations**, a **workflow**, or **Bulk Actions**. Customers tap the Flow button in the message to complete and submit the form inside WhatsApp.

### **Send Through Conversations**

Use Conversations when you want to send the approved WhatsApp template to an individual contact.

1. Open **Conversations** in the HighLevel sub-account.
2. Open the conversation for the contact you want to message.
3. Select **WhatsApp** as the messaging channel.
4. Choose **WhatsApp Template** from the message composer.
5. Select the approved template associated with the published Flow.
6. Review the template.
7. Click **Send**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084111374/original/LHEyESdRLSXqPmZjHZtaq4RcilreY6P6Gw.png?1792825888)

### **Send Through a Workflow**

Use a workflow when the approved WhatsApp template should be sent automatically after a configured trigger or condition.

1. Navigate to **Automation**.
2. Create a new workflow or open an existing workflow.
3. Configure the trigger that determines when the WhatsApp message should be sent.
4. Add the appropriate **WhatsApp** action.
5. Choose **WhatsApp Template** as the message type.
6. Select the approved template associated with the published Flow.
7. Review the action settings.
8. Save the action and publish the workflow when it is ready.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084111705/original/K5kl_IDeSWc114qmbfocG0YjizSBZvERaw.png?1792826539)

### **Send Through Bulk Actions**

Use Bulk Actions when you want to send the approved WhatsApp template to multiple selected contacts.

1. Navigate to **Contacts**.
2. Select the contacts you want to message.
3. Choose **Bulk Action → Send WhatsApp**.
4. Select **WhatsApp Template**.
5. Choose the approved template associated with the published Flow.
6. Review the template and sending details.
7. Confirm the bulk send.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084111855/original/3LQQASMEXChQJlDs7lqaQZxyzYyb8uBQ_A.png?1792826927)

```
Recommended: Send the Flow to an internal test contact first. Complete the form and confirm that the submission appears under the expected form and contact before sending it to customers.
```

---

## **Where to View Form Submissions**

Completed WhatsApp Flow submissions are stored with your HighLevel form submissions and associated with the corresponding contact.

1. Navigate to **Sites → Forms → Submissions**.
2. Locate the relevant form.
3. Open the submission to review the submitted information.

Only the fields included in the WhatsApp Flow are collected through that submission.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084111955/original/Rr7nTKNuwsHkSHkJr8AEIn9Je7Qf0i8EvA.png?1792827231)

---

## **What Happens When the Original Form Changes?**

Editing the original HighLevel form does not automatically change a WhatsApp Flow that has already been published.

If you make changes to the source form, review the WhatsApp Flow before using it for future messages to confirm that the customer experience includes the intended questions.

---

## **Troubleshooting**

Use the checks below when the Flow, preview, template, or submission does not behave as expected.

| **Issue** | **What to Check** |
| --- | --- |
| **Some form fields are missing from the preview** | Review the WhatsApp preview. Unsupported fields are excluded from the Flow experience. |
| **The Flow cannot be published** | Review the configuration and resolve any validation errors shown in the Flow builder. |
| **The WhatsApp template cannot be sent** | Confirm that the template has completed the applicable Meta approval process. |
| **Changes to the original form are not appearing** | Changes to the original form do not automatically update an already-published Flow. Review the Flow configuration before using it again. |
| **A submission cannot be found** | Confirm that the customer completed the final submission step, then check **Sites → Forms → Submissions** in the correct sub-account. |

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to recreate my existing HighLevel form?**

No. You can select an existing HighLevel form when creating the WhatsApp Flow. You can also create a new form from the Flow setup experience.

**Q: Does the form open on an external website?**

No. Customers complete the supported form questions directly inside WhatsApp without being redirected to a separate landing page.

**Q: Why are some fields from my form missing in WhatsApp?**

WhatsApp Flows only includes fields supported by the integration. Unsupported fields are excluded during Flow creation. Review the WhatsApp preview before publishing to confirm what customers will see.

**Q: Where are WhatsApp Flow form submissions stored?**

Completed responses are available under **Sites → Forms → Submissions** and are associated with the corresponding contact.

**Q: Does editing the original form update an already-published WhatsApp Flow?**

No. Changes made to the original HighLevel form do not automatically update an already-published WhatsApp Flow. Review the Flow after making changes to the source form.

**Q: How can I send a form-based WhatsApp Flow?**

After the Flow is published and the associated WhatsApp template is approved, you can send it through **Conversations**, a **workflow**, or **Bulk Actions**.

**Q: Does publishing the Flow automatically send it to customers?**

No. Publishing makes the Flow available for use. You still need to send the approved WhatsApp template through one of the supported sending methods.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [WhatsApp Settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006911)
- [WhatsApp: Send Message Templates (Snippets)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003069)
- [WhatsApp Flows: In-App Appointment Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003720)

title_en: How to Use Edit with Ask AI Feature in Social Planner
source_md:
Edit with Ask AI helps you refine Social Planner content through a conversational editing experience. Instead of starting over when a post needs changes, you can give Ask AI specific instructions, preview the revised content, and choose whether to replace the original text or copy the edited version. This article explains how to use Edit with Ask AI, how session memory works, and how to get better editing results.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Edit with Ask AI?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Edit-with-Ask-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Edit with Ask AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Edit-with-Ask-AI)
- [Content AI vs. Quick AI Actions vs. Edit with Ask AI](#Content-AI-vs.-Quick-AI-Actions-vs.-Edit-with-Ask-AI)
- [How To Use Edit with Ask AI in Social Planner](#How-To-Use-Edit-with-Ask-AI-in-Social-Planner)
- [Prompt Examples for Better Edits](#Prompt-Examples-for-Better-Edits)
- [Preview, Replace, and Copy](#Preview,-Replace,-and-Copy)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Edit with Ask AI?**

Edit with Ask AI is a conversational editing tool that helps you revise content inside Social Planner using natural language instructions. You can ask Ask AI to rewrite, shorten, expand, simplify, polish, reformat, or adjust the tone of selected content without manually rewriting the post from scratch.

Edit with Ask AI is currently available in **Social Planner** wherever **Content AI** is enabled. It is designed to help you refine content after a draft already exists, whether that draft was generated by Content AI or written manually.

---

## **Key Benefits of Edit with Ask AI**

Edit with Ask AI makes content refinement faster and more flexible by letting you explain exactly how a post should change. This gives you more control than a one-click edit while still keeping the workflow simple inside Social Planner.

- **Conversational editing:** Give Ask AI natural language instructions instead of manually rewriting content.

- **Preview before applying:** Review revised content before replacing the original text.

- **Flexible editing control:** Shorten, expand, simplify, polish, reformat, or change tone based on your goal.

- **Copy or replace edits:** Replace the original content or copy the revised version for use elsewhere.

- **Saved editing sessions:** Return to previous editing conversations without losing context.

- **No extra AI credits for edits:** Use conversational edits without consuming additional AI credits.

---

## **Content AI vs. Quick AI Actions vs. Edit with Ask AI**

Social Planner includes multiple AI-assisted ways to create and improve content. Knowing when to use each option helps you choose the right tool for the task.

- **Content AI:** Use this to generate the first draft of a social post from guided inputs.

- **Quick AI actions:** Use these for simple one-click edits, such as improving writing, fixing grammar, shortening, or expanding content.

- **Edit with Ask AI:** Use this when you want to give custom editing instructions and refine content through a chat-style experience.

For example, you might use **Content AI** to create the first draft, then use **Edit with Ask AI** to make the post more casual, add a stronger call to action, or rewrite it for a specific audience.

---

## **How To Use Edit with Ask AI in Social Planner**

Edit with Ask AI is available from the AI menu inside the Social Planner post editor. Use it when you want to refine post content through a chat-style editing experience instead of choosing a one-click AI action.

### 

### **Go to Marketing > Social Planner**

Open **Marketing**, then go to **Social Planner**. This is where you can create, edit, preview, save, schedule, and publish social posts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075727276/original/JEZsWhxwEvM0bW7hvHy2-AfSvjEgMqybZg.png?1783692864)**

### **Create a new social post or open an existing post**

Start a new post or open an existing draft.  You can either edit the existing post with the **Edit**option under three dots menu or create a new post using**"+ New Post"** option.

The post editor shows the **Post to** selector, the **Type content** field, formatting tools, platform options, and the live post preview.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075730157/original/kT36wQxv-A8vmP7kGGMr7EKtS8j8ykxq2w.png?1783694307)

### **Add or review the post content**

Enter content in the **Type content** field or review existing draft text. Edit with Ask AI works best when there is content available for Ask AI to revise, rewrite, shorten, expand, or improve.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075730832/original/-k-iqJOXTJPRGaJlZ1OElTeIpaR5J--o_g.png?1783694693)**

### 

### **Click the AI button in the content toolbar**

Click the purple **AI** button beside the content formatting toolbar. This opens the AI editing menu for the social post content.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075731089/original/CmfHPURmKCTUPbAbI6yFM009CXfQaqvfXQ.png?1783694920)**

### 

### **Select Edit with Ask AI**

From the AI menu, choose **Edit with Ask AI**. The menu may also show quick AI actions such as **Generate with AI**, **Improve writing**, **Fix spelling and grammar**, **Simplify writing**, **Make longer**, and **Make shorter**.

Use **Edit with Ask AI** when you want to give a custom instruction instead of using a predefined quick action.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075731330/original/XI_CPmaH2fwt8fT9CT186y7qxSHUnXheyA.png?1783695002)**

### 

### **Enter your editing instruction**

Tell Ask AI how you want the content changed. Be specific about tone, length, audience, platform, format, or call to action.

Example prompts:

- “Make this more professional but still friendly.”

- “Shorten this for a Facebook post.”

- “Add a stronger call to action.”

- “Rewrite this for small business owners.”

- “Make this easier to understand.”

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075731814/original/Q8Z4HddpKvP7-ziPGiAP6jImJWtsLbtUGQ.png?1783695135)**

### **Preview the revised content**

Review the revised version before applying it. Check that the updated content matches your brand voice, post goal, platform, and audience.

### 

### **Continue refining the content**

If the edit is close but not final, continue the conversation with another instruction. You can ask Ask AI to make the post shorter, warmer, more direct, more detailed, or better formatted.

Example follow-up prompts:

- “Make it more concise.”

- “Keep the same message but make it more casual.”

- “Add one sentence about booking a consultation.”

- “Make the opening line stronger.”

### 

### **Replace the original content or copy the revision**

When the revised version is ready, choose whether to replace the original content or copy the revised version.

- **Replace:** Updates the content in the **Type content** field with the revised version.

- **Copy:** Copies the revised version so you can paste it elsewhere while keeping the original content unchanged.

Use **Replace** when you are ready to update the post. Use **Copy** when you want to keep both versions.

### 

### **Review the post preview**

Check the **Post Preview** panel to see how the content may appear on the selected social channel. Review the post text, formatting, media, links, and platform-specific options before saving or publishing.

### 

### **Save, schedule, or publish the post**

After reviewing the final content, choose whether to save the post for later, schedule it, or publish it. Always review the final post manually before publishing.

---

## **Prompt Examples for Better Edits**

Clear prompts help Ask AI understand the exact change you want. The more specific you are about tone, audience, length, and format, the easier it is to get a useful revision.

### **Tone**

- “Make this sound more friendly and casual.”

- “Make this more professional but still approachable.”

- “Rewrite this in a confident but not pushy tone.”

### 

### **Length**

- “Shorten this to two sentences.”

- “Expand this into a more detailed post.”

- “Make this concise enough for a quick LinkedIn update.”

### 

### **Clarity**

- “Simplify this for beginners.”

- “Make this easier to understand.”

- “Remove jargon and make the message clearer.”

### 

### **Call to Action**

- “Add a clear call to action at the end.”

- “Make the CTA stronger and more direct.”

- “Invite readers to book a consultation.”

### 

### **Formatting**

- “Turn this into a short bulleted list.”

- “Add headings and improve spacing.”

- “Rewrite this as a numbered list.”

### 

### **Brand Style**

- “Make this sound more warm and helpful.”

- “Keep the tone educational and trustworthy.”

- “Make this match the style of the previous post.”

---

## **Preview, Replace, and Copy**

Edit with Ask AI lets you control how revisions are applied. This helps you review the AI-generated version before changing the original content.

- **Preview:** Shows the revised version before it is applied.

- **Replace:** Updates the selected original content with the revised version.

- **Copy:** Copies the revised version so you can use it elsewhere.

Preview the edit before choosing **Replace**. If you are unsure or want to keep both versions, use **Copy** first.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is Edit with Ask AI?**  
Edit with Ask AI is a conversational editing experience that lets you revise selected Social Planner content using natural language instructions.

**Q: Where is Edit with Ask AI available?**  
Edit with Ask AI is currently available in Social Planner wherever Content AI is enabled.

**Q: Does Edit with Ask AI consume extra AI credits?**  
No. Editing with Ask AI does not consume extra AI credits.

**Q: Can I edit content I wrote myself?**  
Yes. You can use Edit with Ask AI to revise content you wrote manually or content generated with Content AI.

**Q: Can I preview edits before replacing content?**  
Yes. You can preview the revised version before choosing whether to replace the original content.

**Q: What happens when I click Replace?**  
**Replace** updates the selected original content with the revised version.

**Q: What happens when I click Copy?**  
**Copy** copies the revised version so you can paste it elsewhere while keeping the original content unchanged.

**Q: Can I keep refining the same content?**  
Yes. You can continue chatting with Ask AI and give follow-up instructions until the content matches your goal.

**Q: Does Ask AI remember my editing session?**  
Yes. Smart Session Memory saves the editing conversation so you can return later and continue with previous context.

**Q: Why do I not see Edit with Ask AI?**  
Confirm you are in Social Planner, Content AI is enabled, and you are working in a supported content editing area.

**Q: Is Edit with Ask AI available outside Social Planner?**  
The current article confirms Edit with Ask AI is available in Social Planner wherever Content AI is enabled.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Content AI with Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001234788-content-ai-with-social-planner)⁠

- [Content AI: Guided Content Questions in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005685-content-ai-guided-content-questions-in-social-planner)⁠

- [Introduction to Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327-introduction-to-ask-ai-assistant)⁠

- [How to Fix Grammar and Spelling, Make Longer Content, and Improve Writing in Social Post](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001325-how-to-fix-grammar-and-spelling-make-longer-content-and-improve-writing-in-social-post-)⁠

- [Getting Started: Set Up Social Planner in HighLevel CRM](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005063-getting-started-setup-social-planner)⁠

- [How to Generate and Edit Images in HighLevel with Ask AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005764-how-to-generate-and-edit-images-using-ask-ai)⁠

title_en: How to Create a Product and Attach It to a Membership Course Offer
source_md:
This article will walk you through the full process of creating a product that can be sold as a membership course. You’ll learn how to configure your product, add pricing, and link it directly to a published membership offer. Once a user purchases the product, they’ll automatically gain access to the associated course. No additional manual setup is needed after the purchase.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Course Offer?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-a-Course-Offer?)
- [Key Benefits of Creating a Paid Course Offer](#Key-Benefits-of-Creating-a-Paid-Course-Offer)
- [How to Configure Your Product and Attach a Course Offer](#How-to-Configure-Your-Product-and-Attach-a-Course-Offer)
  - [Step 1: Access the Product Creation Page](#Step-1%3A-Access-the-Product-Creation-Page)
  - [Step 2: Fill in Product Information](#Step-2%3A-Fill-in-Product-Information)
  - [Step 3: Configure Tax Options](#Step-3%3A-Configure-Tax-Options)
  - [Step 4: Set Pricing](#Step-4%3A-Set%C2%A0Pricing)
  - [Step 5: Link the Product to a Membership Offer](#Step-5%3A-Link-the-Product-to-a-Membership-Offer)
  - [Step 6: Add Product Variants](#Step-6%3A-Add-Product-Variants)
  - [Step 7: Optimize Search Engine Settings](#Step-7%3A-Optimize-Search-Engine-Settings)
  - [Step 8: Save Your Product](#Step-8%3A-Save-Your-Product)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is a Course Offer?**

A course offer allows you to bundle one or more membership courses and sell them at a set price. When a customer purchases a product tied to this offer, they are automatically granted access to the courses included in that offer.

---

## **Key Benefits of Creating a Paid Course Offer**

Creating a paid course offer through products provides flexibility in how you package and sell your digital education content.

- Automates course access after payment
- Offers both one-time and recurring pricing options
- Connects directly with Membership course delivery
- Supports bundled course sales
- Enhances tracking and reporting
- Enables upselling and offer customization

---

## **How to Configure Your Product and Attach a Course Offer**

Follow these steps to create a new product and link it with a course offer.

### **Step 1:**Access the Product Creation Page

To get started with creating a new product, navigate to the **Payments** section from the left-hand menu of your dashboard. Then, hover over the **Products** dropdown in the top menu and click on **Products** from the list. This will take you to the product management page where all your existing products are listed. From here, click on the blue **+ Create Product** button located in the top right corner of the screen to begin setting up a new product. This action will open the product creation interface, where you’ll enter key details like product name, pricing, and membership configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044389908/original/99FpjutYgmbYqg6_ggyoxjmOjKv_-cIz1Q.png?1743591693)

### **Step 2:** Fill in Product Information

The **Product Information** section is where you define the foundational details for your product. First, the **“Include in Online Store”** toggle allows you to determine whether this product should be visible and available for purchase through your online storefront. If you want your product to be publicly available, this toggle must remain enabled.

Next, the **Title** field is a required input where you name your product—this will be shown across your checkout, internal views, and potentially public listings. Below that, the **Description** field allows you to provide a detailed overview of the product, using rich text formatting options such as bold, italics, links, bullet points, and font customization to enhance readability and appeal.

The **Media** section lets you upload an image or video file to visually represent your product. This helps users quickly recognize what they’re buying. It’s recommended to upload files with a resolution of 1024×1024 and a size not exceeding 10MB for optimal display and performance.

There is also an **Enable Product Label** checkbox. If enabled, you can assign a custom label (e.g., “New,” “Top Pick,” etc.) to the product which may be used for visual badges or internal organization.

Lastly, the **Product Collection** dropdown lets you assign this product to an existing collection. Collections help group similar products together for better organization and presentation, especially when managing a larger catalog.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044379584/original/3AilEGgO1T1HzsycekFlp1x0jNkS3FHULA.jpeg?1743585848)

### **Step 3:**Configure Tax Options

The **Product Information** section includes several key fields to define how the product is presented and taxed. One of the first elements here is the **Product Tax Code**, which allows you to select a specific tax category for your product. This is important for enabling automatic tax calculations during checkout. If left blank, the system will apply your default global tax settings.

Next, the **Include tax in prices** option gives you control over whether your product pricing should be shown as tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive. You can either follow the global setting or manually choose “Yes” to include tax in the displayed price or “No” to show it as a separate charge.

Additionally, there’s an option to **Attach Tax Rates**, which is useful if you’re handling taxes manually or have buyers outside the U.S.

Finally, the **Statement Descriptor** field allows you to override the default account name that appears on a customer’s bank statement. This ensures clarity for the buyer and can help reduce payment disputes or confusion.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044379732/original/BMzD5p8HcEubcmcBf0yki9myuiJrsKTdog.png?1743585941)

### **Step 4:**Set Pricing

In the **Pricing** section of the product setup, users can define how their product will be offered to customers by configuring a range of pricing-related fields. Start by entering a **Pricing Name**, which serves as an internal label to help distinguish between different pricing options if you’re offering multiple tiers or plans. Next, select the **Type** of pricing from the dropdown—either **Onetime**, which charges the customer a single fee, or **Recurring**, which adds options for billing cycles, trial periods, and setup fees. In the **Amount** field, input the exact price you want to charge for the product. You can optionally enter a **Compare-at Price**, which is useful for showing discounted pricing by displaying the original price next to the actual price being charged. Below this, use the **Currency** selector to define which currency the payment will be made in, such as USD. If inventory tracking is relevant, check the **Track Inventory** box to manage stock levels and input available quantities. Clicking on **Additional Options** reveals more advanced pricing settings like purchase limits or metadata fields. Use the **Price Description** field to add a brief note or context for this pricing entry (visible internally).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044387970/original/pvfajS8UNYtH7UVEQROG6LQua9ApXxC0bg.png?1743590553)

**IMPORTANT NOTE:**If you create a recurring payment offer subscription and add X number of payments, the subscription will END and be CANCELLED after the number of payments selected. If you want this subscription to run indefinitely until manually cancelled, please leave this field blank.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061506833/original/D7g0PqaxWZbqZ7_LjwDFsh0mVHCZEQk5TA.png?1767014394)

### **Step 5:**Link the Product to a Membership Offer

After configuring your product price, you must **toggle on the “Membership Offer” option** to activate access linking. Once the toggle is enabled, a **“Select Membership Offer”** dropdown will appear. From this dropdown, choose the published membership offer that should be granted when someone purchases this product. Only **published offers** will appear in this list—if the offer hasn’t been published yet, it won’t be selectable. This step is essential, as it ensures that after payment is completed, the user is automatically enrolled in the correct course or training bundle associated with the offer. Without enabling this setting and selecting an offer, users won’t be granted access to the membership content even if they complete their purchase.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044388238/original/thfApsA_zbktSfT-r0TTO95ZB-6lHMAZPQ.png?1743590737)

```
Important:   
  
Before creating a product, make sure your membership offer has already been created and published. Only published offers will appear in the “Membership Offer” dropdown when setting up your product. If your offer is still in draft, it will not be selectable during product setup.   
  
How to Create a Course Offer  
  
Go to the Memberships tab. Click the dropdown and select Offers. Click + Create Offer. Add a title, select your course(s), set the price, and hit Create. Publish the offer.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044393542/original/tgtQTi0bwRXrBWQxdk1AR2XPb-sjshk20w.gif?1743594515)
```

### **Step 6:**Add Product Variants

The “Variants” section lets you create different versions of a product, such as multiple pricing tiers, content levels, or access durations. To set this up, you first add an **Option name** like “Course Level” or “Access Plan.” Then, under **Option values**, you input the specific variants (e.g., “Basic,” “Premium,” “Pro”) and click **Done**. Each variant can have its own **price**, **compare-at price**, and **available quantity**, making it easy to manage inventory and pricing for each option. You can also enable **Track Inventory** if you want to limit how many of each variant can be sold. This is especially useful when offering bundles or time-limited enrollment.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044388415/original/aBmpqqgQbiMK2PZdg80DQa1Qea-IXT_Q4w.png?1743590844)

### **Step 7:**Optimize Search Engine Settings

The **Search Engine Listing** section helps optimize your product for search engines and improves its discoverability online. In the **SEO Title** field, you can enter a concise and relevant title that clearly identifies the product and includes keywords users might search for. The **SEO Description** allows you to provide a brief summary of the product that also incorporates relevant keywords, enhancing visibility in search results. Lastly, the **Handle** defines the product’s unique URL slug (e.g., /product/my-course-name), which can be customized to make the link more readable and SEO-friendly. This section is optional but highly recommended for improving online reach.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044388643/original/go1RsdO4eWNYU8bl1KYGtz5-de2Vpoclnw.png?1743591000)

### **Step 8:**Save Your Product

Click the **Save** button in the bottom-right corner. Once saved, users who purchase this product will automatically gain access to the attached course offer.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why doesn’t my membership offer show up in the product dropdown?**

Make sure the offer is published. Only published offers appear in the Membership Offer dropdown when creating a product.

**Q: Can I create both one-time and recurring prices for the same product?**

Yes! You can click “Add another price” and configure both pricing types in the same product.

**Q: What happens after someone purchases the product?**

They’ll automatically get access to the membership course(s) defined in the attached offer. No additional action is needed.

**Q: How do I send login credentials to buyers?**

Enable the **“Send Welcome Email”** option from Membership settings to automatically send credentials after purchase.

**Q: How can I delete a payments product?**

**To delete a payment product, delete the associated offer. The payment product will be removed automatically.**

title_en: AI Studio Cloud Pricing
source_md:
AI Studio Cloud pricing is based on the resources your app uses to run and store data. Cloud charges depend on three factors: **instance size**, **reserved database storage**, and **actual file storage usage**. Each project includes free allowances for all three, so smaller apps may run without additional Cloud charges.

```
Note: Cloud charges are separate from the AI Studio usage charges incurred when building or modifying your app.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is AI Studio Cloud and How Much Does It Cost?](#What-Is-AI-Studio-Cloud-and-How-Much-Does-It-Cost?)
- [What is Free in Cloud](#What-is-Free-in-Cloud)
- [Instance Pricing in Cloud](#Instance-Pricing-in-Cloud)
- [Database Storage Pricing](#Database-Storage-Pricing)
- [File Storage Pricing](#File-Storage-Pricing)
- [How Pausing and Removing Cloud Affect Charges](#How-Pausing-and-Removing-Cloud-Affect-Charges)
- [How Cloud Billing Works](#How-Cloud-Billing-Works)
- [Low Balance and Spending Limits](#Low-Balance-and-Spending-Limits)
- [Cloud Pricing Examples](#Cloud-Pricing-Examples)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is AI Studio Cloud and How Much Does It Cost?**

AI Studio Cloud provides a built-in backend for apps that need databases, user authentication, and file storage without requiring a separate backend service. For example, a member portal can use Cloud to manage user accounts, store profile information, and handle document uploads.

To learn more about how Cloud works, its features, and setup instructions, refer to [**Managed Cloud Backend in AI Studio**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009113-managed-cloud-backend-in-ai-studio).

Cloud pricing depends on the instance size, reserved database storage, and actual file storage usage. Every project includes a free Tiny instance, 2 GB of database storage, and 1 GB of file storage. Charges apply only when you select a larger instance or exceed the free storage allowances.

---

## **What is Free in Cloud**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083509819/original/yZQQlbnRrIuWI8kdL6_iLt46ExPJgJJwZw.png?1792152767)

---

## **Instance Pricing in Cloud**

An instance determines the computing resources available to your app, including CPU and memory. The Tiny instance is free, while larger instances are billed hourly for as long as Cloud is running.

| Instance | CPU | Memory | Price per hour | Approx. per month\* |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tiny | Shared CPU | Up to 0.5 GB RAM | Free | Free |
| Mini | 2-core ARM, shared | 1 GB RAM | $0.015456 | $11.28 |
| Small | 2-core ARM, shared | 2 GB RAM | $0.02369 | $17.29 |
| Medium | 2-core ARM, shared | 4 GB RAM | $0.09453 | $69.01 |
| Large | 2-core ARM, dedicated | 8 GB RAM | $0.174455 | $127.35 |
| X-Large | 4-core ARM, dedicated | 16 GB RAM | $0.330855 | $241.52 |

```
Note: Monthly estimates are based on 730 hours, assuming Cloud runs continuously throughout the month.
```

#### **How instance size changes affect billing:**

- **Changing instance size:** You can increase or decrease your instance size once per clock hour.
- **Billing during a size change:** When you change sizes, the hour of the change is billed as one full hour at the previous instance rate plus one full hour at the new instance rate. Starting the following hour, only the new instance rate applies.
- **Switching to Tiny:** Moving back to the free Tiny instance stops paid instance charges starting the following hour.

```
Important: Pausing Cloud can stop instance charges, but the hour in which you pause may still be billed.
```

---

## **Database Storage Pricing**

Database storage holds your app's tables and rows. Each project includes **2 GB of free database storage**. Additional storage costs **$0.000197 per GB per hour**, or approximately **$0.14 per GB per month**.

Unlike file storage, database storage is billed based on the amount of storage you reserve, not the amount of data you actually use.

```
Important: Before increasing database storage, review your current usage under Advanced settings → Database storage. Increase the capacity only when your data is approaching the existing limit, since the change cannot be reversed.
```

**How database storage billing works:**

- You pay for the size you reserve, not what you use: Database storage is billed on its provisioned (reserved) size every hour, whether or not that space is filled. The smallest increase is to 8 GB, so after your first increase you're charged for 6 GB above the free 2 GB, even if your data takes up only 0.25 GB.
- It can only go up: Database storage can be increased but never reduced. Once you increase it, the higher size is charged until you remove Cloud.
- Pausing doesn't stop it: Database storage above 2 GB keeps being charged while Cloud is paused. Only removing Cloud stops this charge.

---

## **File Storage Pricing**

File storage holds content uploaded to your app's storage buckets, such as images, PDFs, and documents. Each project includes **1 GB of free file storage**. Additional storage costs **$0.000047 per GB per hour**, or approximately **$0.034 per GB per month**.

Unlike database storage, file storage is billed based on the space your files actually occupy.

- You pay for what you store: File storage grows automatically as files are uploaded, and you're charged only for the space your files actually use.
- Deleting files lowers the charge: If you remove files and your usage drops back under 1 GB, file storage charges stop.
- Pausing doesn't stop it: File storage above 1 GB keeps being charged while Cloud is paused. Delete files or remove Cloud to stop this charge.

#### **Storage Rates at a Glance**

Database and file storage have different billing methods. Comparing their rates and free allowances can help you understand how storage changes affect your Cloud costs.

| Storage type | Free per project | Price above the free amount | Approx. per GB per month\* | Billed on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Database storage | 2 GB | $0.000197 per GB per hour | $0.14 | Reserved size |
| File storage | 1 GB | $0.000047 per GB per hour | $0.034 | Actual usage |

```
Note: Monthly estimates are based on 730 hours.
```

---

## **How Pausing and Removing Cloud Affect Charges**

Pausing and removing Cloud have different effects on billing and stored data. Pausing temporarily stops your app while preserving its data, whereas removing Cloud permanently deletes its database, users, and files.

| Charge | Cloud running | Cloud paused | Cloud removed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Instance (Mini and above) | Charged | Not charged | Not charged |
| Database storage above 2 GB | Charged | Charged | Not charged |
| File storage above 1 GB | Charged | Charged | Not charged |

**Important billing considerations:**

- **Pausing Cloud:** Instance charges stop only for hours in which Cloud remains paused for the entire hour. If the instance runs during any part of an hour, that hour is billed in full.
- **Storage charges while paused:** Database storage above 2 GB and file storage above 1 GB continue to incur charges while Cloud is paused.
- **Removing Cloud:** Removing Cloud stops all Cloud charges but **permanently deletes the database, users, and files**.

Choose **Pause** when you want to temporarily stop your app while keeping its data. Choose **Remove Cloud** only when you no longer need the Cloud environment or its stored data.

---

## **How Cloud Billing Works**

Cloud usage is billed through your HighLevel wallet, while AI Studio building activity is billed separately. Understanding these charges helps you distinguish ongoing Cloud costs from AI Studio usage.

- **Wallet billing:** Cloud charges accumulate throughout the day and are deducted from your wallet once daily. If auto-recharge is enabled, your wallet is replenished according to your existing settings.
- **Agency rebilling:** Agencies can rebill Cloud charges to their sub-accounts. Cloud automatically uses the same rebilling configuration already established for AI Studio, so no additional setup is required.
- **Separate AI Studio usage:** Messages sent to AI Studio are billed as AI Studio usage, not Cloud usage. This includes actions such as **Optimize → Send to chat** and **Try to fix** in the Security Advisor.

---

## **Low Balance and Spending Limits**

If your wallet has insufficient funds or your spending limit is reached, HighLevel provides a **48-hour period** before automatically pausing Cloud. This gives you time to resolve the billing issue and avoid an interruption.

**What happens when a billing issue occurs:**

**![](https://jumpshare.com/share/s17Q15TOuGs0w0ClVVAl+/Analysis+output+2.png)**

---

### **Usage Emails**

HighLevel sends Cloud usage notifications to agency owners when storage exceeds the included allowances. These alerts help identify when additional charges may begin.

- **Database storage:** The agency owner receives an email when a project's database storage exceeds the free 2 GB allowance.
- **File storage:** The agency owner receives an email when a project's file storage exceeds the free 1 GB allowance.
- **Automatic pause:** The agency owner receives notifications when a billing-related pause is scheduled, 24 hours before the pause, and after Cloud has been paused.

---

## **Cloud Pricing Examples**

Your monthly Cloud cost depends on the instance selected and any storage exceeding the free allowances. The following examples illustrate how different types of apps may be billed.

```
Note: These examples use 730 hours per month and assume the stated resources and storage levels remain unchanged. Actual charges depend on usage.
```

#### 

---

### **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Q: Can I use the free Cloud allowances with a paid instance?**

Yes. Every project receives 2 GB of database storage and 1 GB of file storage free, even when using a paid instance. The Tiny instance itself is also free.

#### **Q: Can I reduce database storage after upgrading it?**

No. Database storage increases are permanent for that Cloud environment. Charges continue based on the reserved size until Cloud is removed.

#### **Q: Will I still be charged if I pause Cloud immediately after resizing?**

Yes. The hour in which you change instance size is billed as a full hour of both the previous and new sizes. Pausing during that hour does not eliminate those charges. Instance charges stop for subsequent hours when Cloud remains paused throughout the entire hour.

#### **Q: How can I stop all Cloud charges?**

Removing Cloud stops instance, database storage, and file storage charges. However, this permanently deletes your database, users, and files. Pausing Cloud stops only instance charges for fully paused hours.

#### **Q: Can agencies pass Cloud costs on to their sub-accounts?**

Yes. Cloud uses the same agency rebilling settings configured for AI Studio, with no separate setup required.

#### **Q: What happens if my wallet runs out of funds?**

Your project continues running for 48 hours while the agency owner receives notifications. If the issue remains unresolved, Cloud pauses automatically without deleting data. Once the wallet balance is sufficient, Cloud wakes up automatically, although recovery may take some time. You can also use **Wake up** on the Cloud tab.

#### **Q: Are AI Studio messages included in Cloud charges?**

No. AI Studio messages, including **Optimize → Send to chat** and **Try to fix**, are billed separately as AI Studio usage.

#### **Q: Why am I charged for storage that I'm not using?**

Database storage is charged based on reserved capacity, even when some space is empty. File storage, however, is charged only for the actual space used above the free allowance.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Managed Cloud Backend in AI Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000009113)
- [AI Studio in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007587)
