- [Accept Payments in AI Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000009049)

title_en: Product Media Layouts for the Product Details Page in HighLevel
source_md:
Ecommerce Stores

# Product Media Layouts for the Product Details Page in HighLevel

Customize how product images appear on your Product Details Page with flexible media layouts, zoom options, and keyboard navigation for a polished shopping experience.

What You'll Learn

Product Media Layouts let you control how product images, videos, and galleries appear on your Product Details Page. You can choose between carousel, grid, and stacked layouts, configure zoom behavior, and enable keyboard shortcuts for faster image browsing.

This guide covers all available layout options, image zoom settings including the new keyboard navigation feature, and step-by-step instructions for configuring media layouts in your HighLevel store.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/cjKS423HPZA?&wmode=opaque)

## Understanding Product Media Layouts

Product Media Layouts control the visual presentation of images and videos on your Product Details Page. These layouts are configured through the Product Details element in your store's Page Builder and apply to both default and custom Product Details Pages.

Each layout option offers a different way to showcase product media, from simple single-image displays to interactive carousels with thumbnail navigation. Combined with zoom settings and keyboard shortcuts, media layouts give shoppers multiple ways to explore product details before purchasing.

Key Benefit

Choosing the right media layout improves conversion rates by letting customers view products from multiple angles, zoom into details, and navigate images quickly with mouse, touch, or keyboard controls.

## Available Layout Options

HighLevel provides several Product Media Layout options to match your store's design and the type of products you sell. Each layout offers different navigation styles and visual presentation.

Layout 1

Carousel with Thumbnails

Displays a large hero image with a thumbnail strip below or beside it. Shoppers click thumbnails to change the main image, or use arrow buttons to cycle through the gallery. This layout works well for products with multiple angles or lifestyle shots.

Layout 2

Grid Gallery

Shows all product images in a grid format, allowing customers to see multiple images at once without scrolling through a carousel. Best for products with a moderate number of images (3–6) where side-by-side comparison is helpful.

Layout 3

Stacked Vertical

Arranges images vertically in a scrollable column. Customers scroll down to view all images in sequence. This layout works well on mobile devices and for products with many detail shots or instructional images.

Layout 4

Single Image

Displays one primary product image with optional zoom. Ideal for simple products, digital goods, or minimalist store designs where a single hero shot is sufficient to convey product value.

Note

Layout availability and naming may vary based on your HighLevel version and theme. Check your Store Builder's Product Details element settings for the exact layout options available in your account.

## Image Zoom Settings

Image Zoom controls how customers interact with product images when they want to see more detail. HighLevel offers three zoom behaviors that work across all Product Media Layouts.

Zoom Option 1

Open Lightbox

Clicking a product image opens a fullscreen lightbox overlay with zoom controls, navigation arrows, and a thumbnail strip. This option provides the most immersive browsing experience and supports keyboard navigation shortcuts for faster image browsing.

**Best for:** Stores with high-quality product photography, fashion, jewelry, electronics, or any product where detailed inspection increases buyer confidence.

Zoom Option 2

Click & Hover Zoom

Clicking or hovering over an image triggers an inline zoom effect that magnifies the image within the Product Details Page layout, without opening a separate overlay.

**Best for:** Stores that want zoom functionality but prefer to keep customers on the product page without modal interruptions.

Zoom Option 3

No Zoom

Product images are displayed at their default size with no zoom interaction. Clicking an image has no special behavior unless configured separately.

**Best for:** Digital products, services, or stores with simple product imagery where zoom is unnecessary or would add friction to the buying process.

Pro Tip

Open Lightbox is the only zoom mode that supports keyboard navigation shortcuts (Escape, Arrow keys). If you want to offer keyboard-friendly browsing, choose Open Lightbox as your Image Zoom setting.

## Keyboard Navigation for Open Lightbox

When Image Zoom is set to Open Lightbox, customers can use keyboard shortcuts to navigate product images faster and more efficiently. This feature is especially valuable for desktop users, power shoppers, and customers who prefer keyboard-only navigation for accessibility reasons.

New Feature

Keyboard Shortcuts Now Available

Shoppers can now browse product images using Escape and Arrow keys when the lightbox is open, making image navigation faster and more accessible.

### Supported Keyboard Shortcuts

The following keys are active when a customer clicks a product image and the Open Lightbox zoom opens:

**Escape (Esc)** — Closes the lightbox and returns the customer to the Product Details Page.

**Right Arrow (→)** — Moves to the next image in the product gallery.

**Left Arrow (←)** — Moves to the previous image in the product gallery.

### How Keyboard Navigation Works

Behavior 1

Auto-Focus on Open

When the lightbox opens, it automatically receives keyboard focus. Customers can immediately press Escape or Arrow keys without clicking inside the lightbox first. This removes friction and makes navigation instant.

Behavior 2

Wrap-Around Navigation

Pressing Right Arrow on the last image jumps to the first image. Pressing Left Arrow on the first image jumps to the last image. This continuous loop lets customers explore all images without hitting a dead end or needing to reverse direction manually.

Behavior 3

Page Scroll Prevention

While the lightbox is open, arrow keys no longer scroll the page behind the popup. All keyboard input is reserved for controlling the image gallery. This prevents accidental page movement and keeps focus on product browsing.

Behavior 4

Thumbnail Strip Syncing

As customers navigate with arrow keys, the thumbnail strip automatically scrolls to keep the active thumbnail visible. The currently displayed image is highlighted in the thumbnail strip, providing clear visual feedback of position within the gallery.

### Mouse and Touch Interactions (Unchanged)

Keyboard shortcuts are added on top of existing lightbox controls. All familiar mouse and touch interactions continue to work normally:

- Clicking arrow buttons still navigates between images
- Clicking thumbnails still jumps directly to that image
- Clicking the close icon still exits the lightbox
- Zoom in/out and reset controls remain available
- Grid or view toggle controls remain unchanged

Accessibility Benefit

Keyboard navigation supports customers who rely on keyboard-only workflows, improves compliance with accessibility best practices, and creates a faster browsing experience for power users who prefer keyboard shortcuts over mouse clicks.

## How to Configure Product Media Layouts

Product Media Layouts and Image Zoom settings are configured through the Product Details element in your store's Page Builder. Follow these steps to set up your preferred layout and enable keyboard navigation.

Step 1

Navigate to Your Store

In your HighLevel account, go to **Sites → Stores**. Select the store that contains the Product Details Page you want to configure.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077298088/original/phXZraMlFGn-Cqmx6MIZvkl7nj9_du3fRw.png?1785477655)

Step 2

Open the Product Details Page

From your store's page list, click to edit the **Product Details Page** (or your Custom Product Details Page if you've created a custom PDP). The page will open in the Page Builder editor.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077298147/original/lZOVeB-bPCdPKjYg4YTAOsIQNqP3fFhr-Q.png?1785477760)

Step 3

Select the Product Details Element

Click on the **Product Details** or **Product** element that displays your product images and information. This element controls all media layout and zoom settings for the page.

Step 4

Choose Your Product Media Layout

In the element settings panel (usually on the right side of the builder), locate the **Product Media Layout** or **Desktop Media** section. Select your preferred layout from the available options (e.g., Carousel with Thumbnails, Grid Gallery, Stacked Vertical, Single Image).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077298172/original/9mzQLjJ3bchK9bGl434PERKeOD8fe6i-gg.png?1785477782)

Step 5

Configure Image Zoom Setting

Find the **Image Zoom** dropdown in the settings panel. Choose from **Open Lightbox**, **Click & Hover Zoom**, or **No Zoom**. To enable keyboard navigation shortcuts, select **Open Lightbox**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077298190/original/ZRFI8vs4kwDPqVvlNvj1P-V5POCG68-dAw.png?1785477807)

Step 6

Save and Publish Your Changes

Click **Save** in the Page Builder, then click **Publish** to push your changes to the live store. Your new media layout and zoom settings will now apply to all products on that Product Details Page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077298208/original/K8oLEiEUOqX4QVJFpzwetdFJ40cJ-RSmiw.png?1785477834)

Step 7

Test Keyboard Navigation (Optional)

Open **Builder Preview** or visit a product page on your live store. Click a product image to open the lightbox, then test keyboard shortcuts:

- Press **Right Arrow** and **Left Arrow** to navigate between images
- Press **Escape** to close the lightbox
- Verify that arrow keys no longer scroll the page while the lightbox is open

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077298228/original/qog62wFZb1m0TLh_MKlGynEtsTbseZlnNA.png?1785477861)

Important

Keyboard shortcuts only work when Image Zoom is set to Open Lightbox. If you choose Click & Hover Zoom or No Zoom, the lightbox navigation shortcuts will not be available because the fullscreen lightbox does not open.

## Best Practices for Product Media

Optimizing your Product Media Layout and zoom settings improves the customer experience, increases conversion rates, and reduces product returns. Follow these best practices to get the most from your product images.

**Use high-resolution images** — Upload images that are large enough to support zooming without pixelation. Aim for at least 1200–1500 pixels on the longest side for products where detail matters (fashion, electronics, jewelry).

**Show multiple angles** — Include front, back, side, and detail shots so customers can inspect the product thoroughly. More images increase buyer confidence and reduce "What does it look like?" questions.

**Optimize file sizes** — Compress images to balance quality and load speed. Large files slow down page performance and hurt conversion rates, especially on mobile devices.

**Use descriptive alt text** — Add clear alt text to every product image for accessibility and SEO. Alt text helps screen readers and search engines understand what the image shows.

**Test on multiple devices** — Preview your Product Details Page on desktop, tablet, and mobile to confirm that images load quickly, zoom works correctly, and keyboard shortcuts function as expected on desktop devices.

**Match layout to product type** — Use carousel layouts for products with many images, grid layouts for comparison-heavy products (e.g., color variants), and single-image layouts for simple or digital products.

**Enable Open Lightbox for high-value products** — If your products benefit from detailed inspection (luxury goods, technical equipment, custom items), use Open Lightbox zoom with keyboard shortcuts to provide the best browsing experience.

title_en: Cancel and Reschedule Appointments with Conversation AI
source_md:
Conversation AI can help contacts manage existing appointments directly within a conversation. By enabling cancellation and rescheduling actions, your bot can reduce manual appointment-management work while giving contacts a faster way to change their bookings. These controls can be enabled independently and tested before the bot begins handling live conversations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Cancellation and Rescheduling in Conversation AI?](#What-is-Cancellation-and-Rescheduling-in-Conversation-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Cancellation and Rescheduling](#Key-Benefits-of-Cancellation-and-Rescheduling)
- [How Appointment Booking, Rescheduling, and Cancellation Work](#How-Appointment-Booking,-Rescheduling,-and-Cancellation-Work)
- [Cancellation and Rescheduling Controls](#Cancellation-and-Rescheduling-Controls)
- [Appointment Notifications After a Cancellation or Reschedule](#Appointment-Notifications-After-a-Cancellation-or-Reschedule)
- [Conversation AI vs. Booking Widget Cancellation and Rescheduling](#Conversation-AI-vs.-Booking-Widget-Cancellation-and-Rescheduling)
- [How To Set Up Cancellation and Rescheduling in Conversation AI](#How-To-Set-Up-Cancellation-and-Rescheduling-in-Conversation-AI)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Cancellation and Rescheduling in Conversation AI?**

Cancellation and rescheduling allow Conversation AI to manage existing appointments for a contact during an active conversation. Instead of requiring a team member to make the change manually, the bot can help a contact cancel an appointment or move it to another available time when the corresponding action is enabled. New appointment bookings remain tied to the calendar configured for the bot, while existing appointments can be canceled or rescheduled across calendars at the contact level.

---

## **Key Benefits of Cancellation and Rescheduling**

Giving contacts more control over their appointments can reduce friction while helping your team spend less time processing routine scheduling requests.

- **Automated appointment changes:** Contacts can cancel or reschedule appointments through a Conversation AI interaction instead of waiting for manual assistance.
- **Cross-calendar appointment management:** Existing appointments can be canceled or rescheduled even when they belong to a calendar other than the calendar configured for new bot bookings.
- **Flexible bot behavior:** Cancellation and rescheduling can be enabled or disabled independently based on how you want the bot to manage appointments.
- **Multiple cancellations:** A contact with multiple appointments can cancel several appointments within the same interaction.
- **Support for appointment statuses:** Cancellation and rescheduling are supported across appointment statuses documented for this feature.
- **Safer testing before launch:** Bot Trial lets you test appointment-management behavior before using it with live contacts.

---

## **How Appointment Booking, Rescheduling, and Cancellation Work**

Understanding how each appointment action uses calendars helps prevent unexpected booking behavior. New appointment creation and changes to existing appointments follow different calendar rules.

- **New bookings:** New appointments are created using the calendar configured for the bot’s appointment-booking action.
- **Rescheduling existing appointments:** Existing appointments can be rescheduled across calendars at the contact level.
- **Canceling existing appointments:** Existing appointments can be canceled across calendars at the contact level.
- **Multiple cancellations:** If a contact has multiple appointments, the bot can process multiple cancellations within the same conversation.

### **Appointment Eligibility and Scheduling Conflicts**

Conversation AI checks appointment timing when contacts request a cancellation or reschedule.

**Past Appointments:**Appointments that have already started are not offered as options for cancellation or rescheduling.

**Scheduling Conflicts:** When rescheduling an appointment, the bot prevents moving it to a time when the contact already has another appointment.

**Past Time Slots:**If a requested rescheduling time has already passed, the bot informs the contact and offers the next available time.

These safeguards help contacts manage upcoming appointments without selecting past appointments or creating scheduling conflicts.

---

## **Cancellation and Rescheduling Controls**

Separate controls for cancellation and rescheduling let you decide which appointment-management actions the bot should be allowed to perform. This is useful when your business allows one type of appointment change but wants the other handled manually.

You can configure the bot to:

- Allow both cancellation and rescheduling.
- Allow cancellation while keeping rescheduling disabled.
- Allow rescheduling while keeping cancellation disabled.
- Disable both actions when Conversation AI should only handle new bookings.

The individual controls can be changed later. However, if the feature requires activation through Labs in your account, the release configuration states that the Labs activation itself cannot be reversed after it is enabled.

---

## **Appointment Notifications After a Cancellation or Reschedule**

Changing an appointment and notifying the contact are separate parts of the appointment experience. Configure your calendar notifications or related automation if you want contacts, guests, or team members to receive messages after an appointment is canceled or rescheduled.

HighLevel calendar notifications can be configured for events such as appointment cancellations and changes to an appointment’s date or time. Available channels can include email, SMS, WhatsApp, and in-app notifications depending on the configuration.

For more information, see [Calendar: Email, In-App, SMS & WhatsApp Appointment Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003441-calendar-email-in-app-appointment-notifications?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

---

## **Conversation AI vs. Booking Widget Cancellation and Rescheduling**

Conversation AI appointment actions and cancellation or rescheduling links in a booking widget serve similar customer needs but are configured differently. Keeping these features separate helps ensure that rules intended for booking links are not mistakenly treated as Conversation AI rules.

The Booking Widget includes its own **Cancellation & Reschedule Policy**, which can determine how long cancellation and rescheduling links remain available to bookers. Those settings control the links generated for the booking experience.

The available HighLevel documentation reviewed for this article does not establish that Booking Widget link-expiration rules also limit Conversation AI appointment actions. Avoid assuming that those policies apply to Conversation AI unless your account configuration or updated HighLevel documentation specifically confirms it.

For Booking Widget controls, see [Cancellation & Reschedule Policy (Booking Widget)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002738-cancellation-reschedule-policy-booking-widget-?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

---

## **How To Set Up Cancellation and Rescheduling in Conversation AI**

Proper setup ensures that the bot has the correct appointment actions available and gives you an opportunity to verify the customer experience before live conversations begin. Review the Labs requirement, configure the appropriate bot, and test each appointment scenario you plan to support.

**1. Enable the Labs Feature, If Required**

If **Cancel And Reschedule** is available as a Labs feature in your account:

1. Navigate to **Labs**.
2. Locate **Cancel And Reschedule**.
3. Review the feature information before enabling it.
4. Enable the feature.

**Important:** The release configuration for this feature states that enabling the Labs feature is irreversible. The cancellation and rescheduling controls inside the bot can still be toggled as needed.

**2. Open the Conversation AI Bot**

1. Navigate to **Conversation AI**.
2. Select the bot you want to configure.
3. Click **Edit Bot**.
4. Open **Bot Goals**.

Bot Goals control what a Conversation AI agent should accomplish and which actions it can take during a conversation.

**3. Open the Appointment Booking Action**

1. Locate the bot action used for appointment booking.
2. Open the **Appointment Booking Action**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082744853/original/1jQtk2tIY8HenL8tWrl9zB8x2Se_xEdSKQ.png?1791375765)
3. Confirm that the correct calendar is configured for new bookings.

The calendar selected for appointment booking determines where new appointments created by the bot are placed.

**4. Enable Cancellation and/or Rescheduling**

Use the available controls to enable the appointment actions you want the bot to perform.

- Turn on **Rescheduling** if contacts should be able to move existing appointments.
- Turn on **Cancellation** if contacts should be able to cancel existing appointments.
- Enable both if the bot should support both types of appointment changes.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082745086/original/oaNxCxnQ48UH1fuB0GcJtRzNfNEMDJe8OQ.png?1791375878)

**5. Test the Experience in Bot Trial**

Use **Bot Trial** before making the updated bot experience available to live contacts. Testing helps verify that the conversation behaves as intended and that the correct appointment actions are offered.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can Conversation AI cancel an appointment from a calendar other than the bot’s booking calendar?**

Yes. Existing appointments can be canceled across calendars at the contact level. New bookings, however, are created using the calendar configured for the bot.

**Q: Can Conversation AI reschedule an appointment from another calendar?**

Yes. Existing appointments can be rescheduled across calendars at the contact level.

**Q: Can the bot cancel multiple appointments at once?**

Yes. HighLevel documents support for multiple cancellations during a single interaction when a contact has multiple appointments.

**Q: Can I enable cancellation without enabling rescheduling?**

Yes. Cancellation and rescheduling have separate controls, allowing you to enable the actions independently.

**Q: Will a contact automatically receive a message when the bot cancels or reschedules an appointment?**

Notification behavior depends on your calendar notification and automation configuration. HighLevel lets you configure notification events for cancellations and reschedules separately.

**Q: Can I turn cancellation or rescheduling off after enabling it?**

Yes. The individual bot controls can be toggled on or off. However, the existing feature documentation states that activation of the related Labs feature itself is irreversible.

---

## **Related Articles**

title_en: New UI for Email creation via Bulk action in Contacts
source_md:
The Bulk Email Builder in HighLevel provides a unified way to create and send emails to multiple contacts directly from **Contacts → Smart Lists**. After selecting contacts, you can use **Quick Compose**, **From Smart Builder**, or **Select Existing Template** to create your message. Before sending, HighLevel helps you review eligible recipients, configure sender and tracking options, test the email, and choose how it should be delivered. This guide explains the complete bulk-email workflow and where to review performance afterward.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is the Bulk Email Builder?](#what-is-bulk-email)
- [Key Benefits of the Bulk Email Builder](#key-benefits)
- [Pre-Send Contact Filtering](#recipient-filtering)
- [Email Creation Options](#creation-options)
- [Additional Email Settings](#additional-settings)
- [Sending Options](#delivery-options)
- [How to Create and Send a Bulk Email](#send-bulk-email)
- [How to Track Bulk Email Performance](#email-performance)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

# **What Is the Bulk Email Builder?**

The Bulk Email Builder is the email creation experience available after selecting contacts under **Contacts → Smart Lists** and choosing **Send Email** from the bulk-action toolbar.

It brings three email creation options into one flow:

- **Quick Compose** for simple messages.
- **From Smart Builder** for Design, Code, or Plain Text editing.
- **Select Existing Template** for saved templates or Template Library designs.

The Bulk Email dialog also supports dynamic object labels. If the default Contact label has been configured as something such as **Leads** or **Clients**, the interface can display that configured terminology automatically.

Changing the displayed object label does not change recipient selection, filtering, or email-delivery behavior.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Bulk Email Builder**

The Bulk Email Builder combines message creation, recipient review, delivery controls, engagement settings, and reporting into a streamlined bulk-send workflow.

- **Flexible Email Creation:** Choose Quick Compose, Smart Builder, or an existing template based on the type of message you need to send.
- **Recipient Review:** Review selected, filtered-out, and eligible recipients before sending.
- **Controlled Delivery:** Send immediately, schedule delivery, or process messages in timed batches using Drip Mode.
- **Engagement Tools:** Configure supported click tracking, UTM parameters, and tagging options.
- **Centralized Reporting:** Review individual bulk-action results and access broader email reporting from the unified Statistics dashboard.

---

## **Pre-Send Contact Filtering**

Before a bulk email is sent, HighLevel reviews the selected records and provides a recipient summary so you can understand who is eligible to receive the message.

The summary can include:

- **Selected contacts:** The contacts included in your original selection.
- **Filtered-out contacts:** Contacts excluded because of conditions such as an invalid email address, an unsubscribe status, or applicable email DND restrictions.
- **Eligible recipients:** The contacts remaining after applicable sending restrictions are evaluated.

Review these counts before continuing. Recipient filtering helps prevent messages from being sent to ineligible records, but it does not replace your responsibility to follow applicable consent, compliance, and email-sending requirements.

![Bulk Email recipient summary showing selected filtered-out and eligible contacts](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064218841/original/wfmZ-psbA9_NmFL3yC6dbxwItRUqxbn9MQ.png?1770246883)

---

## **Email Creation Options**

Choose the email creation method that best fits the amount of design, customization, and reuse required for your message.

**Quick Compose:** A lightweight option for writing simple emails quickly. Quick Compose is separate from the Plain Text Editor available through Smart Builder.

**From Smart Builder:** Provides the full email-building experience with the following editing options:

- **Design Editor** for visual, drag-and-drop email creation.
- **Code Editor** for code-based email creation.
- **Plain Text Editor** for text-focused messages without a visual design layout.

**Select Existing Template:** Choose from saved email templates or browse available designs in the Template Library.

![Bulk Email Builder showing available email creation options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064218844/original/ngcorEPkoMlrOw8YkfHwoSmJ9e36UsVfeQ.png?1770246905)

---

## **Additional Email Settings**

Use **Additional Settings** to configure supported tracking and contact-management options for the bulk email.

- **Track Clicks:** Records supported link interactions so click activity can be included in email reporting.
- **UTM Tracking:** Adds configured UTM parameters to supported links for external campaign and traffic analysis.
- **Add Tags:** Applies configured tags according to the supported engagement options available in the Bulk Email Builder.

![Additional Settings in the Bulk Email Builder showing tracking UTM and tagging options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064218877/original/gsQFZ5ksg69zXIkJJCWezrILiqouj-sR-A.png?1770247017)

---

## **Sending Options**

After reviewing the email and its recipients, choose the delivery method that fits your sending schedule.

- **Send Immediately:** Submit the email for processing without scheduling it for a later time.
- **Schedule the Send:** Choose a future date and time for the bulk email.
- **Drip Mode:** Process the selected recipients in timed batches. Configure options such as the start time, batch quantity, repeat interval, and available sending windows as needed.

Drip Mode controls the pace of bulk processing. It does not guarantee inbox placement or email deliverability.

---

## **How to Create and Send a Bulk Email**

Use the following workflow to select recipients, create the email, verify its settings, and submit the bulk-send job.

1. **Select contacts.** Go to **Contacts → Smart Lists**. Apply filters or open a Smart List, then select the applicable contacts using their checkboxes.
2. **Open Bulk Email.** Click **Send Email** in the bulk-action toolbar. Review the initial selection confirmation if it appears.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083358415/original/lMRPtKHNNh2NbegCXdntxCleZ_R96maX9g.png?1792023116)

1. **Review recipients.** Check the selected, filtered-out, and eligible recipient counts before continuing.
2. **Enter sender details.** Configure the applicable **From Name**, **From Email**, and **Subject**. Add preview text, an action name, or other available email details as needed.
3. **Choose an editor.** Select **Quick Compose**, **From Smart Builder**, or **Select Existing Template**, then create or customize the email.
4. **Configure optional settings.** Open **Additional Settings** and configure supported click tracking, UTM parameters, or tagging options as needed.
5. **Send a test.** Enter the **Test Email ID**, click **Send Test Mail**, and review the received email for content, formatting, links, and sender information.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083358749/original/6k-IOr14-zwqUVMAQSKqoSNaY_Pt4PuvWg.png?1792023774)

1. **Review the campaign.** Click **Review Campaign** and verify the sender information, content, links, and recipient information.
2. **Choose delivery.** Send immediately, schedule the send, or configure Drip Mode. Complete any required sending or consent confirmation shown in the interface.
3. **Submit and track the job.** Click **Send Email**, then review the resulting bulk-action job under **Contacts → Bulk Actions**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083359050/original/c5Pb5_HAcsbZGUz5-LdKPfaIF53IY1d0LQ.png?1792024503)

```
Important: Review your recipients, sender details, and email content before submitting the bulk action. Emails that have already been processed cannot be recalled through Bulk Actions.
```

---

## **How to Track Bulk Email Performance**

HighLevel provides both job-level statistics for an individual bulk action and broader email reporting through the unified Email Statistics dashboard.

To review a specific bulk-send job:

1. Go to **Contacts → Bulk Actions**.
2. Locate the applicable bulk-email job.
3. Click **Show Stats**.
4. Review the available processing outcomes and delivery metrics.
5. If available, use the downloadable error information to investigate failed records.
6. Use **Load More Stats** when you need access to more detailed email reporting.

For broader reporting, go to **Marketing → Emails → Statistics**.

Use the available source filters, including **Bulk Action Campaigns**, to focus the dashboard on bulk-email activity. The unified dashboard can include reporting for Campaigns, Workflows, and Bulk Actions.

Depending on the reporting view, available metrics may include delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, failed, and skipped emails.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083360447/original/PshUL61h9swEEkl3tE2XmcGPBsZ_SUp4gQ.png?1792030463)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is the eligible-recipient count lower than the number of contacts I selected?**

Invalid email addresses, unsubscribed contacts, and applicable email-sending restrictions such as DND can reduce the number of contacts eligible to receive the bulk email.

**Q: Does changing the Contact label to Leads or Clients affect email delivery?**

No. A configured object label changes the terminology displayed in the interface. It does not change the underlying recipient-selection, filtering, or email-sending process.

**Q: Are Quick Compose and the Plain Text Editor the same?**

No. **Quick Compose** is a separate lightweight composition option. The **Plain Text Editor** is one of the editing modes available through Smart Builder.

**Q: Will contacts added to a Smart List later automatically receive an already scheduled bulk email?**

Contacts bulk actions and scheduled Email Campaigns use different sending processes. Review your selected audience when scheduling a bulk email, and do not assume that later Smart List changes will automatically update an existing bulk action.

**Q: Can I pause or cancel a bulk email after submitting it?**

Available controls depend on the bulk job's type and current status. Review the applicable job under **Contacts → Bulk Actions** for any available controls. Emails that have already been processed cannot be recalled.

**Q: Can I send bulk email from Company or Custom Object records?**

Yes. HighLevel also supports bulk email to associated contacts from supported Company and Custom Object records. See [Send Bulk Email to Associated Contacts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008744-send-bulk-email-to-associated-contacts) for the separate workflow.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Bulk Actions for Contacts & Smart Lists](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001167703)
- [How to Create and Manage Smart Lists](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001062094-how-to-create-manage-smart-lists)
- [All-in-One Dashboard for Email Marketing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005552-how-to-access-the-all-in-one-dashboard-for-email-marketing)
- [Set Up Drip Mode for Bulk Actions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006472-new-drip-mode-architecture-for-bulk-actions)
- [Send Bulk Email to Associated Contacts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008744-send-bulk-email-to-associated-contacts)
- [Sender Email Priority and Configuration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000979925)

title_en: Social Planner - Category Queue
source_md:
HighLevel's Category Queue feature helps you automate and repurpose evergreen social content. Group posts under a category, define a recurring publishing schedule, and let the queue cycle through the posts continuously. This article explains how Category Queues work, how to create and manage them, and how to control future content.

 
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/cB9h1yR-vKU?&wmode=opaque)
 

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is a Category Queue?](#What-Is-a-Category-Queue?)
- [Key Benefits of Category Queues](#Key-Benefits-of-Category-Queues)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [How to Create a Category Queue](#How-to-Create-a-Category-Queue)
- [How to Manage a Category Queue](#How-to-Manage-a-Category-Queue)
- [Important Notes](#Important-Notes)
- [Category Queue Public API](#Category-Queue-Public-API)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What Is a Category Queue?**

A Category Queue lets you group social posts under a category and publish them according to a recurring schedule. After the queue reaches the final post, it starts again from the beginning, making it useful for evergreen content.

You can build a queue from published posts assigned to a category, add new posts while configuring the queue, and automatically include future posts created under the same category.

---

## **Key Benefits of Category Queues**

- **Automated evergreen scheduling:** Publish category-based content continuously without manually rescheduling every post.
- **Reusable content:** Repurpose published posts and include future posts assigned to the same category.
- **Priority control:** Choose whether new content appears at the beginning or end of the queue.
- **Custom schedules:** Set specific publishing days and time slots for each queue.
- **Flexible queue management:** Edit, reorder, pause, resume, reschedule, or delete a queue as needed.

---

## **Before You Begin**

```
Note: To create a queue from existing content, make sure the published posts are assigned to the appropriate social category. You can also create a new category and add posts while setting up the queue.
```

---

## **How to Create a Category Queue**

1. Log in to your sub-account.
2. Go to **Marketing** > **Social Planner**.  
     
   ![Navigate to Social Planner from the Marketing menu](https://jumpshare.com/share/Pc9OwGeP0CQNwDqQGxDI+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-24+at+10.50.25+PM.png)
3. Click **+ New Post**, then select **Category Queue**.  
     
   ![Select Category Queue from the New Post menu](https://jumpshare.com/share/8c1m6djAWSQvyC42Ytl2+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-24+at+11.07.43+PM.png)
4. Under **Select a Category**, choose the category you want to use for the queue.  
     
   ![Select an existing social category for the queue](https://jumpshare.com/share/qbxG3xek8G9cvNa14qm6+/CN96DupK6jOf3xVoh6AdGV2sZqbOoSTBkQ.jpeg)
5. To create a category, enter a new category name and select the option to add it.  
     
   ![Create a new social category while setting up a queue](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060860653/original/VICQYWl3jqjF_J-r8Rp0z-lF_L85LMWg5Q.png?1765991958)
6. Enable **Enable future posts queuing** to automatically add future posts assigned to the category to this queue.
7. Enable **Prioritize new content** to add newly queued content to the beginning of the queue. When disabled, new content is added to the end.
8. Click **Continue**.  
     
   ![Continue after selecting the category and queue preferences](https://jumpshare.com/share/NcCpZOrNCiOcoM56an2w+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-24+at+11.46.49+PM.png)
9. Select the publishing days and time slots for the queue.
10. Click **Queue Posts** to apply the schedule and continue to the queue editor.  
      
    ![Set the publishing schedule and continue to the queue editor](https://jumpshare.com/share/6p1qoeG3RInnMgludW8d+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-24+at+11.49.18+PM.png)
11. Review the queued posts. Edit the post content or media as needed.
12. To add another post, click **New Post**. You can then drag the post to the preferred position in the queue.
13. Add multiple content variations when you want the queue to rotate different versions of a post.  
      
    ![Add content variations to a post in a Category Queue](https://jumpshare.com/share/Z8q8ZI64iYqMe5h0QpxB+/GIF+Recording+2025-11-25+at+7.17.11+PM.gif)
14. Review all caution, warning, and error messages, and resolve any identified issues.
15. When no blocking errors remain, click **Queue Posts** to activate the queue.  
      
    ![Resolve queue errors and activate the Category Queue](https://jumpshare.com/share/J5Lsc81T3q8Al1fhDM9n+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-25+at+7.03.11+PM.png)
16. Before activating the queue, you can select **Save as Draft**, **Delete**, or **Reset**, as needed.  
      
    ![Save, delete, or reset a Category Queue](https://jumpshare.com/share/Llasxm2JW3kAaDJTeQTp+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-25+at+7.05.00+PM.png)
17. To pause or resume the Category Queue later, go to the **Content** tab and use the queue status toggle.  
      
    ![Pause or resume a Category Queue from the Content tab](https://jumpshare.com/share/5RTw8IW6FJ7agWsJNyDs+/2hAzCIIduz8i2sS6g_8TQKy0WWJV6xY6eA.jpeg)

---

## **How to Manage a Category Queue**

Go to **Marketing** > **Social Planner** > **Content** > **Category Queue**. Locate the queue, then click the **More options** icon to view the available management actions.

![Category Queue More options menu in Social Planner](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060861302/original/0_Bh0pGd3Mn6ZujZ9FiubHRzUCGT6W0R_g.png?1765992875)

### **1. Edit a Category Queue**

Select **Edit queue** to update the queue without deleting or recreating it. You can edit:

- Post details, captions, media, and variations
- Publishing frequency
- Queue time slots
- Post order by dragging and dropping items

### **2. Configure Queue Preferences**

Select **Queue preferences** from the **More options** menu. The available settings control how future posts are added to the queue.

| **Setting** | **When enabled** | **When disabled** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Enable future posts queuing** | Automatically adds new posts created under the category to the queue. | Future posts are not automatically added to the queue. |
| **Prioritize new content** | Adds new content to the beginning of the queue so it publishes first. | Adds new content to the end of the queue. |

![Queue preferences option in the Category Queue menu](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060861428/original/raCU9zXB_zDWhZXW26mheyXJqRNBqLpaaQ.png?1765993165)

![Enable future posts queuing and Prioritize new content settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060861440/original/ME71MM_VsLUBQ32yGp-MItMmFsrGYroTag.png?1765993199)

### **3. View the Queue Calendar**

Select **View queue calendar** to review the queue in weekly or monthly view. Use the calendar to see how posts are distributed and identify scheduling gaps or content-heavy days.

### **4. Reschedule the Entire Queue**

Select **Reschedule queue** to move the entire queue to a new start date. HighLevel recalculates the post dates based on the queue's existing publishing frequency and time slots.

![Reschedule queue option in Social Planner](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060861506/original/B-rKvVdwo3Ba2sjFuTy_MomIyZxXhekw3A.png?1765993274)

![Select a new start date for a Category Queue](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060861546/original/26ZksYwNAv7d-SEUJtty5NKelnd9UQtbDA.png?1765993329)

### **5. Add Posts from the Post Composer**

While creating a social post, select **Add to Queue** and choose a category.

- Selecting an existing category adds the post to that category's queue.
- Creating a new category creates a corresponding category queue for the post.

![Add a social post to an existing or new Category Queue](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063016594/original/FS8wPfJv0ra9CbjnufIbaucaLvlj_uz7eA.png?1768888475)

### **6. Pause, Resume, or Delete a Queue**

- Use the status toggle on the **Category Queue** page to pause or resume a queue.
- Select **Delete** from the **More options** menu to remove a queue that you no longer need.
- Use **Reset** while editing a queue to discard changes to a queue item and restore its original content.

---

## **Important Notes**

- Category Queues can include previously published posts assigned to a category. You can also create new posts and add them to the queue.
- Rescheduling an individual post in a Category Queue is not supported.
- You cannot reschedule or rearrange posts directly from the Category Queue calendar.
- Changes made under **Queue preferences** take effect from the next queue cycle.
- You can pause, resume, or delete a Category Queue from the **Content** tab.
- To review category and queue status, go to **Marketing > Social Planner > Settings > Categories.** The status column shows whether the queue is active, paused, or in draft.

---

## **Category Queue Public API**

If you want to create or manage Category Queues programmatically for custom workflows, integrations, or automation, you can use the **Category Queue Public API**.

Find the API reference in **Public API Docs → Social Planner → Category Queue**.

Authenticate with your **Location API key** or an **OAuth token**, depending on your integration type.

### **Common Supported Actions**

| Action | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Fetch categories | Fetch available categories and their queue status. |
| Manage Category Queues | Create, list, update, and fetch Category Queues. |
| Manage queue items | Add, update, reset, and delete queue items. |
| View calendar data | View scheduled posts in calendar formats. |
| Advance the queue | Delete the currently active post and schedule the next available post. |

For endpoint details, request and response schemas, and examples, use the official documentation.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How do I automatically add future posts to a Category Queue?**

Open **Queue preferences** and enable **Enable future posts queuing**. HighLevel then automatically adds new posts created under that category to the queue.

**Q: How do I publish newly added content before existing queue items?**

Enable **Prioritize new content** under **Queue preferences**. New content is then added to the beginning of the queue.

**Q: Can I change a Category Queue's schedule?**

Yes. Use **Edit queue** to change the publishing frequency or time slots. Use **Reschedule queue** to move the entire queue to a new start date. Rescheduling an individual queue post is not supported.

**Q: How do I add a new post to an existing queue?**

Open the queue and select **New Post**, or select **Add to Queue** from the social post composer and choose the category. You can then drag the post to the preferred position while editing the queue.

**Q: Can I add multiple content variations?**

Yes. Add variations to rotate different versions of the post's content and media.

**Q: Can I change the order of posts later?**

Yes. Select **Edit queue**, then drag and drop the posts into the preferred order.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Set Up Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005063)
- [Social Planner - Track Social Performance Using Advanced Analytics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004101)
- [Social Planner - Discover Trends with Social Listening](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006434)
- [Social Planner - Link Shortener](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005007)
- [Content AI with Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001234788)

# **What Can Workflow AI Do?**

1. ### **Help you with your first workflow**

   If you are new to workflows, you can just mention what you want to achieve and Workflow AI will give you the actions and triggers you need to add and help you configure the same. AI Assistant can also explain what are workflows and how to use them.
2. ### **Break Down Your Workflow**

   If you're not sure about a specific part of your workflow, just ask. Workflow AI can describe what’s happening, making complex workflows easier to understand.
3. ### **Make Your Workflows More Efficient**

   Workflow AI can scan your workflow for potential improvements, offering tips on how to streamline processes and what actions can be added to achieve it.
4. ### **Step-by-Step Guidance**

   Need help setting up a workflow? Workflow AI can guide you through the process, explaining each step so you can feel confident in what you’re building.
5. ### **Answer Questions**

   Got questions while you’re working on a workflow? You can ask Workflow AI for help with any doubts or queries—whether it’s about specific actions or general best practices.
6. ### **Add Actions to Your Workflow**

   It can even help you add specific actions—like sending an SMS reminder, waiting for confirmation, updating an appointment status, or tagging contacts based on activity.
7. ### **Suggest Next Steps**

   Not sure what to do next? Workflow AI provides suggestions for the next steps you should take, helping you move forward with confidence.
8. Manage workflow settings and naming Workflow AI can help you rename the workflow and update workflow settings through natural-language prompts. This includes re-entry, multiple opportunities, stop on response, timezone/time windows, sender details, and mark conversations as read.

---

# **How To Use Workflow AI**

When you open the builder you can find the Workflow AI on the bottom left corner of the builder. After clicking the AI icon, the chat box will open.

**There are 4 ways you can chat with Workflow AI:**

1. **Analyze Workflow:** Click the "Describe this Workflow" button to have Workflow AI analyze your workflow.
2. **Help Building:** Click the "Assist with Building" button to get suggestions for your workflow from Workflow AI.
3. **Standard Chat:**Start typing in the text box and ask it anything.
4. **Explain a Workflow Imported Through a Snapshot:**When you open a workflow imported through a snapshot, an Explain This Workflow pill appears at the top of the workflow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035129651/original/jwZwwK-eV9l0uxQNXMPz-hmo_Hz25Owq7A.jpeg?1729538529)

---

# **Learn More About Workflows**

Workflow AI isn't only for helping you build a workflow or analyzing your current workflow structure! You can also learn anything you need to know about workflows by chatting with Workflow AI. If you need to learn more about different actions or triggers, or if you don't even know what an action or a trigger is, you can simply ask Workflow AI.

**For Example:** In the screenshot below, we asked Workflow AI "What is a trigger" and the answer we received was a detailed explanation what a trigger is with some examples of different workflow triggers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035127626/original/G9c94h31VcKm85WK87WHPflmqUfk-_EZLQ.jpeg?1729535368)

---

# **How to Clear & Start New Chat**

If you need to start a new chat with Workflow AI, all you need to do is click the **"Clear Chat"** button in the top right corner of the Workflow AI chat box. After clicking **"Clear Chat"**, your previous chat will go away and you will be brought back to the first step where you can choose what you'd like Workflow AI to do.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035126833/original/hCNL5VQIXbt6aTKpVGaH3bc4bcb4wHye0w.gif?1729534097)

---

# **How to Export the Current Chat**

If you'd like to export your current chat and keep a record of the conversation, you can simply click the "Export Chat" button to download a copy of the entire conversation.

```
IMPORTANT: Exporting chat will ONLY export a copy of the current conversation. This will not export any previous conversations you may have had with Workflow AI.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035126822/original/ZSz47iER4yiqVunl3ORPa7WKv7L9JLMjrQ.gif?1729534087)

---

# **How to Analyze Your Entire Workflow**

If you want Workflow AI to analyze your workflow and describe the workflow to you or your team, all you need to do is click the **"Describe This Workflow"** button.

Workflow AI will give you a detailed overview of your workflow from start to finish, including some details about different steps in the workflow.

**This can be incredibly useful in the following situations:**

1. You forget why you built a workflow.
2. You have new team members that are learning your processes.
3. When customers want to learn more about a workflow in your snapshot.
4. and dozens of other situations where learning more about a given workflow will help streamline the education process!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035128009/original/2uRHFRGQU_PlxHq5KIlIMMVIx1wybKli_g.png?1729536011)

---

## **Explain a Workflow Imported Through a Snapshot**

Workflows imported through snapshots include an Explain This Workflow pill at the top of the workflow. Use this option when you need context about a workflow you did not build yourself.  
  
To explain a snapshot workflow:  
  
1. Open a workflow that was imported through a snapshot.  
2. Click \*\*Explain This Workflow\*\* at the top of the workflow.  
3. The AI Assistant opens and explains the workflow's triggers, actions, and branching logic.  
4. Continue the conversation to ask follow-up questions about specific parts of the workflow.  
  
You can also ask AI to make changes to the workflow after reviewing the explanation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077919281/original/4Yrui_TXaDkGXfFlwwtXDiWTsTKjb5mVbw.png?1786120999)

# 

# **How to Build Workflows with AI**

If you are having trouble building your workflow, or you just want help from AI to build the best possible workflow for your situation, you can use Workflow AI to get this done fast and easy!

## **Step 1:**Ask Workflow AI for Help

To start building your workflow with AI all you need to do is start typing in the chat box and ask for help building your workflow.

Just mention the use case you want to achieve and Workflow AI will share detailed explanations of the actions and triggers that are best to add for your use case, and give you step-by-step instructions to follow to configure the desired workflow!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035129092/original/Pyb9M0EJsoQtcXeP-09hm0bW--8IXBpM4g.gif?1729537639)

## **Step 2:** Choose from Provided Suggestions

Once you start receiving suggestions from Workflow AI, you'll be able to pick the best option from the suggestions provided.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035129123/original/EyDqZy5onhnq1I3IQQoB7VwyuTz-u0J0GA.png?1729537706)

## **Step 3:** Add Trigger or Action to Workflow

To add the suggested action or trigger to your workflow, simply select the place where you want it to be added. The action will be added and the sidebar will be opened for configuring that specific action.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035129143/original/bdWF009FNq-XAvyao3WPFtGCdy_tZ4MP3A.gif?1729537745)

```
DID YOU KNOW?

Workflow AI will also help you configure the triggers and actions you're adding the workflow! Just tell Workflow AI your end goal and it will guide you through the implementation!  
  
Below is an example where the user asked Workflow AI to configure a wait step where the contact should pass through when they have opened an email.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035128810/original/AfZJaVj0sEDr456Kf4LbdRridoUmCMBMVQ.jpeg?1729537221)
```

## **Step 4:**Next Steps for Workflow

While you're chatting with Workflow AI, it will even give you suggested questions to ask that will help you build next steps in your workflow, or so you can better understand the process that is being implemented!

You can see in the screenshot below that Workflow AI has given us 4 different follow-up questions to ask!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035129316/original/mBgRXprFHAgNwW2E0tKOKu1TK8hVmzcE-A.png?1729538004)

## **Step 5:** Rating Workflow AI's Answers (Optional)

As you continue your conversation with Workflow AI, you can select if you liked what the AI has answered, or tell us if you were not satisfied with the answer. This will give us better insights on where the AI needs to be trained and updated so we can provide you with the best possible Workflow AI possible!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035061908/original/T4mtyZxK2iiPD5nAQ6bUkCXquREPZQ4jSA.png?1729492021)

---

# **Frequently Asked Questions**

### **Q. Why should I use Workflow AI?**

Workflow AI makes building and optimizing workflows much faster and easier. It takes out the guesswork by offering real-time suggestions and making sure your workflows are efficient and error-free.

### **Q. Can Workflow AI handle complex workflows?**

Absolutely! Workflow AI is designed to help with both simple and complex workflows. Whether it’s a one-step process or a multi-layered automation, it’s got your back.

### **Q. How do I add an action in my workflow?**

Workflow AI will suggest actions based on what you’re building. Just click the **+** button next to the action (like sending an SMS or updating a status), and it’ll be added to your workflow.

### **Q. Can I keep a record of my chat with Workflow AI?**

Yes! Just click on the **Export Chat** button to download a copy of the conversation, so you can refer to it whenever you need.

### **Q. Is Workflow AI available for everyone?**

Yes, as long as you have access to workflows, you can use Workflow AI.

title_en: Connect Forms and Calendars in AI Studio
source_md:
Forms and calendars help turn an AI-generated page into a working experience that can collect information or book time with your business. In AI Studio, these components begin as part of the front-end page experience, then can be connected to your HighLevel account when you are ready to make them functional. This makes it easier to build the page first, then complete the connection steps needed for submissions or scheduling.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Forms and Calendars in AI Studio?](#What-are-Forms-and-Calendars-in-AI-Studio?)
- [Key Benefits of Connecting Forms and Calendars in AI Studio](#Key-Benefits-of-Connecting-Forms-and-Calendars-in-AI-Studio)
- [When AI Studio Needs Your Input](#When-AI-Studio-Needs-Your-Input)
- [How Forms Work in AI Studio](#How-Forms-Work-in-AI-Studio)
- [How To Connect Forms in AI Studio](#How-To-Connect-Forms-in-AI-Studio)
- [Where Form Submissions Go After Connection](#Where-Form-Submissions-Go-After-Connection)
- [How Workflows Connect to Form Submissions](#How-Workflows-Connect-to-Form-Submissions)
- [How Calendars Work in AI Studio](#How-Calendars-Work-in-AI-Studio)
- [How To Connect Calendars in AI Studio](#How-To-Connect-Calendars-in-AI-Studio)
- [What Happens After a Calendar Is Connected](#What-Happens-After-a-Calendar-Is-Connected)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Forms and Calendars in AI Studio?**

AI Studio can create the **form experience** on the page. If a user asks for a form, AI Studio can help shape the page around that goal. For example, it can create a contact section, registration section, or book a call section and place the form in the right part of the page. If the request is broad, AI Studio may first ask what kind of form the user wants.

This makes setup easier because users do not need to know all the details before getting started.

This means AI Studio can help create:

- Contact forms
- Registration forms
- Lead capture sections
- Appointment booking pages
- Consultation request pages

AI Studio gives you creative flexibility because it can generate custom, unique forms and booking experiences that match your brand, page style, and overall goal!

```
Important: Forms and calendars are not connected automatically. AI Studio can create the layout for a form or booking section, but you need to ask it to connect that component before it starts sending data into your sub-account.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068281687/original/VCKJ0hcuDDv4v3NWS-0izNzQGcWQCe4e2Q.png?1775059157)

---

## **Key Benefits of Connecting Forms and Calendars in AI Studio**

Connecting forms and calendars in AI Studio helps turn a generated draft into a usable experience for your business. It also saves time by combining page creation with lead capture and booking functionality in one workflow.

- **Faster Setup:** Build the page and the action area together instead of assembling them manually
- **Controlled Connection:** Decide when forms and calendars should be connected to your HighLevel account
- **CRM-Ready Lead Capture:** Connected forms can send submissions into your sub-account
- **Simpler Scheduling Flow:** Connected calendars can turn a booking page into a live scheduling experience

---

## **When AI Studio Needs Your Input**

If AI Studio needs you to choose a calendar or form, it pauses the current request and shows a selection card in chat.

Choose the resource and click **Connect** to continue the same request without sending a new prompt.

If nothing is available to connect, you can create the required resource, return to AI Studio, and click **Check again**. If the list fails to load, click **Try again**.

You can also click **Dismiss** to continue building without the connection and connect it later.

---

## **How Forms Work in AI Studio**

You can ask AI Studio to create different types of forms, such as contact forms, booking inquiry forms and registration forms. AI Studio can add the form directly into the page layout, a section, or a popup flow depending on the prompt and page goal.

Forms in AI Studio start as front-end layouts. This is important because seeing a form on the page does not automatically mean it is already connected to your CRM or collecting submissions. 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068285896/original/y-7pCb1oWXFw-dRjTml14YxiO58fT08JBg.png?1775061287)

### **How To Connect Forms in AI Studio**

When you want the form to start collecting submissions, ask AI Studio to connect it (e.g. "*Connect forms to my CRM*") or click **Connect** when prompted in the chat. This triggers the Connect to CRM flow.

When a form is connected in AI Studio, the page uses HighLevel's external tracking behavior to send submission activity back into the account. After the user chooses to connect CRM tracking to the page, form submissions can be captured into HighLevel and used for follow-up workflows.

In simple terms, the process works like this:

1. AI Studio builds the form on the page
2. The user connects it to CRM tracking
3. Submissions begin flowing into HighLevel

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068277913/original/wT3ZrszE_OG812gntkwQQs-vZz0-ff5dXQ.png?1775057242)

### **Where Form Submissions Go After Connection**

Once connected, form submissions go into the connected sub-account CRM setup, not into the AI Studio project itself. This means that the page lives in AI Studio but the responses, contacts and submission activity go into the connected HighLevel account. After connection, form submissions can appear under form submissions as third-party submissions, and they can also be tied into workflow activity through external tracking behavior.

Users can view submissions in:

1. **Contacts**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068278869/original/F5KfLTQbO5NsWrZwZVyXU-p9nRYb2RGI5Q.png?1775057616)
2. **Sites** > **Forms** > **Submissions** > **External****Forms**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068278950/original/vwg6Q1CvuQnoWvgeEl6iC76h6L74B2kqqA.png?1775057667)

## **How Workflows Connect to Form Submissions**

Use the AI Studio Form Submitted workflow trigger to start a workflow automatically when a visitor submits a connected form on an AI Studio site. The trigger is designed specifically for AI Studio form submissions and lets you automate follow-up actions for captured leads.

To configure the workflow:

1. Go to Automation > Workflows and create a new workflow or open an existing one.
2. Click Add New Trigger.
3. Search for and select AI Studio Form Submitted.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082941344/original/AyMZhWzo41MAe2pMPZsQs1GBWBVm-1SGLg.png?1791544992)
4. Add filters as needed to control which form submissions start the workflow.
5. Add the workflow actions you want to run after the form is submitted. Save and publish the workflow when ready.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082941343/original/yOXohyEQjmgDMiMFzGYRHnALclvTd-yTlw.png?1791544992)

After configuring the trigger, you can add workflow actions such as sending emails or SMS messages, adding tags, creating opportunities, updating contact fields, or assigning contacts to team members.

For complete setup instructions, see [AI Studio Form Submitted Workflow Trigger](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008298-ai-studio-form-submitted-workflow-trigger/).

```
Important: Existing AI Studio forms that use the External Tracking Event > Form submission trigger will continue to work and do not need to be updated.  
  
Reconnect an existing AI Studio form to CRM only if you want that form to use the new AI Studio Form Submitted workflow trigger. Reconnect each existing form individually that you want to use with the new trigger.
```

---

## **How Calendars Work in AI Studio**

AI Studio can create a custom booking experience on the front end instead of only embedding a standard calendar widget layout. If you ask AI Studio for an appointment page, consultation page, or discovery call page, it can generate the front-end layout and add a booking area as part of the experience.

Once connected to one of your pre-existing calendars, that custom experience can use the selected HighLevel calendar in the background for scheduling!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068290680/original/R0Yw05aXWLXPZ2Mdl2cIiNSFvgeK-ChC3Q.png?1775064580)

### **How To Connect Calendars in AI Studio**

Connecting a calendar turns the booking section on the page into a live scheduling experience. Instead of building the scheduling component manually, AI Studio can help you connect an existing calendar from the sub-account.

1. Ask AI Studio to create a booking-focused page or scheduling section.
2. When prompted within the chat, choose the calendar you want to use from the sub-account.
3. Connect that calendar to the page component.
4. Preview and test the booking experience.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068284764/original/6iugIWnPI-GnOtwjnSlQCDhz1yHL-Wu2fg.png?1775060780)

### **What Happens After a Calendar Is Connected**

The calendar itself comes from the sub-account. AI Studio helps place and connect it inside the page experience. So the page lives in AI Studio, but the scheduling setup is still tied to the connected calendar inside the account.

That means any meetings or time slots booked from the AI Studio page are added to that connected calendar instead of staying only on the front end. After the calendar is connected:

- Visitors can book available times from the page
- Booked meetings are added to the selected calendar in your sub-account
- The booking uses the availability and setup already configured on that calendar
- Any automations, follow-up actions, or other calendar-based behavior tied to that calendar can continue to run as configured in HighLevel

This makes the AI Studio page a fast way to present the booking experience while still using the calendar setup that already exists in your account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068285436/original/-95iFshVQARbb2zQMPquezRGkDoOOAnoKQ.png?1775061166)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I edit the page after connecting a form or calendar?**  
Yes. You can continue refining the page experience in AI Studio after the component has been connected.

**Q: Do I need to create a form in HighLevel first before using it in AI Studio?**  
No. AI Studio can generate the front-end form experience from a prompt, then guide you through the connection step when you are ready.

**Q: Do calendar confirmations, reminders, and automations still come from the connected calendar setup?**  
Yes. Once the page is connected to a calendar, bookings made from the page use that selected calendar, so any confirmations, reminders, and automations tied to that calendar will run.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [AI Product Pricing Update](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652)
- [AI Studio in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007587)
- [Tracking External Forms with GoHighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006092)
- [Where Do Form Responses Show Up?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000979916)
- [How to Set Up a Personal Booking Calendar with HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005153)
