title_en: Unified Task Management Across Contacts and Opportunities
source_md:
This guide walks you through HighLevel’s Unified Task Management system, available across Contacts and Opportunities. It’s designed to help users create, edit, and manage tasks through a consistent, efficient interface.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Unified Task Management?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Unified-Task-Management?)
- [Key Benefits of Unified Task Management](#Key-Benefits-of-Unified-Task-Management)
- [How to Use Unified Task Management Across Modules](#How-to-Use-Unified-Task-Management-Across-Modules)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Unified Task Management?**

Unified Task Management in HighLevel allows you to create and manage tasks from both the Contacts and Opportunities modules using the same interface. The system offers a clean layout, powerful filters, and advanced task options—making it easier to stay on top of your to-dos regardless of where you work inside the platform.

In the Contacts module, you can access the task panel from within a contact’s detailed view to create, view, and manage tasks directly associated with that individual.

In the Opportunities module, clicking into any opportunity record opens a similar task panel, allowing you to manage tasks that are tied to that specific deal or pipeline stage—using the same familiar interface.

---

## **Key Benefits of Unified Task Management**

- **Consistent Interface Across Modules:**Tasks look and function the same whether you’re working from a Contact or Opportunity record, minimizing confusion and standardizing task handling.
- **Simplified Task Creation:**A clean and organized task form helps users enter task details quickly, with clearly labeled fields for title, description, due date, and assignee.
- **Recurring Task Options:**Set up tasks to repeat on a schedule, allowing automation of ongoing reminders or processes without additional manual effort.
- **Centralized Filtering and Search:**Locate tasks easily with built-in filters and a search bar that work across all task views—no matter the module.
- **Quick Task Edits:**Open and edit tasks directly using a unified layout, making updates simple and accessible.

---

## **How to Use Unified Task Management**

### **Access Contact List**

Go to the Contacts section in your left-hand menu and select the **Smart Lists** tab. This displays a list of all contacts in your subaccount, where you can view basic info like name, phone number, and email. Click any contact to view their full profile and access task tools.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048627832/original/Fs3OV-aZ8vOOmel75jZ0tlEi35aGZgJDlA.png?1750429054)

#### 

### **Open a Contact Record**

Clicking a contact opens their detailed profile, showing email, phone, preferences, and activity history. To manage tasks, locate and click the **Tasks icon** at the top right corner of the contact view.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048628418/original/xNgcfDS_0LOagSXlKSKSAJ-8AIGfYOdsfw.png?1750429535)

### **Filter Tasks by Team or Status**

Use the filter icon to quickly narrow down your task list. You can filter tasks by assignee or task status, helping you focus on what’s relevant for your workflow. This makes it easier to manage workloads and ensure accountability within your team.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048630461/original/PVVgimYhfyNsX3em2MJqQvzrMeE44OkcIw.png?1750430988)

### **Sort Tasks for Better Visibility**

Click the sort icon to organize tasks by due date or creation date. You can toggle between ascending or descending order to prioritize what needs attention first. This helps maintain clarity when reviewing large task lists.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048630531/original/bsUQ1R6cBfmriXZD6jwmQ0AD33I2gA8Z7w.png?1750431034)

### **Edit or Delete Tasks**

Click the three-dot menu next to any task to open options for editing or deleting it. Select “Edit” to modify task details or “Delete” to remove the task permanently from the record.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048630700/original/7uilwSm4pnYvb1ntErEkAUFwrxyr-ZaxJw.png?1750431104)

### **Add a New Task**

In order to create a New task from Tasks panel of a contact or opportunity record, click the **+ Add Task** button. This action opens the full task creation form where you can enter all task details.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048628712/original/xXWceuxFIFjurCwDFWTM6E9_EMoh0zsckQ.png?1750429739)

### **Enter the Task Title**

Start by giving your task a clear and concise title in the *Title* field. This is a required field and helps identify the task easily when viewed in lists or filters.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048628830/original/QSdu8k7Wg6kC_j6C_UYJpkgd8JfMX6SB3Q.png?1750429830)

### **Add Task Description**

Click “Add description” to include more details about the task. Use this field to provide context, instructions, or important notes that help the assignee understand the objective.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048628967/original/swWxUXWry4nGt7DOkFuE5uSjj_yy9qk2Zw.png?1750429907)

### **Set Due Date and Time**

Use the calendar and time picker to select when the task should be completed. This helps structure deadlines and ensures accountability within your team.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048629128/original/us1Gox9eoYk2bXrOszqpP5hyeQcsnO3cmg.png?1750430001)

### **Select a Time for the Task**

Click the time dropdown to set when the task is due. You can choose the exact hour and minute to schedule task reminders with precision.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048629194/original/cWPjBYIX6yiJW-F_YPTSS7IM6DBd1jHd8A.png?1750430059)

### **Recurring Tasks**

To configure a recurring task, first toggle on the **Recurring tasks** option. Then use the **Repeats every** field to define how frequently the task should recur—for example, every X days, weeks, or months. Under **Ends on**, choose whether the task should repeat indefinitely (**Never**), stop on a specific date (**On**), or after a certain number of repetitions (**After**). You can also enable the option to **create a new task even if the previous task is overdue**, which ensures that the recurrence continues on schedule regardless of completion status. This setup is ideal for automating repetitive actions and maintaining consistent follow-up.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048629266/original/C37PxsvhdJsemfJLsoD279A1ltYFh_1FHw.png?1750430133)

### **Assign to a Team Member**

Use the **Assign to** dropdown to designate the task to a specific user. You’ll see a list of all team members associated with the account—select the appropriate person responsible for completing the task. Assigning tasks helps organize accountability and ensures clear ownership of follow-ups.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048629545/original/cv6NP791uQJV-9b5jEXgCE9jHAlZ1l0C3A.png?1750430309)

### **Save or Add Another Task**

Once your task details are complete, click **Save** to finalize and create the task, or choose **Save and Add Another** to quickly continue creating additional tasks. This dual-option approach helps streamline bulk task entry without having to reopen the form for every new entry.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048629630/original/oY2gbtnYs4H1eEKFcBB8UqBQb3-jKH4tLQ.png?1750430381)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is Unified Task Management available to all users?**

It must be manually enabled in Labs for each subaccount before it becomes accessible.

**Q: Can I return to the previous task system?**

Yes, you can disable the toggle in Labs to switch back to the earlier version.

**Q: Are my existing tasks affected?**

No. All current tasks are fully available in the unified interface with no data loss.

**Q: Can Recurring Tasks be created in both Contacts and Opportunities?**

Yes. Recurring task functionality is available across all records with task tabs.

**Q: Do these changes impact automation or workflows?**

No. The feature update applies only to the user interface and task management experience.

title_en: Preference Management (Email Unsubscription Management)
source_md:
Email Compliance

# Preference Management

Give contacts control over the types of marketing emails they want. Preference Management lets each location create subscription categories, link them to campaigns, and automatically honor opt-outs at a category level.

No Default Categories

For new configurations, HighLevel does **not** add a default "One-on-One" subscription type. Create the categories that fit your email program. Category names can be edited after creation and support up to **100 characters**.

## What is Preference Management?

Preference Management helps businesses stay compliant by honoring each contact's communication choices — both whether they want to receive emails, and what types of emails they prefer to receive. This reduces unwanted outreach, minimizes the risk of being marked as spam, and supports healthier email deliverability.

With Preference Management, each location can create and manage custom communication (preference) categories that align with its marketing needs. These categories can be linked directly to campaigns, enabling the system to automatically respect every contact's stated preferences.

When a contact opts out of a specific preference type, any future campaigns assigned to that category will automatically exclude them — even if they were part of the original campaign audience. This ensures more relevant messaging, stronger compliance, and a more personalized experience for every contact.

## Key Benefits of Preference Management

Compliance-First Communication

Automatically uphold opt-out decisions at a category level so every send respects contact choices.

Healthier Email Deliverability

Reduce spam complaints and unwanted messages, protecting your sender reputation over time.

Personalized Engagement

Send more relevant content aligned with stated contact preferences — not everyone wants every email.

Location-Level Customization

Each location defines its own communication categories based on its specific marketing strategy.

## Preference Types

Preference Types are the granular categories that are the foundation of Preference Management. Create up to 5 active subscription types per sub-account. To add a new one after that, archive an existing type first.

These categories live under **Settings → Preference Management Hub** and can be edited, disabled, or deleted at any time.

For step-by-step instructions on creating Preference Types, jump to [How to Setup Preference Management](#setup).

## Associating Preferences with Campaigns

Linking a campaign to a preference category tells the system **"why"** you're emailing. This allows HighLevel to filter audiences based on contact choices before delivery.

When a contact opts out of a category, they are automatically kept out of current and future sends for that category — even if the contact is still on your static list.

For instructions on linking preferences to a campaign, see [Step 2: Assign Preferences to Campaigns](#setup).

## Automatic Audience Filtering

If a contact has opted out of a specific preference type, they will be automatically excluded from any campaign assigned to that category — even if they were originally included in the campaign audience. This ensures accurate targeting and prevents unwanted emails from being sent.

Once preferences are set, the system will:

Auto-Exclude Conflicts

Automatically remove contacts from campaigns that conflict with their stated preferences.

Enforce Category Opt-Outs

Honor category-level opt-outs even if the contact appears in the original campaign audience.

## How to Setup Preference Management

Step 1

Create Preference Types

Preference Types are the subscription categories used to label your email programs — such as newsletters, promotions, or event updates.

### Go to the Preference Management Hub

Navigate to **Settings → Preference Management Hub** at the location level.

---

### Create a Subscription Type

Click **+ Create Subscription Type**.

![Create Subscription Type button in Preference Management Hub](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069370539/original/PDDXKYVeUCSICwiwZsTVGef5blmdYKYbIg.jpeg?1776423230)

---

### Enter the Subscription Name & Description

Enter a **Subscription Name** and **Description** for the category you want to use.

![Subscription Name and Description fields](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069370639/original/AMUNhi9OqkkPc4J7FmVZs4_K_eeQmsf0sQ.jpeg?1776423253)

---

### Use a Clear, Descriptive Name

Pick a name that recipients will understand. Subscription category names support up to **100 characters**.

---

### Save & Confirm

Save your changes and confirm the action when prompted.

---

### Repeat for Each Category

Repeat this process for each preference category you want to use.

Step 2

Assign Preferences to Campaigns

Assign a preference category to an email campaign from within the Email Builder. This enables the system to understand why the message is being sent and who should receive it.

### Open the Email Campaign

Open the Email Campaign you want to assign a Subscription Type to, then click **Send or Schedule**.

![Send or Schedule button in Email Builder](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063104565/original/9l87fXiGITv6B3IjFHwWi7tcGJMHSigQVg.png?1768940148)

---

### Select the Preference Type

Choose your desired **Preference Type** using the dropdown.

![Preference Type dropdown selection](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063104691/original/hbud_C6l1m-8DaK8ssIBg_KSlZolm-tGww.png?1768940415)

## Managing Preferences at the Contact Level

From the Contact Details Page, teams can view or manually adjust each contact's preferences for full transparency and control. To view or update preference settings for a contact, follow the steps below.

**Note:** When a preference status is updated at the contact level, HighLevel logs the update in Conversations so teams can review preference changes in context.

### Open the Contact's Subscription Status

Go to **Contacts** and select a contact. From the contact page, open the **DND** tab and click **Subscription Status**.

![Subscription Status option under DND tab](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063105524/original/xze7RqTAwaecNeurxEuUu9hORwD7JlmqWQ.png?1768942404)

---

### Set Each Preference Type

In the **Manage Email Subscriptions** popup, set each Preference Type to **Subscribed** or **Unsubscribed** as appropriate.

![Manage Email Subscriptions popup](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063105550/original/pwS5GCiH_5kST2ghuW_Dxvs05UkxYlsQnw.png?1768942495)

---

### Provide a Legal Basis to Resubscribe

For any preference category marked as **Unsubscribed**, the location **must provide a legal basis** before the contact can be resubscribed.

![Legal basis required to resubscribe a contact](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063105568/original/aHL8BCQPt9iodTMcK-8CYhGLIJ0BNuqOVQ.png?1768942528)

## Frequently Asked Questions

How does category opt-out relate to global unsubscribe?

Category opt-out suppresses only the selected topics. A **global unsubscribe** opts the user out from all marketing email from the location.

Can contacts manage their own preferences?

Yes. When Preference Management is enabled, the unsubscribe link includes a **"Manage your preferences"** link where contacts can manage their own category-level choices directly.

Do emails sent from workflows honor category preferences?

Yes. Automatic filtering removes contacts whose preferences conflict with the campaign's categories — regardless of how they were added to the audience.

What happens if all preference types are archived?

When all preference types are archived, Preference Management shows a guided **zero-state message** instead of an empty view — prompting you to create or restore a category.

Can Preference Management be turned off after enabling it?

**No.** Preference Management is irreversible once enabled. Because it introduces location-level unsubscribe controls, activation cannot be undone. Enable it only when you're ready to commit.

Is there a limit on how many Preference Types I can create?

Create up to 5 active subscription types per sub-account. To add a new one after that, archive an existing type first. Subscription category names support up to **100 characters** and can be edited after creation.

title_en: How to Create Polls in Community Posts
source_md:
Create polls directly in Community posts to collect feedback and encourage participation. HighLevel supports poll creation through the web Community experience, while GoKollab lets members create polls from the iOS and Android mobile app. Polls help members share their opinions without leaving the Community feed. This guide covers creating polls on web and mobile, configuring available voting settings, and viewing published polls.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Polls in Community Posts?](#What-are-Polls-in-Community-Posts?)
- [Key Benefits of Community Polls](#Key-Benefits-of-Community-Polls)
- [How to Create Polls in Community Posts](#How-To-Create-Polls-in-Community-Posts)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are Polls in Community Posts?**

Community Polls are interactive posts that let members vote on questions directly within HighLevel Communities. Polls keep feedback and discussions in one place, making it easier to gather opinions without directing members to an external survey or platform.

Polls are available through the HighLevel web Community experience and the GoKollab mobile app. Members can participate directly from Community posts, while poll creators can use available settings to manage voting and results.

**On the HighLevel web experience, Community Polls support:**

- 2 to 10 answer options.
- Single-select or multi-select voting.
- Optional result visibility for members.
- Optional poll end dates and times.
- Editing published polls to add answer options.

---

## **Key Benefits of Community Polls**

Community Polls help you collect feedback and encourage participation without moving conversations outside your Community. Members can respond directly to questions, while poll creators can configure voting options and manage results using the controls available in their interface.

- **Native posting:** Create polls directly within the Community post composer.
- **Flexible voting:** Allow members to select one or multiple answers, depending on the poll settings.
- **Controlled visibility:** Choose whether members can view poll results.
- **Timed engagement:** Set an end date and time to close voting automatically.
- **Easy updates:** Edit published polls and add answer options through the documented web experience.
- **Mobile poll creation:** Create polls directly from Community posts in the GoKollab mobile app, making it easier to collect feedback while away from your computer.

---

## **How to Create Polls in Community Posts**

You can create Community polls using HighLevel on the web or the GoKollab mobile app. Both experiences let you prepare a post, add poll answer choices, and publish the poll to a Community feed. Follow the instructions for the platform you use.

### **Create a Poll in HighLevel Communities (Web)**

The HighLevel web experience lets you create Community polls and configure answer options, voting preferences, result visibility, and closing times before publishing.

```
Note: The steps below describe the documented new Client Portal workflow. If your account uses the newer unified Communities Beta experience, the navigation may look different.
```

1. From the HighLevel Sub-Account view, select **Memberships** in the left-hand menu.
2. Under **Client Portal**, click **Try the new Client Portal** if the updated experience is not already enabled.
3. Select the checkbox and click **Enable for everyone**to make the updated experience available to members.  
     

   ![Enabling the new Client Portal experience](https://jumpshare.com/share/b327rMnyIuBREVYswNCF+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-22+at+18.31.55.gif)
4. From **Memberships**, select **Communities**, then open **Groups**.
5. Click **Login**for the Group where you want to publish the poll.  
     

   ![Opening a Community Group in HighLevel](https://jumpshare.com/share/hCeMzRWkux44JyvfI5Op+/Screenshot+2026-07-22+at+18.36.43.png)
6. Click **Create a post**.
7. Enter the post **Title** and **Description**.
8. Click **Poll** in the post composer.
9. Add your poll answer options.
10. Reorder or delete answer options as needed.
11. Turn on **Allow multiple answers** if members should be able to select more than one option.
12. Turn **Allow Members to See Results** on or off to control result visibility.
13. Configure the poll end date and time if you want voting to close automatically.
14. Review the poll and click **Post**to publish it to the Community feed.  
      

    ![Creating and publishing a Community poll on the web](https://jumpshare.com/share/g2X5TBBZWy5q6kIoDJlu+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-22+at+18.41.49.gif)

### **Create a Poll in the GoKollab Mobile App**

GoKollab members can create and publish polls directly from Community posts on iOS and Android. The mobile poll editor includes answer choices, voting settings, and publishing controls, allowing members to gather feedback without switching to the web experience.

1. Open the **GoKollab** mobile app and sign in using your Community credentials.
2. Select **Communities** from the bottom navigation.
3. Open the Community where you want to create a poll.
4. Start a new Community post to open the **Create post** screen.
5. Select the destination Community channel using the channel selector at the top of the post composer.
6. Enter the post title and the question or description you want members to respond to.
7. Open the **Create poll** panel from the post composer.
8. Add the answer choices that members can vote on.  
     

   ![GoKollab mobile poll editor showing answer choices](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084000401/original/UwxNC5ouyAoXNVwayZ-hvrd-KPX6WMLE9Q.png?1792690387)
9. Tap **Add option** to include more answer choices. Use the available reorder and delete controls to adjust the options as needed.
10. Review the available poll settings:  
      
    - **Allow multiple answers:** Let members select more than one answer.
    - **Allow members to see results:** Control whether members can view poll results.
    - **Set an end date:** Configure when voting should close.
11. Tap **Save** to save the poll settings and return to the post composer.
12. Review the post title, selected channel, and poll details. Tap **Post** in the upper-right corner to publish the poll.
13. Return to the Community feed and confirm that the poll appears in the intended channel. Review the poll question, answer choices, and displayed vote count.  
      

    ![Published GoKollab Community poll showing the selected channel, answer choices, and vote count](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083999430/original/YXAMwYExvIA2_umVy7bTHMtfvjmUSR4_8g.png?1792689155)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

The answers below describe the documented HighLevel web poll editor. Several voting settings are also visible in the GoKollab mobile editor, but controls and limits should be verified separately when using the mobile app.

**Q: How many options can I add to a poll?**

The HighLevel web poll editor supports between 2 and 10 answer options.

**Q: How long can each answer option be?**

Each answer option can contain up to 100 characters in the web editor.

**Q: Can members select more than one answer?**

Yes. Turn on **Allow multiple answers** to let members select multiple choices. This setting is available in the documented web editor and appears in the GoKollab mobile poll editor.

**Q: What happens when member result visibility is turned off?**

Members can still vote, but they cannot see vote counts or live percentages when results are hidden.

**Q: What happens when a poll reaches its end date?**

The poll is marked **Closed**, and members can no longer vote.

**Q: Can I edit a poll after publishing it?**

Yes. The documented web experience lets poll creators edit published polls and add new answer options.

**Q: Can members change their vote?**

Yes. Members may be prompted to confirm before changing their vote.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Communities - How to Manage Content](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000297)
- [How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000280)
- [Communities - How to Manage Members Inside Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000289)
- [Communities - Tagging Channels and Events in Posts/Comments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006288)

title_en: Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard
source_md:
The Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard gives businesses a clear view of outbound Voice AI performance in HighLevel. Use this dashboard to track call attempts, connected calls, call duration, triggered actions, sentiment trends, and detailed logs for outbound calls placed by AI agents.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard?](#What-is-the-Voice-AI-Outbound-Calling-Dashboard?%E2%80%8B)
- [Key Benefits of the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Voice-AI-Outbound-Calling-Dashboard%E2%80%8B)
- [Attempted Calls](#Attempted-Calls%E2%80%8B)
- [Connected Calls](#Connected-Calls%E2%80%8B)
- [Actions and Sentiment](#Actions-and-Sentiment%E2%80%8B)
- [Call Status Distribution](#Call-Status-Distribution%E2%80%8B)
- [Detailed Call Logs](#Detailed-Call-Logs%E2%80%8B)
- [How To Use the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard](#How-To-Use-the-Voice-AI-Outbound-Calling-Dashboard%E2%80%8B)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%E2%80%8B)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)
- [SEO Information](#SEO-Information)

---

# **What is the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard?**

The Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard is an analytics view inside HighLevel that helps businesses review outbound AI call performance. It brings the same clean reporting experience from the inbound Voice AI dashboard into a dashboard built specifically for outbound calls.

The dashboard tracks every outbound call attempt, including connected calls, no-answer calls, voicemail outcomes, and failed calls. It also includes performance tiles, trend charts, sentiment insights, triggered action reporting, and detailed call logs so teams can understand how outbound Voice AI campaigns are performing.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard**

The outbound dashboard helps businesses quickly understand campaign performance, identify call outcome trends, and confirm which workflows are generating outbound call activity.

- **Complete Call Visibility:** Track every outbound call attempt, including connected, no-answer, voicemail, and failed calls.
- **Connected Call Insights:** View total connected calls along with total and average call duration.
- **Performance Trend Tracking:** Review outbound calling performance across month, week, and year trend charts.
- **Action Monitoring:** See how often outbound calls trigger actions inside HighLevel.
- **Sentiment Analysis:** Review positive, neutral, and negative sentiment trends from outbound conversations.
- **Workflow Attribution:** Use the Workflow Name column to identify which workflow initiated each outbound call.
- **Detailed Call Review:** Access call status, recordings, transcripts, duration, and source workflow details from the call logs.

---

## **Attempted Calls**

Attempted Calls show the total number of outbound calls Voice AI tried to place. This includes all outbound call outcomes, not only successful conversations.

Attempted call outcomes may include:

- Connected
- No Answer
- Voicemail
- Failed

Use the Attempted Calls tile to understand total outbound dialing volume and campaign reach. This helps teams confirm whether outbound workflows are running as expected and whether the campaign is generating the expected number of call attempts.

---

## **Connected Calls**

Connected Calls show how many outbound calls successfully reached a recipient or voicemail destination. This view helps teams understand how many outbound attempts resulted in an actual connection.

Connected call reporting includes:

- Total connected calls
- Total call duration
- Average call duration
- Month, week, and year trend charts

Use connected call data to measure conversation volume, review call duration patterns, and identify changes in outbound performance over time.

---

## **Actions and Sentiment**

Actions and Sentiment help businesses understand what happened during and after outbound Voice AI calls. These insights mirror the inbound Voice AI dashboard experience while focusing on outbound call activity.

The dashboard can show:

- **Actions Triggered:** Tracks actions completed during or after outbound calls.
- **Sentiment Analysis:** Displays sentiment trends from outbound conversations, such as positive, neutral, or negative outcomes.

Use these insights to confirm outbound workflows are triggering correctly and to identify opportunities to improve agent prompts, call flows, and follow-up actions.

---

## **Call Status Distribution**

Call Status Distribution shows how outbound call attempts are split across different outcomes. This helps teams quickly understand whether calls are connecting, going to voicemail, receiving no answer, or failing.

Common call statuses include:

- **Connected:** The outbound call reached the contact or recipient endpoint.
- **Voicemail:** The call reached a voicemail box.
- **No Answer:** The call was placed but not answered.
- **Failed:** The call could not be completed.

Use this chart to identify patterns in call outcomes and decide whether call timing, contact lists, caller ID setup, or workflow targeting may need adjustment.

---

## **Detailed Call Logs**

Detailed Call Logs provide a clear record of every outbound call attempt. This makes it easier to review call outcomes, troubleshoot failed calls, and understand which workflow started each call.

Outbound call logs may include columns such as:

- Call Status
- Workflow Name
- Contact details
- Date and time
- Duration
- Recording
- Transcript

The **Call Status** column identifies the result of the outbound attempt, such as Connected, Voicemail, No Answer, or Failed.

The **Workflow Name** column shows which workflow initiated the outbound call. This is especially useful when multiple workflows use outbound Voice AI and teams need to trace call activity back to the correct automation.

---

## **How To Use the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard**

The outbound dashboard gives teams a centralized place to review outbound AI call performance. Checking the dashboard regularly helps confirm campaigns are running properly and gives teams the data they need to improve workflows.

1. Log in to the desired HighLevel sub-account.
2. Go to **AI Agents**.
3. Open the **Voice AI** tab.
4. Select **Dashboard & Logs**.
5. Click **Outbound**.
6. Use the agent and date filters to narrow the dashboard results.
7. Review the dashboard tiles for attempted calls, connected calls, actions triggered, and sentiment.
8. Review the call status distribution chart for connected, voicemail, no-answer, and failed call outcomes.
9. Use the lower summary tiles to compare call outcomes against the previous month.
10. Open the call logs to review individual outbound call attempts when needed.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073605631/original/W7Vvo8Ppk8tMJankXuAOTrfizfX9wMIMtw.png?1781386956)**  
This screenshot shows where to access the outbound dashboard from **AI Agents > Voice AI > Dashboard & Logs > Outbound**, along with the main performance tiles and call status distribution chart.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What does the Voice AI Outbound Calling Dashboard show?**  
A: It shows outbound Voice AI performance, including attempted calls, connected calls, call duration, triggered actions, sentiment trends, call status distribution, and detailed call logs.

**Q: What counts as an attempted call?**  
A: Attempted calls include every outbound call Voice AI tries to place, including connected calls, no-answer calls, voicemail outcomes, and failed calls.

**Q: What does the Connected Calls tile track?**  
A: Connected Calls tracks total connected calls, total call duration, average call duration, and performance trends by month, week, and year.

**Q: What does Call Status mean in the call logs?**  
A: Call Status shows the outcome of the outbound call attempt. Common statuses include Connected, Voicemail, No Answer, and Failed.

**Q: What is the Workflow Name column used for?**  
A: Workflow Name shows which workflow initiated the outbound Voice AI call. This helps teams connect call activity back to the correct automation.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Voice AI Agents Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004693)
- [Inbound Call Flow for Voice AI Calls](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003431)
- [Test Call Logs Visible in Voice AI Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005211)

title_en: Social Planner - Link Shortener
source_md:
Shorten long URLs and track link performance directly in HighLevel Social Planner. The Link Shortener helps you create cleaner social media posts, add campaign tracking parameters, and monitor link clicks.

This guide explains how to generate shortened links and review their performance.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Link Shortener?](#What-is-the-Link-Shortener?)
- [Key Benefits of the Link Shortener](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Link-Shortener)
- [How to Use the Link Shortener in Social Planner](#How-to-Use-the-Link-Shortener-in-Social-Planner)
- [Important Considerations](#Important-Considerations)
- [Link Tracking in Social Planner Statistics](#Link-Tracking-in-Social-Planner-Statistics)
  - [Link Click Analytics](#Link-Click-Analytics)
  - [Campaign Tracking](#Campaign-Tracking)
  - [Filters & Sorting](#Filters-&-Sorting)
  - [Quick URL Preview](#Quick-URL-Preview)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is the Link Shortener?**

The Link Shortener is a built-in Social Planner feature that converts long URLs into shorter links for published posts. It also supports UTM parameters and link-click tracking, helping you measure the performance of your social media campaigns.

This functionality helps improve the overall readability and visual appeal of your social content, especially when sharing URLs from blogs, landing pages, or external websites.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Link Shortener**

Shortened links make social media posts easier to read while providing valuable insights into campaign performance.

- **Clean posts:** Keeps social posts uncluttered by shortening long URLs.
- **Better experience:** Improves user experience with concise, easy-to-read links.
- **Auto-shortening:** Automatically generates a shortened version of any long URL.
- **Post preview:** Shows how the final post will look with the shortened link.
- **Cross-platform support:** Works across all connected social platforms in Social Planner.

---

## **How to Use the Link Shortener in Social Planner**

This step-by-step guide shows how to use the Link Shortener while composing social media posts:

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner** from the left-hand menu. Click on + **New Post > + Create New Post**button.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084847402/original/3rpPZPoJWf-6khzk-JU2LOvxoB2xKbb-Sw.png?1793713128)
2. In the **post composer**, select the social media accounts where you’d like to publish the post.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084847445/original/Rf-gse8gQTvAsJNRE_csQkXRR_EbXoXnpg.png?1793713155)
3. In the **Content** input box, add your content.
4. Click the **URL Shortener** icon located next to the content editor.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084847496/original/Wg28Cc2_yf0d7xqZ89NwVUJkSCljiTPAKg.png?1793713207)
5. Add **Name of the Link** & **Target URL**.
6. Setup **Tracking** **Details**:  
     
   - UTM Campaign (utm\_campaign) - select or create a campaign.
   - Add Custom UTM Parameters like source, campaign, etc.
7. Click on **Generate and Insert Link** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/FwmggfzC0ZzUxkhb5QCH+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-02+at+9.18.40+PM.gif)
8. Once inserted:   
     
   - The **preview pane** will show a shortened version of the URL.
   - The **input field** will still display the original long URL.
9. Review your post, and then choose **Publish** or **Schedule** to send it out at a later time.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084847847/original/2uhZ5TwoprJoLWYR6Apt4Wq471t1Gqm-IA.png?1793713375)

---

## **Important Considerations**

Understanding how shortened links and tracking parameters work helps ensure accurate campaign reporting.

- **Supported Links:** Native URL Tracking is available for supported shortened links generated through Social Planner.
- **UTM Parameters:** UTM tags identify campaign traffic in compatible analytics tools. They are separate from Social Planner's click tracking.
- **Automatic Short URLs:** Shortened URLs are generated automatically and cannot currently be manually customized.
- **Link Preview:** The original URL remains in the editor, but the shortened link appears in the published post.
- **External Shorteners:** Third-party shortened links can be added manually, but they are not covered by Social Planner's native URL Tracking.
- **Conversion Tracking:** Link clicks do not automatically measure leads, purchases, or other website conversions.

---

## **Link Tracking in Social Planner Statistics**

Social Planner provides Link level performance analytics directly inside the Statistics page. This means that in addition to shortening links inside your posts, you can now track how those links perform after publishing.

The Link Shortener continues to shorten long URLs in your post preview and final published post. With URL Tracking, you can:

- Shortened links and long URLs both appear in your performance analytics
- Every link you publish becomes trackable automatically
- You do **not** need to do anything extra for click tracking, it starts as soon as the post goes live
- Campaign Names help you group multiple posts that share the same link

```
Note: Only the link created via Social Planner will be displayed in the statistics page.
```

### **L****ink Click Analytics**

Every URL you share through Social Planner is now measurable. You can track:

- Total clicks on each shortened or original URL
- Platform-wise performance (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)
- Trends over time

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064027182/original/lYr6EJeFMIR9LndS7JUG-HORObUbEW2T3w.jpeg?1770059860)

### **Campaign Tracking**

When composing a post, you can assign a **Campaign Name** to your link. All posts using that same link + campaign are grouped together in analytics, helping you compare and understand performance across posts and channels.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064027201/original/t5C3wqeoszEUkOxb9jxesYmINTVc4l04dQ.png?1770059904)

### **Filters & Sorting**

Inside **Marketing → Social Planner → Statistics → URL Tracking**, you can now filter Top performing and low performing.

### **Quick URL Preview**

Selecting any URL will show a preview panel so you can see exactly which link you are analysing.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will my social post show the long or short link?**

The published post will display the shortened link. The long URL is only visible to you in the content editor.

**Q: Why UTMs matter when using a shortener?**

When you use a link shortener **without** UTMs:

- Analytics might just show traffic as “direct” or generic “referral”
- You can’t easily distinguish performance between:

  - Facebook ad vs. Facebook organic post
  - Email header link vs. footer link
  - One influencer vs. another

When you use a link shortener **with** UTMs:

- You can:

  - Track campaigns properly in GA/other tools
  - Compare performance of different channels and creatives
  - Prove which specific link/placement is working

The shortener makes the long UTM-heavy URL look clean and clickable, but the UTM tags do the important reporting work.

**Q: Can I customize or rename the short link?**

Not yet. The short links are currently auto-generated and not editable.

**Q: Does the Link Shortener work on all social platforms?**

Yes, the shortened link will appear across all social platforms supported in Social Planner, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and more.

**Q: Can I still use my own external link shorteners like Bitly?**

Yes, you can manually add shortened links from third-party services if preferred.

---

- [Social Planner - Track Social Performance Using Advance Analytics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004101)
- [Social Planner - Discover Trends with Social Listening](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006434)

title_en: Dashboards: Custom Object Widgets and Insights
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/H6DvNG-dIh8?&wmode=opaque)

Unlock deeper reporting by visualizing your Custom Objects directly inside HighLevel dashboards. Custom Object Widgets turn your unique data—pets, properties, cases, projects and more into real‑time charts that anyone on your team can explore. Build KPIs that standard CRM objects can’t cover, style them to your brand, and share insights securely across your organization.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Custom Object Widget?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-a-Custom-Object-Widget?)
- [Key Benefits of Custom Object Widgets](#Key-Benefits-of-Custom-Object-Widgets)
- [Metrics & Chart Types](#Metrics-&-Chart-Types)
- [Permissions & Sharing](#Permissions-&-Sharing)
- [How To Set Up Custom Object Widgets](#How-To-Set-Up-Custom-Object-Widgets)
  - [1) Insert a Custom Object Widget into a dashboard](#1)-Insert-a-Custom-Object-Widget-into-a-dashboard)
  - [2) Insert a Custom Object Widget into a custom report](#2)-Insert-a-Custom-Object-Widget-into-a-custom-report)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is a Custom Object Widget?**

Custom Object Widgets let you add charts that reference the Custom Objects you create in Sub‑Account Settings. Because every business tracks unique data, these widgets transform non‑standard records (for example, “Pets,” “Properties,” “Cases”) into totals and averages you can filter, style, and reuse across dashboards.

---

## **Key Benefits of Custom Object Widgets**

Custom Object Widgets are designed to surface the KPIs that matter most to your business, even when your data lives outside standard CRM objects.

- **Tailored analytics:** Build metrics for the unique records you track (for example, Avg. Pet Age).
- **Centralized reporting:** Mix Contact, Opportunity, and Custom Object metrics on the same dashboard.
- **Flexible charting:** Switch among Numeric, Line, Bar, Horizontal Bar, Donut, or Table to fit your story.
- **Reusable filters:** Apply dashboard Quick Filters or widget-level filters without changing the original widget view.
- **Secure sharing:** Respect existing dashboard permission tiers so only the right users can view or edit widgets.

---

## **Metrics & Chart Types**

Understanding what you can measure and how you can visualize it helps you choose the right chart for the question at hand.

- **Metrics available for Custom Object Widgets:** Count, Sum, Average.
- **Supported chart types (dashboard taxonomy):** Numeric, Table, Bar, Horizontal Bar, Line, Donut.
- A recommended chart type is pre-selected when you add a widget, and you can change it at any time from the chart picker.
- Tables can display multiple fields as columns; charts can use eligible fields for grouping where supported.

---

## **Permissions & Sharing**

Govern who can view, filter, or edit widgets using the same permission tiers that control your dashboards.

- Dashboard **VIEW/EDIT/FULL/NO ACCESS** roles continue to apply to Custom Object Widgets.
- Editors can change chart type, metrics, filters, and theme; viewers can interact with Quick Filters.
- Use the three‑dot menu on a widget to **Duplicate** or further configure it without affecting the original.

*Suggested reads: [Manage Dashboard Permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/hc/en-us/search?query=Manage%20Dashboard%20Permissions), [Duplicating Widgets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/hc/en-us/search?query=Duplicating%20Widgets).*

---

## **How To Set Up Custom Object Widgets**

Getting set up is fast once your Custom Object exists. Proper setup ensures your fields are available for metrics, grouping, and filters, so your widgets answer the right questions the first time.

Before adding any widgets, **make sure your Custom Object is created**. For step‑by‑step instructions, see **[Creating and Editing Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003897-creating-and-editing-custom-objects)**

### **1) Insert a Custom Object Widget into a dashboard**

1. In your **Sub-Account**, navigate to the Dashboard and click the blue button in the top-left corner to open the desired dashboard.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786184/original/mKur0JVvJDqKuXfBFECi02REs4EkBtcPhQ.png?1760246447)
2. Click **Edit** (pencil icon) → **Add Widget**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786196/original/VADVTrGEzJ3UcAPMVoeYUv7LIwwatHonug.gif?1760246487)
3. Choose your preferred chart type (Numeric, Donut, Line, Bar, or Table), then scroll to the Custom Objects (Example: Dogs) category and select your desired metric or Top Campaigns widget.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786217/original/Una6aORTCDgc7NkNLV48OPr30VhYdDtufg.png?1760246611)
4. Apply filters (campaign, metric, date range) or switch theme/colors.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786231/original/q3BatzHNdkipD9hsmGv5X-QKfg6Ig5HZIQ.png?1760246691)
5. Click **Save**. The widget begins streaming ad data.

### **2) Insert a Custom Object Widget into a custom report**

1. In your **Sub-Account,**Go to **Reports → Custom Reports** and open an existing report or click **Create Report**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786251/original/BFj9ZABgpGvBo2gbWPNXaKcV4DAW3yuJrA.png?1760246761)
2. Choose to **start from a blank canvas**, **use a template**, or **import an existing dashboard layout**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786262/original/VCV1S5rz7-6bAUZuMpXNJTX-0WFhxrSjNQ.png?1760246859)
3. Click **Add Widget/Element** (top-left). In the widget list, find **Custom Objects** widgets (Example: Dogs) and **drag** the ones you want into the layout.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786297/original/bPOZ1dqXuH7OnDQ3frf6Kc9EewYMeQQRYg.png?1760247108)
4. Configure each widget: **chart type**, **filters**, and **theme** to suit your needs and Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786303/original/ZVr8x3CtEQDrRp2TaAx1r-mV6BwgUIUzjQ.png?1760247170)
5. Click on Send or Schedule to set up an **email schedule** to receive the report automatically.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055786314/original/tEDjP9NHc13gOrGWrVtNg-Ee-7C71ILbOg.png?1760247267)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How many Custom Objects can I create?**  
Up to **ten** Custom Objects per location (sub‑account). Each object can be used in widgets.

**Q: Which plans support Custom Objects and dashboards?**  
Custom Objects, Dashboards & Custom Reports are Now Available on All Plans

**Q: Can I duplicate a Custom Object Widget?**  
Yes. Use the **three‑dot menu → Duplicate** to copy the configuration and tweak as needed.

**Q: Can I group by a picklist field from my Custom Object?**  
When a chart or table supports grouping and your object includes eligible select fields, you can group by those fields. Availability varies by chart type.

**Q: Why does my widget show “No data”?**  
**A:** Check that your Custom Object has records, that you selected an eligible metric/field, that the date range (if used) includes your data, and that filters or Quick Filters aren’t excluding everything.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Creating & Editing Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003897-creating-and-editing-custom-objects)
- [How to Create a Custom Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001531-how-to-create-a-custom-dashboard)
- [Quick Filters on Dashboards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004503-quick-filters-on-dashboards)
- [How to Customize Dashboard Themes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003966-how-to-customize-dashboard-themes)
- [Duplicating widgets on a dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004492-duplicating-widgets-on-a-dashboard)
- [How To Manage Dashboard Permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/hc/en-us/search?query=Manage%20Dashboard%20Permissions)
