title_en: Workflow Trigger - Contact Tag
source_md:
#### This article explains the Contact Tag Workflow Trigger in HighLevel, detailing how it can automate workflows when tags are added or removed from a contact. Learn how to set it up, explore advanced use cases, and troubleshoot common issues.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Contact Tag Workflow Trigger?](#What-is-the-Contact-Tag-Workflow-Trigger?)
- [Key Benefits of Using Contact Tag Triggers](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-Contact-Tag-Triggers%E2%80%8B)
- [How to Set Up the Contact Tag Trigger](#How-to-Set-Up-the-Contact-Tag-Trigger%E2%80%8B)
- [Advanced Use Cases](#Advanced-Use-Cases%E2%80%8B)
- [Common Errors and Troubleshooting](#Common-Errors-and-Troubleshooting%E2%80%8B)
- [Cross-References to Related Articles](#Cross-References-to-Related-Articles%E2%80%8B)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is the Contact Tag Workflow Trigger?**

The Contact Tag Workflow Trigger allows you to automate workflows in HighLevel whenever a contact tag is added or removed. Tags are labels you assign to contacts to help you organize, categorize, and take action based on their attributes or behavior.

For example, adding a "New Customer" tag can trigger an automated welcome email, while removing a "Lead" tag can update sales team notifications.

---

## **Key Benefits of Using Contact Tag Triggers**

## 

1. **Automation:** Streamlines your workflow by automating actions based on tags.
2. **Organization:** Helps maintain a clean, actionable database of contacts.
3. **Targeted Engagement:** Allows you to segment customers and deliver personalized messaging.
4. **Scalability:** Works seamlessly across campaigns, pipelines, and multiple teams.

---

## **How to Set Up the Contact Tag Trigger**

1. **Access the Workflow Builder**

   - Navigate to **Automations** in HighLevel and select **Workflows**.  
       
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037662887/original/1Bxp7u95i5b_phIz0Xqr_PmZ66aMhQEIMw.jpeg?1733230581)
   - Click **Create Workflow** and choose a blank workflow or a template  
       
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037664252/original/htJeRsxvsvZ6R13My3rlsZdJr93DA2xqrA.png?1733231469)
2. **Add the Trigger**

   - In the workflow builder, click **Add Trigger** and search for **Contact Tag**.  
       
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037665913/original/4wpXAsdOM4pHDZZisVgkicn2A5VkAhTsvw.jpeg?1733232531)
   - # Workflow Trigger Name: Give your trigger a descriptive name, like “Tag Added - Interested.”
   - Select whether the workflow should be triggered by a tab being **Added** or **Removed.**  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037666266/original/eOGmDLoVhCbryaeavyziVMk-SXJeepc9Jg.jpeg?1733232715)  
       
     **Note:** In the contact tag selector, selecting or deselecting tags does not apply changes until you confirm them (for example, by clicking Apply). Workflows using the Contact Tag trigger fire after the tag update is actually applied.
   - Specify the Tag: Choose the tag (e.g., “Interested,” “Newsletter Subscriber”) that will activate the trigger.  
       
       

     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037255252/original/NMLa1ip5dNjC6rJ7N_-GfPVdiKoZfluOGw.png?1732636379)
   - Add New Tag : You can use **"+ Add New Tag"** option to instantly create a new tag from scratch and start using the tag right there in the workflow you are creating.  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037255317/original/Lc3pJmx6ih2O3iVGk7JFI6bo7foZ9FRa-Q.png?1732636410)
3. **Define Tags**

   - Add the specific tag(s) that will trigger this workflow.
   - Use clear, consistent naming conventions (e.g., "VIP Customer" or "Cold Lead").
4. **Add Workflow Actions**

   - After setting the trigger, configure the actions you want the workflow to perform. Common actions include:  
       
     - Sending an email or SMS.
     - Assigning tasks to team members.
     - Updating the contact's pipeline stage.
5. **Save and Test**

   - Save the workflow and test it by tagging a contact to ensure the desired actions are triggered.  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037672086/original/akYVKwQP298jqA2r-tezPS1HXuVthUAl3g.png?1733235531)

---

### **Example Use Cases**

# Actions for Tag Added Send an Email or SMS: Example: When the “Interested” tag is added, send a follow-up email: Subject: “Thank You for Your Interest!” Body: Hi {{contact.first\_name}}, Thank you for showing interest in our services. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out! Best regards, [Your Company Name] Notify Your Team: Send an internal notification to your sales team: “A new contact tagged as ‘Interested’ needs follow-up. Contact details: {{contact.details}}.”

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037274442/original/IOVwa25hHMQAIIvQqTHcn9nE2mTljO8prg.jpeg?1732674226)

# Actions for Tag Removed Send a Re-Engagement Email or SMS: Example: When the “Newsletter Subscriber” tag is removed, send this message: “Hi {{contact.first\_name}}, we’ve processed your unsubscribe request. If this was a mistake, click here to rejoin.” Ask for Feedback: Send a survey or feedback request to understand why the tag was removed.

---

### **Advanced Use Cases**

1. **Combining Multiple Triggers**

   - Use "Contact Created" and "Contact Tag" triggers together to welcome new leads and assign them to specific sales teams.
2. *Flowchart Example: Contact Created ➔ Tag Added ➔ Workflow Triggered.*
3. **Dynamic Customer Segmentation**

   - Automatically update tags based on customer behavior (e.g., purchases, website visits) to personalize marketing campaigns

---

### **Common Errors and Troubleshooting**

- **Duplicate Tags:** Ensure tags are unique and descriptive to avoid confusion in workflows.
- **Inactive Workflow:** Double-check that your workflow is published and active.
- **Missing Actions:** Verify that all actions linked to the trigger are correctly configured.
- **Overlapping Workflows:** Avoid setting up multiple workflows with the same trigger to prevent unintended actions.

---

### **Cross-References to Related Articles**

- Standard Triggers - Contact Tag
- A List of Workflow Triggers
- Action - Add Contact Tag
- Workflow Trigger - Contact Changed
- Workflow Trigger - Contact Created

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can tags trigger workflows retroactively?**  
No, tags trigger workflows only when they are added or removed after the workflow is active.

**Q: How do I manage a large number of tags?**  
Use clear naming conventions and periodically review your tags to remove duplicates or inactive tags.

**Q: What happens if multiple workflows use the same tag as a trigger?**  
All workflows with the same trigger will activate simultaneously. Plan triggers carefully to avoid unintended overlaps.

**Q: Can tags be used across multiple automations?**  
Yes, tags can be used in various workflows, campaigns, and pipeline stages for seamless integration.

title_en: Typeform – Actions & Triggers in Workflows
source_md:
## **1. Introduction**

The **Typeform integration** in HighLevel enables seamless automation between your CRM workflows and Typeform’s interactive form platform. Whether you’re capturing leads, collecting survey data, or tracking customer feedback, this integration connects Typeform submissions directly with HighLevel automations — ensuring instant data sync and workflow execution.

### **Why It Matters**

With this integration, agencies, marketers, and businesses can:

- Automatically capture and use Typeform responses in HighLevel workflows.
- Create personalized follow-ups, CRM entries, or notifications based on new submissions.
- Save time by automating repetitive data-entry and response-handling tasks.

---

## **2. Triggers and Actions**

### **Triggers (Typeform → HighLevel)**

These are events in **Typeform** that can initiate workflows inside **HighLevel**.

| **Trigger Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **New Entry** ⚡ Instant | Fires instantly when a new response is submitted in Typeform. |

> ? *This is an instant trigger — meaning HighLevel captures new form submissions in real time as soon as they occur.*

---

### **Actions (HighLevel → Typeform)**

These are actions that **HighLevel** can execute in **Typeform** through workflows.

| **Action Name** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Create Empty Form** | Create a new blank form in Typeform. |
| **Duplicate Existing Form** | Make a copy of an existing form, preserving its structure and questions. |
| **Search Responses In A Form** | Search for and retrieve existing responses from a selected Typeform form. |

> ? *These are premium actions and are billed according to HighLevel’s standard action pricing.*

---

## **3. Getting Started**

Follow these steps to start using Typeform triggers and actions in your workflows:

1. **Search in Workflows**

   - Open your HighLevel **workflow builder**.
   - Search for “Typeform” in the trigger or action menu.
2. **Connect Your Typeform Account**

   - If your Typeform account is already connected, you’ll see configuration options right away.
   - If not, click **Connect Now** and complete the OAuth setup to link your Typeform account.
3. **Alternative Method**

   - You can also connect from **Settings → Integrations**.
   - Locate **Typeform** and complete the authorization process.

Once connected, you can seamlessly add Typeform triggers or actions to your automation workflows.

---

## **4. How Typeform Triggers Work**

Typeform triggers rely on webhooks through the Typeform API. When a new entry (form submission) occurs, HighLevel instantly receives that data and triggers the defined workflow.

### **Setup Instructions:**

1. Choose the trigger **New Entry (Instant)**.
2. Select the form you want to connect.
3. Click **Test Trigger** — HighLevel will fetch a sample entry to map fields.
4. Map the Typeform fields (e.g., name, email, responses) to HighLevel workflow variables.

---

## **5. Common Use Cases**

Use Case 1: Create Tasks and Notify Team from Typeform Submissions  
**Goal**: Automatically create a ClickUp task, update the contact field, and send an internal notification when someone submits a Typeform entry.

- **Workflow Setup:****Trigger**: Typeform → New Entry (Instant)
- **Filter:** Form Name = “Client Onboarding Form”
- **Actions:**
  - Create Task (ClickUp)
  - Update Contact Field (HighLevel)
  - Send Internal Notification (HighLevel)

**Example:**A new client fills out your “Client Onboarding Form” in Typeform. Instantly, a ClickUp task is created with the client’s details, their contact field in HighLevel is updated with the latest information, and your internal team receives a notification to begin the onboarding process.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055323343/original/ax9fOQv54xWP3-d6xfAkPdtrk3U0m4cICA.png?1759755610)

---

Use Case 2: Create Conditional Tasks and Send Notifications from Typeform Submissions  
**Goal**: Automatically create a new document, check form response values, and trigger different follow-up actions based on the number of items submitted in a Typeform entry.

**Workflow Setup:**

- **Trigger**: Typeform → New Entry (Instant)
- **Filter**: Form Name = “Order Submission Form”
- **Actions**:
  - Create New Document (ClickUp)
  - Condition: Check if “total\_items” equals “3”
  - Branch (If True):
    - Update Contact Field (HighLevel)
    - Send Internal Notification (HighLevel)
    - Send Email (HighLevel)
  - Branch (If False):
    - End Workflow

**Example**:  
A customer submits an order through your “Order Submission Form” on Typeform. The workflow creates a new document in ClickUp with their order details. If the customer ordered exactly three items, the contact record in HighLevel is updated, the operations team is notified internally, and a confirmation email is sent to the customer. If the total items are not three, the workflow ends without additional actions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055323302/original/b2WKgCzFdxO7advNUh3c79jk2ibGVSPT3w.png?1759755600)

---

Use Case 3: Automate Document Creation and Notifications on Pipeline Stage Change  
**Goal**: Automatically check for existing form responses when a deal’s pipeline stage changes, create or duplicate documents accordingly, and notify the team or contact based on the outcome.

**Workflow Setup:**

- **Trigger**: Pipeline Stage Changed (HighLevel CRM)
- **Filter**: Pipeline = “Client Onboarding Pipeline”
- **Actions**:
  - Search Responses in a Form (Typeform)
  - **Branch**(Responses Found):
    - Create New Document (ClickUp)
    - Update Contact Field (HighLevel)
    - Send Internal Notification (HighLevel)
    - Send Email (HighLevel)
  - **Branch**(Responses Not Found):
    - Duplicate Existing Form (Typeform)
    - Send Internal Notification (HighLevel)
    - Send Email (HighLevel)

**Example**:  
When a deal moves to the “Onboarding” stage in your CRM pipeline, the workflow searches for existing Typeform responses linked to the client.

- If a response is found, a new document is created in ClickUp with the client’s data, their contact record is updated, and both your team and the client are notified.
- If no response is found, a new copy of the onboarding form is created for the client to fill out, followed by an internal notification to your team and an email prompt sent to the client.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055323932/original/uJjeoYxQqm7oxf0OKT3u8c6BbwoBF4PRjA.png?1759755870)

---

## **6. FAQs**

**Q: Do I need a paid Typeform account to use this integration?**  
A: No. The integration works with both free and paid Typeform accounts. However, certain features (like response limits or branding removal) depend on your Typeform plan.

**Q: Is this integration available to all HighLevel users?**  
A: Yes, it’s available to all accounts that have access to **workflows** and **integrations**.

**Q: Are these actions and triggers premium?**  
A: Yes. The Typeform trigger and actions are premium and billed at the standard rate per execution.

**Q: How fast does the trigger respond?**  
A: The **New Entry** trigger is *instant*, meaning data flows to your workflow within seconds of a Typeform submission.

title_en: Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/FBbSIexn6G8?&wmode=opaque)

Keep your Conversation AI bot accurate without the busywork. Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links lets HighLevel automatically re-crawl and retrain your web URL sources on a daily, weekly, or monthly cadence—so customer answers stay current while your team focuses on higher-value work. Configure it once, then monitor statuses and logs from a single table view.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Auto-Refresh-of-Knowledge-Base-Trained-Links?)
- [Key Benefits of Auto Refresh](#Key-Benefits-of-Auto-Refresh)
- [Setting the Refresh Frequency](#Setting-the-Refresh-Frequency)
- [Monitoring Refresh Status & Logs](#Monitoring-Refresh-Status-&-Logs)
- [How To Setup Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links](#How-To-Setup-Auto-Refresh-of-Knowledge-Base-Trained-Links)
- [Best Practices for a Healthy Knowledge Base](#Best-Practices-for-a-Healthy-Knowledge-Base)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links?**

Auto Refresh is a feature in HighLevel that schedules automatic re-training of the web URLs you’ve added to your Knowledge Base. Instead of manually clicking **Refresh** for each URL, HighLevel periodically re-crawls the pages, updates the table data, and re-indexes the fresh content your bot relies on. This ensures your bot can reference up-to-date product pages, help docs, and blog articles without manual maintenance.

Auto Refresh removes the need for recurring manual updates and reduces the risk of outdated answers. By continuously syncing your Knowledge Base URLs on a schedule, the feature helps your bot deliver consistent, reliable responses drawn from the most recent source material.

---

## **Key Benefits of Auto Refresh**

Understanding the benefits helps you decide the right cadence and scope. These advantages focus on accuracy, time savings, and operational visibility, especially for teams managing many links across multiple sub-accounts.

- **Always-current answers:** Ensures the bot uses the latest content for higher accuracy and reliability.
- **Time savings at scale:** Reduces manual refresh work, especially when managing many URLs across sub-accounts.
- **Fewer outdated responses:** Prevents stale instructions, prices, or policies from reaching customers.
- **Lower risk of human error:** Automates repetitive refresh tasks so one missed click doesn’t leave sources stale.
- **Predictable scheduling:** Choose Daily, Weekly, or Monthly cadences to match your content update rhythm.
- **Load management:** Stagger refreshes to avoid peak-time crawling and manage performance on large sites.

---

## **Setting the Refresh Frequency**

Scheduling controls how often HighLevel automatically re-crawls your URLs. Choose a frequency that aligns with how frequently your source content updates and the size of your URL library.

Click the **Auto Refresh** icon (circular arrows) and select your preferred schedule:

- **Daily:** Refreshes approximately every 24 hours.
- **Weekly:** Refreshes on the same weekday you select.
- **Monthly:** Refreshes on the same calendar day each month.

---

## **Monitoring Refresh Status & Logs**

Visibility into each crawl cycle helps you validate that refreshes are working and quickly resolve errors that would otherwise leave stale content in place.

The **Status** column reflects the current state of each URL:

- **Getting Data:** HighLevel is actively re-crawling the page.
- **Trained:** The latest data was saved; check **Last data refreshed at** for the timestamp.
- **Failed:** The crawl encountered an error; retry the refresh or review page accessibility.

---

## **How To Setup Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links**

A reliable setup ensures refreshes run on time and your bot benefits from the latest content. Complete these steps in order to avoid missed schedules.

1. From your **Sub-Account**, go to **AI Agents → Knowledge Base**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055725754/original/PSVZrFEy8yFUbFvJzLXMef6rvJljZrSlWA.png?1760104326)
2. Select the knowledge base you want to configure and click **Web Crawler**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055725883/original/G7hLoJ_WBVxmgUC_743_FGos-hF3o1y03Q.png?1760104413)
3. Click the **Auto Refresh** icon (circular arrows) and choose a refresh frequency - **Daily**, **Weekly**, or **Monthly** then click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055726984/original/91Cm-4EmYWejUMIRDHTKzEuZNOyHHKyTvw.gif?1760105055)

---

## **Best Practices for a Healthy Knowledge Base**

Following these best practices improves crawl reliability, reduces failures, and helps your bot serve more accurate answers at scale.

- **Use stable URLs:** Avoid addresses that frequently redirect or require login to view content.
- **Keep pages lightweight:** Extremely long or script-heavy pages may crawl slowly and can hit timeouts.
- **Audit failures weekly:** Investigate rows stuck in **Failed**; fix broken links and retry.
- **Stagger heavy sites:** For large libraries, prefer **Weekly** or **Monthly** to spread load over time.
- **Prioritize critical pages:** Set **Daily** for pages that change often and directly affect customers.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Auto Refresh cost extra credits?**  
A: No. URL re-crawls are included in your existing Conversation AI usage.

**Q: What happens if a refresh fails?**  
A: The **Status** changes to **Failed** and the previously trained content remains active. Fix the URL or retry manually.

**Q: Will Auto Refresh update custom FAQ pairs?**  
A: No. Custom Q&A entries are static; update them manually as needed.

**Q: Does Auto Refresh work with domain crawls as well as single URLs?**  
A: Yes. Auto Refresh can be applied wherever those URLs appear in the Web URLs table. Cadence and performance depend on page depth and size.

**Q: Can I pause Auto Refresh temporarily?**  
A: Yes. Click on **Manage Automation** and **Disable**Auto Refresh. Re-enable later without losing data.

**Q: Are Google Docs or PDFs supported?**  
A: Auto Refresh currently focuses on publicly accessible web pages. For documents, convert or publish to a web-accessible page.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Training Your Conversation AI Bot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004416-training-your-conversation-ai-bot)
- [Web URLs and Links](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001338-web-urls-and-links)
- [Labs Features - Complete Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003588-labs-features-complete-overview)
- [Knowledge Base Integration for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005266-knowledge-base-integration-for-voice-ai-agents)

title_en: How to Send Review Requests
source_md:
In this article, we will cover several ways to send review requests to clients manually and automatically within the CRM. Prompting your clients to provide reviews on your Google My Business Page provides several benefits which we will cover below

---

#### **Covered in this article:**

#### [**Pre-requisites before getting started with review requests**](#Pre-requisites-before-getting-started-with-review-requests)

#### [**Ways to send Review Requests:**](#Ways-to-send-Review-Requests%3A)

- #### [1. Quick Actions: (Manual)](#1.-Quick-Actions%3A-(Manual))
- #### [2. Workflow Action: (Automated)](#2.-Workflow-Action%3A-(Automated))
- #### [3. Reputations Tab: (Manual)](#3.-Reputations-Tab%3A%C2%A0(Manual))

#### [**What do the different review request statuses mean?**](#What-do-the-different-review-request-statuses-mean?)

#### [**Troubleshooting**](#Troubleshooting)

- #### [How to dispute or report a google review](#How-to-dispute-or-report-a-google-review)

---

## **Pre-requisites before getting started with review requests**

- To send Google reviews links please integrate GMB first**([See Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222899)),** **Or**if you would like to use a 3rd party review link please**[click here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000980328-reputation-management-how-to-customize-the-review-request-messages-sms-email-/preview#:~:text=email%20example%20here-,How%20to%20add%20a%20different%20review%20URL%20to%20your%20review%20request,-How%20to%20enable)**
- Review requests will need to be enabled (toggled on) in the sub-accounts settings **([See Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/48000980328?portalId=48000045315#:~:text=email%20example%20here-,How%20to%20enable%20(Toggle%20on)%20the%20review%20request%20feature%20throughout%20the%20system,-Please%20toggle%20the))**
- (Optional)Customize your outbound (SMS/Email) review messaging ([**See Guide**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000980328))
- Ensure your Google Business Profile is fully integrated and connected to the correct location. (**[See Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222899)**)

---

## **Here are several reasons why you would want to get as many reviews as possible:**

If you’re a business owner, then you probably already know that the answer to why your business or service would need reviews is “*because it helps people find out more about your business*.”

And there's more...

**1) To increase sales and conversions**

If you’re selling a product or service, then it makes sense to have positive reviews from happy customers. They can help convince potential buyers that the product/service will be good for them.

**2) To improve SEO**

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is one of the most important aspects of running an online business. Having high-quality content is great, but if your site isn’t optimized for search engines like Google and Bing, then it won’t rank as well in searches.

**3) To build trust with visitors**

When people visit your website, they want to know that they are dealing with someone who is trustworthy. If you have lots of negative comments on your site, then this could damage your reputation and cause customers to be less likely to buy from you in the future.

**4) To provide a better customer experience**

If you don’t offer any reviews or ratings for products, then it can make it difficult for potential buyers to find what they need. This will also mean that they may not get the best deal when buying online.

---

# **Ways to send Review Requests:**

There are three ways to send review requests from within the CRM:

**1.****Quick Actions** - This is a *Manual*action by the user  
**2.** **Workflow Action** - This is an Automated action that sends a review request from within a workflow. If the contact has an[**assigned user**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/48001222668/edit?portalId=48000045315#:~:text=%22Only%20Assigned%20Data%22%20is%20a%20great%20way%20to%20limit%20sales%20people%20from%20seeing%20each%2Dother%27s%20leads%2C%20opportunities%2C%20conversations) the review request will come from the assigned user.  
**3.****Reputation** **Tab** - This is a *Manual* action by the user

---

## **1. Quick Actions: (Manual)**

Quick Actions are shortcuts available in the top left above the sidebar which allows you to perform a set of actions with a few clicks. One of those actions is Sending a review Request:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48253460777/original/fGCUySpsIIEoMcXrn4-AysrfJErzo2EQXw.gif?1664294199)

**Please Note:**

```
When sending a review request, the person who is signed in will be the one listed as the sender of that message. ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48252671465/original/7OpayQ_kGN6ZhW10WyXVlOL0owImRWHEMg.png?1663879131)  
If you are looking to send a review request from the contact's assigned user, please use the Workflows action "Send Review Request" to send a request on behalf of the assigned user (listed below).
```

## 

---

## **2. Workflow Action: (Automated)**

To automate the review request process within a workflow please add the "**Send Review Request**" action > Select the channel **Email/ SMS**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48253748374/original/4621flFaFbUydDSpldVPj_E6iAbxWiz79A.gif?1664393276)

## 

---

## **3. Reputations Tab:****(Manual)**

In the sidebar, you can head to the **Reputation tab> Requests>** To send an individual Review Request Manually and to keep a track of all the review requests that are being sent:  
  
**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48253477990/original/6gSuJKY30kCZ4mrTc74yqp6MLv2zeHniCg.gif?1664299510)**

---

## **What do the different review request statuses mean?**

**Queued:** When the user creates a review request, the system will attempt to send the request immediately. If there is a queue of other review requests in front of your request, there may be a slight delay before the request goes out.

Another possible reason is that the email/SMS request is set up to send after one day:

- **Sent**: The system has sent the review request.
- **Delivered**: After the system has sent the review request, only Twilio confirms the delivery of the SMS sent. Mailgun will not provide a delivered status.
- **Failed**: When a review request fails to deliver. This can happen for a variety of reasons such as the phone number not being valid.

If you are using another SMTP integration, please make sure to send the review request by logging in with the user email that matches the SMTP integrated email. The system will use the user login email as the sender's email when sending review request emails.

---

# **Troubleshooting**

### **How to dispute or report a google review**

To dispute or report a Google Review that you believe is wrong or spam please follow the instructions in this article:  
[How to Dispute a Google Review and Check on the Dispute Status](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001180761)

title_en: Validate Voice AI Prompts for Speech-to-Speech (S2S)Models
source_md:
Prompt Validation helps you optimize existing Voice AI prompts for speech-to-speech (S2S) models such as GPT Live, GPT Realtime, and Gemini. It removes outdated instructions, improves prompt structure, and prepares your agent for direct speech conversations. You can review and edit all suggested changes before applying them.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Prompt Validation for Speech-to-Speech Models?](#What-is-Prompt-Validation-for-Speech-to-Speech-Models?)
- [Key Benefits of Prompt Validation](#Key-Benefits-of-Prompt-Validation)
- [How Prompt Validation Works](#How-Prompt-Validation-Works)
- [How to Validate Your Voice AI Prompt](#How-to-Validate-Your-Voice-AI-Prompt)
- [Prompt Validation vs. Prompt Optimizer](#Prompt-Validation-vs.-Prompt-Optimizer)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Prompt Validation for Speech-to-Speech Models?**

Prompt Validation is a HighLevel feature that automatically analyzes and restructures existing Voice AI prompts for speech-to-speech models.

Traditional voice agents use separate Speech-to-Text (STT), language processing (LLM), and Text-to-Speech (TTS) stages. S2S models handle speech more directly, making some instructions written for older systems unnecessary.

The validator removes outdated instructions, reorganizes workflows, and provides a side-by-side comparison before any changes are applied.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618510/original/gmSDidcYxaezB-77ZbBp_MJJb8kCWfKkPg.png?1793372209)

---

## **Key Benefits of Prompt Validation**

Prompt Validation simplifies the transition to speech-to-speech models while helping preserve important business instructions.

- **Automatic Cleanup:** Removes unnecessary SSML tags, pause markers, filler instructions, and formatting.
- **Better Organization:** Converts lengthy instructions into structured, numbered steps.
- **Model-Specific Optimization:** Separates Speech and Reasoning model instructions for GPT Live.
- **Business Rule Preservation:** Aims to retain important details such as operating hours, pricing, and policies.
- **Transparent Review:** Displays suggested additions and removals before applying them.
- **Full Control:** Allows you to edit, regenerate, or cancel proposed changes.

---

## **How Prompt Validation Works**

Prompt Validation uses two stages to prepare existing prompts for speech-to-speech models.

1. **Cleanup:** Removes outdated pipeline-specific instructions and unnecessary formatting.
2. **Restructuring:** Organizes instructions into clear steps and groups related information.

For GPT Live, the validator can also separate instructions between:

- **Speech Model:** Handles greetings, conversational tone, FAQs, policies, and caller interactions.
- **Reasoning Model:** Handles complex tasks such as pricing calculations, discounts, date calculations, and multi-step decisions.

The Speech model retains instructions explaining when to delegate tasks to the Reasoning model.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618579/original/dgQs46nUxendOXsLMV6doRsxkOlYn0hTaQ.png?1793372241)

---

## **How to Validate Your Voice AI Prompt**

Validating your saved prompt helps identify unnecessary instructions and improve compatibility with your selected S2S model. Review all proposed changes before saving to ensure important business requirements remain accurate.

1. Navigate to **AI Agents → Voice AI → Agent List** and open your agent.
2. Select a supported **GPT Live, GPT Realtime, or Gemini** model from the Model dropdown.
3. Save your existing prompt. Validation analyzes the last saved version, not unsaved editor changes.
4. Click **Validate prompt** above the prompt editor.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618845/original/saInG6EY2Sf2bn1kuyXtqBmNjeM7haFJRw.png?1793372396)
5. Review the information in the validation dialog and click **Start validating**.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618948/original/ooFKpZOIPghzZYHsmTraVOkgk_ahvEDx4Q.png?1793372415)
6. Review the proposed instructions in the side-by-side comparison.

   - Red text indicates removed instructions.
   - Green text indicates added or rewritten instructions.
   - **Warnings and removed content** highlights items requiring attention.  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084621021/original/cQobq6gLW5PaBtIVd38MElXWAc9-7dHjwQ.png?1793373222)  
       
     **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084621140/original/5om0G6sg1kbUxFt7g_EOHOgdWIureW2isQ.png?1793373269)**
7. Click **Edit result** to adjust instructions or **Regenerate** to request another proposal.
8. Click **Apply** to transfer the proposed instructions into the editors.
9. Click **Save** in the agent builder to save the updated prompt.

   **Important:** Clicking Apply does not automatically save your changes.
10. Test the updated agent using **Web Call** or **Phone Call** to confirm it follows your business rules correctly.

---

## **Prompt Validation vs. Prompt Optimizer**

Although both tools help improve Voice AI agents, they serve different purposes. Prompt Validation focuses on preparing instructions for S2S models, while Prompt Optimizer evaluates agent behavior through test scenarios.

| Feature | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Validate prompt | Cleans and restructures existing instructions for S2S models. |
| Prompt Optimizer | Tests agent conversations and recommends improvements. |
| Edit Prompts with AI | Rewrites selected prompt instructions based on user requests. |

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Prompt Validation automatically update my agent?**

No. You must review the suggested changes, click Apply, and then Save.

**Q: Will my business rules and policies be changed?**

The validator is designed to preserve business-specific information such as pricing, hours, and policies. Always review suggested changes before applying them.

**Q: Does every S2S model use separate Speech and Reasoning instructions?**

No. The separate Speech and Reasoning instruction structure described here applies to GPT Live.

**Q: Can I edit the suggested instructions?**

Yes. Click Edit result to modify the proposed instructions before applying them.

**Q: What happens if an important instruction is removed?**

You can restore or modify it before clicking Apply.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [GPT Live 1 Speech-to-Speech Model for Voice AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009101)
- [How to Set Up Speech-to-Speech (S2S) Voice AI Agents in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009217-how-to-set-up-speech-to-speech-s2s-voice-ai-agents-in-highlevel)
- [Voice AI – Prompt Optimizer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007781-voice-ai-prompt-optimizer)
- [Voice AI – Edit Prompts with AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007529-voice-ai-edit-prompts-with-ai)

title_en: Convert Existing Sub-Account to SaaS Mode Subscription Plan
source_md:
This help article provides a guide on how to attach a SaaS mode subscription to an existing sub-account in HighLevel. 

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How to Convert an Existing Sub-Account To SaaS Mode](#How-to-Convert-an-Existing-Sub-Account-To-SaaS-Mode)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **How to Convert an Existing Sub-Account To SaaS Mode**

1. In your Agency account, navigate to the **Sub-Accounts** tab on the main navigation bar.
2. Scroll to the sub-account you want to convert, select the **three-dots** icon on the lower right corner of the listing.
3. Select **S****witch To SaaS**  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hGnHgYlDeA5VA5hHT16H+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-03+at+12.41.30+AM.png)
4. If **Customer Does Not Exist Yet in Stripe**, select the **Create New Customer in Stripe** option. Send the customer the link via **SMS**, **Email** or **directly****copy** and **send****it****to****them**. Then ask your client to upload their card on the link.
5. Click on **Proceed**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/iRDjEPxOgkxdr21r77MA+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-03+at+12.51.01+AM.png)
6. If **Customer Already Exists in Stripe**, select the **Link Existing Customer in Stripe**option, **search** and **select** the **customer**, hit **Proceed**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/yvJrCkwMQQoAhX7UCxej+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-03+at+12.59.12+AM.png)
7. After clicking on **Proceed** for both the above options, you will be prompted to **choose which plan from your SaaS Configurator you'd like to move that client to**.  
     
   **Important:** A plan must be selected to activate SaaS mode. Clients must add payment methods for the plan to take full effect.  
     
   Review plan details before you continue. In the **Select Subscription Plan** modal, HighLevel now shows more information about each plan so you can confirm what you are enabling.  
     
   - Click on the **Show Full Details** option above the select Plan button.  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7v1siL0HSgt6gnu9u2W9+/Screenshot+2025-11-21+at+1.54.11%E2%80%AFPM.png)
   - **You** **can** **review****:** Rebilling rates, Add-ons included in the plan, Marketplace apps included with the plan, Custom menu links included with the plan.  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/rbz3LnVy8nRbmHFpEwF1+/Screenshot+2025-11-21+at+1.55.15%E2%80%AFPM.png)
8. **Select a plan** and click on **Continue**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/baD1dldAsCjUeBgfdr0C+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-03+at+1.06.00+AM.png)
9. If Attach Snapshot is enabled for the selected SaaS plan, HighLevel displays a warning before applying the snapshot.

   The warning appears even when the snapshot does not contain any conflicting assets.   
     
   Choose how HighLevel should handle any conflicts:

   **Overwrite Conflicting Assets:** Replace conflicting existing assets with the versions from the snapshot.

   **Keep Existing Assets:** Preserve conflicting assets already in the sub-account. Non-conflicting assets from the snapshot are still applied.

   **Cancel:** Stop SaaS enablement. No changes are applied.

   If no conflicts exist, the selected conflict option has no effect and the snapshot applies normally.

   Note: This conflict-handling behavior applies to both SaaS V1 and SaaS V2.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081327147/original/r2hC0_nsCPS8obfOXa_wx-NzIkIrqaLtvg.png?1789748970)
10. If a payment method is not available when the plan is assigned, the selected plan remains On Hold.  
      
    When the client reaches the lockout screen:  
      
    If no card is on file, the client can add one and attempt payment.  
      
    If a card is already on file, HighLevel displays the saved card and lets the client proceed to payment without adding another card.  
      
    After successful payment, HighLevel automatically unlocks the sub-account.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/8ksVfUlrQWbFtqnc8ZYu+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-03+at+1.11.13+AM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What should I do if the “Share Link” option is not working or is unavailable?**

If the “Share Link” option is not working, first ensure that your browser or network settings are not blocking the pop-up or the link itself. Try using a different browser or clearing your browser’s cache. If the issue persists, check if there are any restrictions or permissions set within your HighLevel account that might be affecting this functionality. You can also contact HighLevel support for further assistance.

**Q: Can I switch an existing sub-account to SaaS mode if it has pending invoices or unpaid balances?**

Yes, you can switch an existing sub-account to SaaS mode even if there are pending invoices or unpaid balances. However, it’s generally good practice to resolve any outstanding balances to avoid complications with billing and account management. Ensure that all financial matters are up-to-date to ensure a smooth transition.

**Q: How can I track the status of the SaaS Mode conversion process for my sub-accounts?**

To track the status of the SaaS Mode conversion, you can monitor the sub-account’s status within your HighLevel dashboard. Look for updates or notifications related to the conversion process. If you do not see any changes or updates, verify that the process was completed successfully. You may also need to check your Stripe account to confirm that the subscription has been created and is active. For detailed tracking, consider reaching out to HighLevel support if you encounter any issues.  
  
**Q: Can I attach a plan to a sub-account that was created before I enabled SaaS Mode?**

Yes, but you'll need to manually assign the SaaS plan using the steps in this article. Legacy accounts won’t be automatically converted unless you assign a plan.

**Q: Will a sub-account lose access to features not included in the SaaS plan tier when it switches to SaaS Mode?**

Yes. When a sub-account is moved to SaaS Mode and a specific plan tier is assigned (e.g., Starter, Professional, or Premium), it will only have access to the features enabled in that tier. Any features previously available that are not included in the selected plan will be disabled automatically. To retain those features, make sure they are included in the plan assigned through the SaaS Configurator.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [SaaS Mode - Full Setup Guide + FAQ](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001184920)
- [Activate SaaS Mode, Request Payment, and Configure Phone Rebilling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001177740)
- [Guide to SaaS Plan Creation, Sales, and Customer Onboarding](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003670)
- [Upgrading and Cancelling SaaS Plans for Clients](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001979)
- [How to Upgrade / Downgrade SaaS Plan for a Location](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001207110)

title_en: Getting Started - Setup Facebook and Instagram Messenger
source_md:
Ever feel overwhelmed jumping between different platforms to answer messages from your customers? Let's simplify things! By connecting Facebook and Instagram Messenger directly to your CRM, you'll have all your conversations in one spot. You'll streamline your responses, engage with your customers faster, and ultimately create a smoother communication experience for everyone involved.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Integrate Facebook & Instagram](#Integrate-Facebook-&-Instagram)
- [How Facebook and Instagram messages create contacts](#How-Facebook-and-Instagram-messages-create-contacts)
- [Link Instagram to Facebook](#Link-Instagram-to-Facebook)
- [Test Your Facebook & Instagram Messenger Connection](#Test-Your-Facebook-&-Instagram-Messenger-Connection)
- [Test Facebook Messenger](#Test-Facebook-Messenger)
- [Test Instagram Messaging](#Test-Instagram-Messaging)
- [What Does a Successful Connection Look Like?](#What-Does-a-Successful-Connection-Look-Like?)
- [Test the Reply](#Test-the-Reply)
- [What If the Test Message Doesn't Appear?](#What-If-the-Test-Message-Doesn't-Appear?)

---

## **Integrate Facebook & Instagram**

First, let's get Facebook and Instagram working together within your CRM. This integration will be a game changer in how quickly and effectively you communicate with customers.

- Head over to **Settings > Integrations**.
- Click on **Connect** under Facebook & Instagram.  
    
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046961045/original/QdZFNRgoafMeGOzeflCNcbwiaqz-QRd2Jg.png?1747785916)
- **Log in** to Facebook and choose your Facebook **page** (make sure it's the one **connected to Instagram**).
- Click **Connect Facebook & Instagram**.
- Lastly, hit **Sync Leads**.

---

## **How Facebook and Instagram messages create contacts**

When someone messages your business on Facebook or Instagram for the first time, HighLevel creates or updates a contact based on your **Contact Deduplication Preferences**.

- If the person later shares an email or phone number that matches an existing contact and **Allow Duplicate Contact** is turned off, HighLevel automatically merges the messenger contact into that existing record so you keep one complete profile.
- If **Allow Duplicate Contact** is turned on, the automatic merge does not run and separate contact records may exist for the same person.

**Learn More**

- [Facebook Troubleshooting - Integration Issues](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000981698)
- [Facebook Multi page Troubleshoot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004567)
- [Facebook Pages missing in Manage Pages during integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001234487)
- [Connect Instagram Business or Creator to Facebook (allows posting to IG)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001213003)
- [Allow Duplicate Contacts (Contact Deduplication Preferences)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/48001181714?portalId=48000045315)

---

## **Link Instagram to Facebook**

Now, let's ensure Instagram and Facebook are fully linked so your messages flow seamlessly into one inbox. Trust us—this step will save you tons of time!

- Navigate to your **Facebook account** and log in to your page.
- Click on **Account > Settings**.
- Use the search bar to find **Linked Accounts**.
- Select **Instagram** and click **Connect**.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046961111/original/qiMpvvQcdL5_5wGdinP4dhnA4sykmmaXRw.png?1747786378)
- Keep the toggle on to **enable Instagram messages** to appear in your inbox.
- **Authenticate** your Instagram login credentials.

Fantastic job! You're now set up to effortlessly handle your social interactions. Next, consider testing the integration by sending a test message to confirm everything is working smoothly.

---

## **Test Your Facebook & Instagram Messenger Connection**

After connecting your Facebook Page and Instagram account, send a test message to confirm that incoming messages are reaching HighLevel correctly.

### ``` Tip: Send the test message from a different Facebook or Instagram account—not the business account you connected to HighLevel. This provides a more accurate test of the customer messaging experience. ```

### **Test Facebook Messenger**

1. From a different Facebook account, open the connected business's **Facebook Page**.
2. Click **Message** and send a test message to the Page.
3. In HighLevel, open the appropriate **Sub-Account**.
4. Go to **Conversations**.
5. Locate the new conversation in the Conversations inbox.
6. Open the conversation and confirm that the Facebook Messenger test message appears in the message history.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078682474/original/FTxoEww4wAUJl0Rp_Fq2AWylS1ZoqNyTLA.png?1787050147)

### 

### **Test Instagram Messaging**

1. From a different Instagram account, open the connected business's **Instagram profile**.
2. Send a new direct message (DM) to the account.
3. In HighLevel, open the appropriate **Sub-Account**.
4. Go to **Conversations**.
5. Locate the new conversation in the Conversations inbox.
6. Open the conversation and confirm that the Instagram test message appears in the message history.

### 

### **What Does a Successful Connection Look Like?**

Your integration is working correctly when:

- The test message appears in **HighLevel → Conversations**.
- The message appears under the correct contact/conversation.
- You can open the conversation and view the incoming Facebook Messenger or Instagram message.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078706715/original/xGnLhZqZULa9VCCb21fzNJofyUmRGHhYtQ.png?1787060979)

When someone messages your business through Facebook or Instagram for the first time, HighLevel creates or updates their contact based on your **Contact Deduplication Preferences**.

### 

### **Test the Reply**

For an end-to-end verification, reply to the test message from within **HighLevel → Conversations**. Then, return to the Facebook Messenger or Instagram account you used for testing and confirm that the reply was received.

If both the incoming message and your reply are delivered successfully, your messaging connection is working as expected.

### 

### **What If the Test Message Doesn't Appear?**

If the test message doesn't appear in **Conversations**:

1. Go to **Settings → Integrations** and confirm that the correct Facebook Page and Instagram account are connected.
2. Confirm that messaging access is enabled for the connected account.
3. Verify that the appropriate Facebook/Instagram permissions have been granted.
4. For Instagram, confirm that the Instagram account is correctly linked to the Facebook Page.
5. Send another test message after verifying the connection and permissions.

If messages still aren't appearing, see [Messaging Setup & Troubleshoot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006069) for additional Facebook and Instagram messaging checks.

title_en: Secure Access to Conversation Attachments in HighLevel
source_md:
HighLevel is introducing enhanced security for conversation attachments to better protect sensitive customer information. Applications accessing attachments outside HighLevel will require additional file access permissions and authenticated access. 

```
This update initially applies to email conversation attachments, with other channels planned for future phases. Affected developers must update their applications by November 30, 2026.
```

---

# **What Is Secure Conversation Attachment Access?**

Secure Conversation Attachment Access is a permission-based security model that controls how external applications retrieve conversation files. Instead of relying on directly accessible attachment links, applications must have the appropriate permissions and authenticated access.

This enhancement strengthens data protection and supports HighLevel's HIPAA compliance and security requirements while maintaining the existing experience for most users.

---

## **Key Benefits of Secure Conversation Attachment Access**

The updated security model helps businesses protect confidential files while providing greater control over application access.

- **Enhanced Data Security:** Protect sensitive conversation attachments from unauthorized access.
- **Permission-Based Access:** Allow only appropriately authorized applications to retrieve protected files.
- **Improved Compliance Support:** Strengthen safeguards supporting HIPAA and security requirements.
- **Controlled Application Access:** Require authenticated requests when external applications retrieve attachments.
- **Consistent File Security:** Establish a foundation for secure attachment access across additional channels.

---

## **How Conversation Attachment Access Is Changing**

The update introduces new access requirements for applications retrieving email conversation attachments outside HighLevel.

| Current Experience | Updated Experience |
| --- | --- |
| Attachment links can be accessed directly. | Protected attachment access requires authorization. |
| Existing attachment URL format. | New, more secure attachment URL format. |
| Existing application permissions. | Additional file access permission required. |
| Existing integrations can use their current links during the transition. | Affected integrations must be updated by November 30, 2026. |

```
Important: Existing attachment links will continue working only through the transition period ending November 30, 2026. Developers should complete migration before this deadline.
```

The initial phase covers **email conversation attachments only**. Other conversation channels and file-based custom fields are planned for future phases.

---

## **Who Is Affected by This Update?**

The security enhancement primarily affects developers and applications that access or display conversation attachments outside HighLevel.

- **Regular HighLevel Users:** No changes are expected when accessing attachments directly within HighLevel.
- **Marketplace Developers:** Must update applications that retrieve email conversation attachments externally.
- **Users of Affected Applications:** Must reauthorize their applications to grant the additional permission.
- **Applications Without Attachment Access:** No action is required.

This distinction helps businesses identify whether they need to take action before the migration deadline.

---

## **Attachment Permissions and Application Reauthorization**

External applications must have the necessary file access permission before retrieving protected email attachments. Existing users must reauthorize affected applications to grant the updated access. Developers should update their application's permission configuration and ensure that attachment retrieval uses authenticated requests.

Reauthorization is required because existing permissions do not automatically grant the new file access permission.

For information about Marketplace permissions, see [API Security – OAuth Consent for Marketplace Apps](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005002).

---

## **How to Prepare for Secure Attachment Access**

Developers should review their existing integrations and complete the required updates before November 30, 2026. Preparing in advance helps prevent interruptions when the new access controls take effect.

1. **Review Your Application:** Identify whether it retrieves or displays email conversation attachments outside HighLevel.
2. **Update Permissions:** Add the required file access permission to your Marketplace application.
3. **Update Attachment Retrieval:** Modify integrations to use authenticated access and the updated attachment format.
4. **Request Reauthorization:** Ask existing users to reauthorize the application with the additional permission.
5. **Test Attachment Access:** Verify that authorized applications can retrieve attachments and that unauthorized requests are appropriately restricted.
6. **Complete Migration:** Deploy and verify the required changes before **November 30, 2026**.

For technical implementation details, refer to the [Conversation Attachment API Documentation](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/upload-file-attachments/).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will this change affect attachments viewed directly in HighLevel?**

No changes are expected for users viewing attachments within HighLevel.

**Q: Which conversation channels are affected?**

The initial phase applies to email conversation attachments. Other channels and file-based custom fields are planned for future phases.

**Q: What happens to existing attachment links after November 30, 2026?**

Existing directly accessible attachment links will no longer be supported under the previous access model. Applications must use the updated permission-based access process.

**Q: Do existing Marketplace applications require reauthorization?**

Yes, if they access affected attachments. Existing users must reauthorize these applications to grant the additional file access permission.

**Q: What happens if developers do not update their applications?**

Applications relying on the previous attachment access method may no longer be able to retrieve protected email 

attachments after the transition.

**Q: Do applications that do not access conversation attachments need to take action?**

No. Applications that do not retrieve or display conversation attachments are not affected.

---

title_en: Using Media Controls from the Notification Tray in the HighLevel Mobile App
source_md:
Media controls in the HighLevel mobile app make it easier for users to manage supported media playback without returning to the app every time they need to pause, resume, or skip. This is especially helpful for learners watching or listening to longer course, membership, or community content on mobile. 

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Media Control from the Notification Tray?](#What-is-Media-Control-from-the-Notification-Tray?)
- [Key Benefits of Media Controls from the Notification Tray](#Key-Benefits-of-Media-Controls-from-the-Notification-Tray)
- [Supported Mobile App Version](#Supported-Mobile-App-Version)
- [How To Use Media Controls from the Notification Tray](#How-To-Use-Media-Controls-from-the-Notification-Tray)
- [Troubleshooting Notification Tray Media Controls](#Troubleshooting-Notification-Tray-Media-Controls)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Media Control from the Notification Tray?**

Media controls from the notification tray allow users to manage supported media playback after starting content inside the HighLevel mobile app. Instead of reopening the app to control playback, users can use their mobile device’s notification area to pause, resume, or skip supported media.

This feature improves the mobile learning experience by making playback more flexible for users who consume long-form content while multitasking. It also supports a smoother experience across mobile surfaces where users interact with media, courses, memberships, communities, posts, comments, chats, and Go Live-related content.

---

## **Key Benefits of Media Controls from the Notification Tray**

Notification media controls reduce friction for users who need quick playback access while using their mobile device. These controls help learners and members stay engaged with content without constantly navigating back into the app.

- **Faster Playback Control:**Pause, resume, or skip supported media directly from the notification tray.
- **Better Long-Form Learning Experience:**Continue consuming longer course or membership content with fewer interruptions.
- **Improved Multitasking:**Control media while switching between apps or using other areas of the device.
- **Cleaner Mobile Experience:** Enjoy a refreshed editor experience across posts, comments, chats, and Go Live.
- **More Reliable Playback:**Benefit from video and media improvements designed to reduce playback interruptions.
- **Improved Navigation Flow:**Move through the app more smoothly with better background refresh, carousel browsing, and back navigation.

---

## **Supported Mobile App Version**

Using the latest mobile app version helps ensure that users can access the newest playback controls, editor improvements, and bug fixes. App updates are especially important when features rely on device-level behavior, such as notification tray media controls.

The notification tray media controls are included in:

- iOS: v26.03.210 or later
- Android: v26.03.210 or later

Users should update the HighLevel mobile app before trying to use this feature. Existing HighLevel mobile course guidance also recommends updating the app to access newer mobile course experiences.

---

## **How To Use Media Controls from the Notification Tray**

Starting playback inside the HighLevel mobile app is required before notification tray controls can appear. Once supported media is playing, the mobile device can display playback controls in the notification area.

1. Update the HighLevel mobile app to v26.03.210 or later.
2. Open the HighLevel mobile app on iOS or Android.
3. Navigate to supported media content, such as a course, membership, or other media-enabled area.
4. Start playing the media inside the app.
5. Swipe down from the top of the screen to open the device notification tray.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073151049/original/ZxO8GYowTZEfpEL5s_G0TmT_bN0Uguq4-w.png?1780920030)
6. Use the available media controls to pause, resume, or skip playback.
7. Return to the HighLevel app when you want to continue interacting with the content directly.

---

## **Troubleshooting Notification Tray Media Controls**

Notification tray controls depend on the mobile app version, supported media behavior, and device-level notification settings. Checking these items first can help resolve most cases where controls do not appear as expected.

Try the following:

- Confirm the HighLevel mobile app is updated to v26.03.210 or later.
- Start playback inside the HighLevel mobile app before opening the notification tray.
- Confirm the media type supports notification tray controls.
- Make sure mobile notifications are enabled for the app.
- Check whether the device has background playback or battery restrictions enabled.
- Close and reopen the app, then start playback again.
- Restart the device if controls still do not appear.

HighLevel has separate notification-related documentation for Client Portal and mobile app notifications, including notification preferences and mobile push notification behavior.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to update the mobile app to use notification tray media controls?**A: Yes. Users should update to iOS or Android app version v26.03.210 or later before using this feature.

**Q: Can I pause and resume media without reopening the HighLevel app?**A: Yes. After supported media starts playing in the app, users can pause or resume playback from the notification tray.

**Q: Can I skip media from the notification tray?**A: Yes, skip controls are included in the release note. Availability may depend on the supported media type and device behavior.

**Q: Why do I not see media controls in my notification tray?**A: Confirm the app is updated, media is actively playing, notifications are enabled, and the content type supports notification tray controls.

**Q: Did this update change posts, comments, chats, or Go Live?**A: Yes. The editor experience across posts, comments, chats, and Go Live was refreshed to feel cleaner.

**Q: Are notification tray controls the same as HighLevel push notifications?**A: No. Notification tray media controls manage active media playback. Push notifications alert users about updates, messages, comments, or other activity.

---

## **Related Articles**

title_en: Call Logs for Voice AI Agents
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/e8BspK2Gyd4?&wmode=opaque)

The **Call Logs** feature gives you complete visibility into every call handled by your Voice AI agents. Whether you need to review performance, understand customer interactions, or ensure quality control, Call Logs provide detailed insights in one place.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Call Logs for Voice AI Agents?](#%C2%A0What-are-Call-Logs-for-Voice-AI-Agents?)
- [Key Benefits of Call Logs for Voice AI Agents](#Key-Benefits-of-Call-Logs-for-Voice-AI-Agents)
- [How to Access Call Logs](#How-to-Access-Call-Logs)
- [Reviewing Call Summaries, Transcripts, and Recordings](#Reviewing-Call-Summaries,-Transcripts,-and-Recordings)
  - [Call Summary](#Call-Summary)
  - [Call Transcript](#Call-Transcript)
  - [Call Recording](#Call-Recording)
- [Bulk Export Call Logs](#%E2%80%8BBulk-Export-Call-Logs)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Call Logs for Voice AI Agents?**

Voice AI Call Logs provide a detailed history of calls handled by your Voice AI agents. These logs help you understand what happened during each call, how the agent responded, which actions were triggered, and where improvements may be needed.

Call Logs are available inside the Voice AI Dashboard & Logs area. Each call entry can include the agent name, contact name, caller number, date and time, duration, actions triggered, summary, transcript, call recording, and feedback options.

---

## **Key Benefits of Call Logs for Voice AI Agents**

- **Phone Number:**See exactly who your agents interacted with. You can click the phone number to open the Contact Details page instantly.
- **Call Time & Duration:**Get accurate information on when the call took place and how long it lasted.
- **Actions Triggered:**Review the actions performed during the call for better workflow understanding.
- **Call Summary:**View a concise overview of the call along with all details collected by the agent during the conversation.
- **Call Transcript:**Access the complete conversation for clarity, compliance checks, and deeper insights.

---

## **How to Access Call Logs**

Voice AI Call Logs are located inside the AI Agents area of HighLevel. This is where you can review recent calls, apply filters, export call data, and open call-specific details such as summaries, transcripts, and recordings.

To access Voice AI Call Logs:

1. In the left navigation menu, click **AI Agents**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073573203/original/VdqG2DBKaB_hQ2pMPPptD2aWwLpOJTPjsA.png?1781287080)
2. At the top of the AI Agents area, click **Voice AI**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073573216/original/4TwVCg40Rc3_e_JRn2YD9pifw00u_9QA_Q.png?1781287110)
3. Apply any needed filters.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073573254/original/UkU_Mfe4mrNiJRQ_w39o5T5VBcB1LpFIyg.png?1781287172)
4. Scroll down to the call log table.  
     
   For each call, the call log table will show details such as Agent Name, Contact Name, Contact Number, From Number, Date and Time, Duration, Actions Triggered, Summary, Transcript, Call Recording, and Feedback options.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073573354/original/beStsDZTYj2cki1bkW4Cs5VOR-odF_1s2w.png?1781287328)

---

## **Reviewing Call Summaries, Transcripts, and Recordings**

Call-level details help you understand what happened during each Voice AI conversation without needing to replay every interaction manually. For each call, you can review the interaction in three ways: Summary, Transcript, and Call Recording.

### **Call Summary**

The Summary option gives you a short overview of what happened during the call. This helps you quickly understand the purpose and outcome of the conversation without reading the full transcript or listening to the recording.

Use **Summary** when you want to:

- Review the main reason for the call
- Confirm what the Voice AI agent handled
- Check the outcome before opening more detailed call data

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073572504/original/NoWdyXOoQDP358Fb229eyMdCh4SdbESYmQ.png?1781285851)

### **Call Transcript**

The Transcript option shows the full text of the conversation. This is useful when you need to review exactly what the caller said, how the Voice AI agent responded, and whether the conversation followed the intended flow.

Use **View Transcript** when you want to:

- Review the exact conversation
- Check how the agent handled questions or objections
- Find areas to improve prompts, responses, or routing

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073572574/original/M6vDUu4yowqq1StrkLIHAUQNAsFvo016SQ.png?1781286007)

### **Call Recording**

The Call Recording option lets you listen to the audio from the call when a recording is available. Listening to the original audio gives additional context such as tone, pacing, and caller intent.

From the recording window, you can:

- Listen to the full conversation
- Download the audio file when available

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073572604/original/h0TfDztKbU13uyBN1Jnujl1rB5QpGyojHQ.png?1781286059)

---

## **Bulk Export Call Logs**

Bulk export lets you download Voice AI call logs as a CSV file. Exports respect your active filters, so only matching call logs are included in the file. You can filter by details such as contact, live or test calls, inbound or outbound calls, agent, date range, and action type. When you bulk export, it exports up to the 50 most recent calls that match your current filters.

To export all calls within the applied filters, click **Export All.**To download only specific calls, use the checkbox next to the calls to select them, then click **Export**.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073572640/original/eSH_XszTV7CnKjFd1-9NYM8r4Ne0ZVQi3Q.png?1781286120)**

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How far back can I view call logs?**

Call logs are available for all calls handled since the feature was activated.

**Q: Are call logs available for all agents?**

Yes, any Voice AI agent with call activity will have logs visible in their Agent Details page.

**Q: Why can’t I download a recording for a call?**  
Recording downloads are available only for completed calls where a recording exists. Availability may also depend on provider support.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004107)
- [How to Edit a Voice AI Agents Voice](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005874)
