title_en: SaaS Multi-Brands Overview
source_md:
SaaS Configuration

# SaaS Multi-Brands Overview

Manage up to two independent brand identities within a single SaaS account, each with unique branding, domains, and white label settings.

What You'll Learn

This article explains how SaaS Multi-Brands enables agencies to operate multiple brand identities from a single account, each with independent white label configurations, domains, and theme settings.

You'll learn what Multi-Brands is, its key benefits, how to configure each brand independently, and how to map brands to sub-accounts or SaaS plan categories.

Private Beta Feature

SaaS Multi-Brands is currently in Private Beta, available to a limited cohort of agencies. Public Beta availability is planned within 2–3 weeks. Features and functionality may evolve based on feedback during the beta period.

## What is SaaS Multi-Brands?

SaaS Multi-Brands enables agencies to manage up to two independent brand identities within a single HighLevel SaaS account. Each brand operates with its own white label configuration, allowing agencies to serve different markets, customer segments, or business verticals under distinct brand identities—all from one agency account.

Each brand can be customized with unique branding elements, mapped to specific sub-accounts, or assigned automatically through SaaS plan categories. This eliminates the need to manage separate agency accounts for different brand identities.

Brands can be switched independently, allowing you to manage each brand's settings, configurations, and sub-account assignments from a centralized interface.

## Key Benefits

SaaS Multi-Brands provides agencies with the flexibility to operate multiple brand identities without the overhead of managing separate accounts.

**Serve Multiple Markets** — Operate distinct brands for different customer segments, geographic regions, or business verticals under one agency account.

**Explore New Niches** — Use a second brand to test new markets or service offerings while maintaining your primary brand identity.

**Simplified Account Management** — Manage multiple brands from a single agency dashboard without maintaining separate agency accounts or login credentials.

**Tailored Client Experience** — Deliver a fully branded experience with unique logos, domains, themes, and contact information for each brand.

**Flexible Brand Assignment** — Map brands to individual sub-accounts or automate brand assignment through SaaS plan categories.

## Brand Configuration Capabilities

Each brand in SaaS Multi-Brands can be configured independently with the following white label settings and branding elements.

Feature 1

Brand Name and Logo

Define a unique brand name and upload a custom logo for each brand to ensure consistent branding across all customer touchpoints.

Feature 2

White Label Domain

Configure a unique white label domain for each brand, allowing customers to access their accounts through a branded URL specific to that brand identity.

Feature 3

API Domain

Set a custom API domain for each brand to ensure API integrations and webhooks align with your brand identity.

Feature 4

Brand Email and Phone Number

Specify a unique contact email address and phone number for each brand, providing customers with brand-specific support channels.

Feature 5

Theme Customization

Apply a unique theme to each brand, including color schemes, button styles, and layout preferences.

Feature 6

Custom CSS and JavaScript

Inject custom CSS and JavaScript for each brand to further customize the user interface and functionality.

Feature 7

Privacy Policy and Terms URLs

Define custom URLs for privacy policies and terms of service for each brand, ensuring compliance and brand-specific legal documentation.

Note

Each brand operates with its own independent white label configuration. Changes made to one brand do not affect the settings of the other brand.

## Availability and Plan Requirements

SaaS Multi-Brands is available **exclusively to customers subscribed to the $497 Founder Plan.** Agencies on other plans do not have access to this feature.

During the Private Beta phase, Multi-Brands has been enabled for an initial cohort of 20–30 agencies. Public Beta availability is planned within 2–3 weeks, after which the feature will be accessible to all agencies on the Pro Plan.

Plan Requirement

You must be subscribed to the $497 Founder Plan to access SaaS Multi-Brands. This feature is not available on other SaaS plan tiers.

Brand Management

Manage Multiple Brands from One Account

Switch between brands, configure unique settings, and map brands to sub-accounts or SaaS plan categories—all from your agency dashboard.

## How to Set Up SaaS Multi-Brands

Follow these steps to create and configure multiple brands within your SaaS account.

Step 1

Access SaaS Configuration

Navigate to your agency dashboard and access the SaaS Configuration section. This is where you manage all brand settings and configurations.

Step 2

Create a New Brand

Click the option to create a new brand. You can create up to two brands per agency account. Provide a brand name and upload a logo for the new brand.

Step 3

Configure White Label Settings

Set up the white label domain, API domain, brand email, phone number, theme, custom CSS/JavaScript, and privacy/terms URLs for the new brand. Each setting is independent from your other brand.

Step 4

Set a Default Brand

Designate one brand as the default fallback for agency-wide settings. This brand is used when a sub-account or SaaS plan category does not have a specific brand assigned.

Step 5

Map Brands to Sub-Accounts

Assign a brand to individual sub-accounts. When a sub-account is mapped to a brand, customers accessing that sub-account see the branding, domain, and settings associated with the assigned brand.

Step 6

Automate Brand Assignment via SaaS Plan Categories

Link brands to SaaS plan categories to automatically assign branding based on the plan a customer subscribes to. This allows you to deliver different brand experiences depending on the SaaS plan tier without manual assignment.

Step 7

Switch Between Brands

Use the brand switcher in your SaaS Configuration dashboard to toggle between your brands and manage their settings independently. Changes to one brand do not affect the other.

Setup Complete

Your SaaS Multi-Brands setup is complete. Customers accessing sub-accounts or plans mapped to each brand will see the appropriate branding and white label settings.

title_en: How to Use Course AI to Create and Manage Courses
source_md:
Course AI helps you create courses in HighLevel using simple prompts and existing materials. You can generate course outlines, modules, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and images, then customize everything before sharing it with learners.

This article covers how to create a course with Course AI and use its tools throughout the Course Builder.

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/OvZseH7KhpxFIqvqVlpi)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How to Create a Course with Course AI](#How-to-Create-a-Course-with-Course-AI)
- [How to Customize Your Course Outline](#How-to-Customize-Your-Course-Outline)
- [How to Generate Lesson Content from Videos](#How-to-Generate-Lesson-Content-from-Videos)
- [How to Write or Edit Lesson Descriptions with AI](#How-to-Write-or-Edit-Lesson-Descriptions-with-AI)
- [How to Generate Quiz Questions with AI](#How-to-Generate-Quiz-Questions-with-AI)
- [How to Generate Thumbnails with AI](#How-to-Generate-Thumbnails-with-AI)
- [Important Things to Know](#Important-Things-to-Know)

---

## **How to Create a Course with Course AI**

1. Go to **Memberships > Courses > Products**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/gMniM7avIpYsmRMsZAbp+/Screenshot+2026-10-14+at+18.12.44.png)
2. Click **Create New > Start from scratch** to open Course AI.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ayseAFlJQ7o6aNN14e0Z+/Screen+Shot+2026-10-14+at+18.22.20.png)
3. Choose a **course type:**

   - Self-paced skill course
   - Mini-course / lead magnet
   - Daily bootcamp / challenge
   - Certification program
   - Recording library / vault
4. Describe your course, including the topic, target audience, and what learners should achieve.
5. Optionally, attach **images, PDFs, or public reference links**. You can also **use voice input.**
6. Submit your prompt to generate a course outline.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/CSOQWQKrfdrvISHVpzUf+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-14+at+18.24.01.gif)

---

## **How to Customize Your Course Outline**

Course AI Studio displays your conversation on the left and a live course outline on the right.

You can refine the course before creating it.

1. Review the generated course title, description, modules, lessons, and quizzes.
2. Use the chat to request changes or select suggested follow-up responses.
3. Edit or delete titles, modules, and lessons as needed.
4. Use AI rewriting options such as **Clarify**, **Rephrase**, **Make specific**, or **Shorten** to improve titles.
5. Generate a course cover image or upload your own.
6. Click **Confirm** when you're satisfied with the outline.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vdoHnG5xGxHeOZSEJ8hQ+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-14+at+18.39.30.gif)

---

## **How to Generate Lesson Content from Videos**

Course AI can analyze newly uploaded or imported lesson videos and suggest supporting content based on their transcripts.

1. Open your course and select a lesson.
2. Upload or import a lesson video.
3. Once Course AI has processed the video, review the suggestions in the **Course AI** panel.  
     
   Depending on the video's content, suggestions can include:

   - **Lesson description:** A summary of the video.
   - **Quiz questions:** Questions based on important moments in the lesson.
   - **Downloadable PDF recap:** A summary learners can save for reference.

4. Click **Accept** beside an individual suggestion, **Accept all** to use every suggestion, or **Dismiss** to skip one.
5. Save your changes using the available save or publishing option.

Accepted PDF recaps are added to the lesson's downloadable resources.

```
Note: Automatic transcript-based suggestions are available only for newly uploaded or imported videos.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083326566/original/hTe8ANkuNDnybQzkvDOpxODOQCxs26TBrw.png?1791988581)

---

## **How to Write or Edit Lesson Descriptions with AI**

You can use Course AI to create descriptions or improve text you've already written.

1. Open a lesson in the Course Builder.
2. If the description is empty, use Course AI to generate one from the lesson title or an available video transcript.
3. If the description already contains text, open the AI **Edit** options.
4. Enter your own editing instructions or choose a quick edit:

   - Rewrite
   - Make it shorter
   - Make it longer
   - More professional
   - More casual
5. Review the updated description and save your changes.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/x5Kxkvxz64yA6XGdlWbf+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-14+at+19.43.25.gif)

---

## **How to Generate Quiz Questions with AI**

Course AI can generate quiz questions from an individual lesson, an entire module, or the whole course.

1. Open a quiz in the Course Builder and choose **Generate quiz questions**.
2. Select the source content you want AI to use.
3. Choose a **Question type**:

   - Single choice
   - Multiple choice
   - Mix
4. Select the difficulty: **Easy**, **Medium**, or **Hard**.
5. Set the **Number of questions** (1–20).
6. Click **Generate**, review the questions, and save your changes.

You can edit the generated questions before making the quiz available to learners.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/P06vt37CrB45OovjpGMN+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-14+at+19.50.23.gif)

---

## **How to Generate Thumbnails with AI**

You can create AI-generated thumbnails for lessons, quizzes, and assignments.

1. Open the lesson, quiz, or assignment you want to update.
2. Access its AI thumbnail generation option.
3. Describe the image you want to create.
4. Choose a style:

   - Photographic
   - Illustrated
   - Bold text overlay
   - Minimal
5. Click **Generate**.
6. Review the image and save your selected thumbnail.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/B5thNhcWjQrkkHRsaWPc+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-14+at+20.01.18.gif)

---

## **Important Things to Know**

- **File limits:** You can attach up to 5 files, with a maximum size of 25 MB per file, when providing materials for course creation.
- **Reference links:** URLs must be public and accessible to AI.
- **Video processing:** Automatic lesson content suggestions work with newly uploaded or imported videos only.
- **AI content:** Generated outlines, descriptions, quizzes, and images can be reviewed and edited.
- **Manual creation:** Select **Skip and set up manually** if you prefer to build your course without AI.

Once your course content is ready, review its settings, preview the learner experience, and complete the necessary publishing and access setup.

title_en: Understanding Email Conversion and Revenue Attribution
source_md:
### [동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/jmzGnQzxiL0?&wmode=opaque)

# 

# **What Is Email Conversion and Revenue Attribution?**

Email conversion and revenue attribution helps you understand which email campaign receives credit when a recipient interacts with an email and later completes an eligible purchase. HighLevel uses an attribution window to connect qualifying email interactions with subsequent orders and display the resulting conversion and revenue data in Email 

Statistics.

By default, HighLevel uses a **5-day attribution window**, which can be customized based on your reporting needs.

> **Note:** Attributed revenue is not the same as ROI. Revenue attribution measures revenue credited to a campaign, while ROI also requires cost or spend information.

---

## **How Email Attribution Works**

HighLevel uses qualifying email interactions and the configured attribution window to determine which campaign receives credit for an eligible purchase. When a contact interacts with multiple eligible campaigns, the most recent qualifying campaign within the attribution window receives the attribution.

For example:

1. A contact opens **Campaign A**.
2. The contact later clicks **Campaign B**.
3. The contact completes an eligible purchase within the attribution window.
4. **Campaign B** receives credit because it was the most recent qualifying email interaction.

If the purchase occurs outside the configured attribution window, it is not attributed to the campaign under this attribution model.

---

## **Email Conversion Metrics**

Conversion statistics help you evaluate the purchases and revenue attributed to an email campaign. The available metrics provide both overall revenue performance and record-level conversion information.

| Metric | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Orders/Conversions** | Number of purchases or conversions attributed to the campaign |
| **Revenue** | Total revenue attributed to the campaign |
| **RPR (Revenue per Recipient)** | Average revenue generated per email recipient |
| **Conversion/Order Rate** | Rate at which recipients generated attributed conversions |
| **Average Order Value** | Average value of attributed orders |

---

## **How to View Email Conversion Metrics**

Campaign Statistics provides the conversion and revenue information associated with an individual email campaign. Use this view when you want to understand how a specific campaign contributed to eligible purchases.

1. Go to **Marketing > Emails > Campaigns**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081182406/original/3ycNz_dvXbICeC7LduaQpSecxNK1AQAdkg.png?1789647731)
2. Locate the email campaign you want to review.
3. Open the **three-dot menu** and select **Statistics**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081182448/original/V5LZ7TacK7OhUwbjDUyeNETRpdk1YGzMWA.png?1789647753)
4. Click **Load More Statistics**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081182496/original/UTMaiEe0FyrzPV1jvNBO_AJSNatZEJlJDw.png?1789647778)
5. Review the available conversion and revenue metrics.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081182576/original/lRS_oR3zQvSg4vXVyEKcq-iU3k6e_f2Uug.png?1789647817)

Use the **Ordered** tab to review contacts whose eligible purchases were attributed to the campaign.

> **Note:** Eligible orders reflected in HighLevel Payments can be considered for attribution, including Shopify orders as documented by HighLevel.

---

## **Configure Email Attribution**

Attribution settings determine how long a qualifying email interaction can receive credit for a purchase and which campaigns are eligible for attribution. Adjust these settings based on how you want to evaluate email-driven revenue.

### 

### **Attribution Window**

HighLevel uses a **5-day attribution window by default**. You can customize this period in the applicable email attribution settings.

A longer attribution window allows purchases occurring further from the qualifying email interaction to receive attribution, while a shorter window limits attribution to purchases occurring closer to the interaction.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081182955/original/8gYRQZVDWrZccU-9K508M9wM4Tx_2sFygw.png?1789647997)

### **Attribution Scope**

HighLevel provides attribution scope options including:

- **All Campaigns:** Allows attribution across eligible email campaigns.
- **Product Element Specific:** Limits attribution to applicable product-focused campaigns.

Choose the option that matches how you want email purchases attributed in your reporting.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens if a contact interacts with multiple email campaigns?**

The most recent qualifying opened or clicked campaign within the attribution window receives credit for the eligible purchase.

**Q: What happens if the purchase occurs outside the attribution window?**

The purchase is not attributed to that email campaign under the configured attribution model.

**Q: Are Shopify orders included in email attribution?**

HighLevel documents that eligible orders reflected in Payments can be considered for attribution, including Shopify orders.

**Q: What is the difference between All Campaigns and Product Element Specific?**

**All Campaigns** allows attribution across eligible campaigns. **Product Element Specific** limits attribution to applicable product-focused email campaigns.

**Q: Is attributed revenue the same as ROI?**

No. Attributed revenue shows revenue credited to the campaign according to HighLevel's attribution rules. ROI requires cost or spend information in addition to revenue.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [A Guide to Email Attribution Settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001700)
- [Email Statistics - Summary Page](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006834)
- [Guide to Email Campaign Statistics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002176)
- [All-in-One Dashboard for Email Marketing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005552)
- [Click Performance in Email Statistics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006836)

title_en: How To Duplicate A Calendar
source_md:
Duplicating a calendar in HighLevel lets you instantly clone an existing scheduling setup. This article walks you through each step of copying an existing calendar and explains which elements carry over from the original calendar into the new one.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview of Duplicating Calendars](#Overview-of-Duplicating-Calendars)
  - [Key Benefits of Duplicating a Calendar](#Key-Benefits-of-Duplicating-a-Calendar)
  - [What Settings Get Duplicated](#What-Settings-Get-Duplicated)
  - [What Settings Do Not Get Duplicated](#What-Settings-Do-Not-Get-Duplicated)
  - [How To Duplicate a Calendar](#How-To-Duplicate-a-Calendar)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Overview of Duplicating Calendars**

Duplicating calendars creates a brand-new calendar that mirrors the configurations of an existing one. Rather than piecing together your availability, reminders and other settings from scratch, you can clone a proven setup with a single action. This ensures consistency in client experiences and saves valuable time when rolling out similar calendars for different staff, locations, or services.

---

## **Key Benefits of Duplicating a Calendar**

- **Time Savings:** Launch a fully configured calendar in minutes without manual reconfiguring settings
- **Uniform Experience:** Maintain consistent availability slots, meeting types, and communication styles across multiple calendars
- **Error Prevention:** Avoid missing critical details, like buffer times or cancellation policies, that can slip through manual setup
- **Flexible Scaling:** Easily spin up calendars for new team members, additional services, or test environments while preserving your original setup

---

## **What Settings Get Duplicated**

The following settings and configurations are automatically copied when you duplicate a calendar:

- **Meeting Details:** Calendar Logo; Calendar Name; Description; Group; Meeting Invite Title; Select Team Member & Assign Meeting Location; Meeting Color
- **Availability:** Weekly Available Hours; Look Busy Settings; Recurring Meeting Options; Slot Interval; Meeting Duration; Minimum Scheduling Notice; Date Range Restrictions; Maximum Bookings Per Day; Maximum Bookings Per Slot; Pre-Buffer Time; Post-Buffer Time
- **Forms & Payments:** Select Form; Widget Order; Pre-Populate Fields (Sticky Contacts); Consent Checkbox; Add Guests; Confirmation Page Settings; Meta Pixel; Auto-Confirm New Calendar Meetings; Payment Settings
- **Notifications & Additional Options:** Email & In-App Notifications; Google/Outlook Invitations; Assign Contacts to Respective Calendar; Skip Contacts if Already Assigned; Allow Rescheduling; Allow Cancellation; Meeting Invite Notes
- **Customizations:** Calendar Cover Image; Widget Style; Primary & Background Colors; Button Text; Calendar Title, Description, and Details; Custom Code

---

## **What Settings Do Not Get Duplicated**

Understanding which elements are excluded from duplication helps you configure the new calendar correctly:

- **Calendar Name:** The cloned calendar is automatically named **Copy of '[Original Name]'**. Update the name during setup to avoid confusion
- **Calendar ID:** A new, unique Calendar ID is generated for the duplicate
- **Calendar URL:** The duplicate’s URL is based on the original click link, with additional random numbers appended at the end
- **Workflow Automations:** Any triggers or workflows tied to the original calendar are not cloned and must be recreated or reassigned

---

## **How To Duplicate a Calendar**

Follow these steps to duplicate an existing calendar:

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Calendar Settings

- From the sub-account dashboard, select **Calendars**on the left-hand navigation bar
- Using the top navigation ribbon, click **Calendar Settings**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051070037/original/GeLYL0xHa27HXLXJDcEs4zFyXQkeDsoUOQ.png?1754514961)**

#### **Step 2:**Select Calendar

- Click the **3 Dot**iconnext to the calendar you would like to duplicate
- Select **Duplicate**and confirm in the popup

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051070106/original/y22sJbotThZHuOVqzpgIKt2aEt7ymI-hVA.png?1754515179)

#### **Step****3:**Review New Calendar

- The new calendar will automatically be named "Copy of [Original Name]". Update the name to avoid confusion
- Inspect every setting, from availability windows and buffer times to meeting locations and notification templates, to ensure they match your needs
- Once the calendar is configured correctly, click the blue **Save**button in the upper right corner

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051070237/original/bnpbLryZvGkqjlg9W5MaApk5Tu78AsIevA.png?1754515588)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I duplicate any calendar type (Round-Robin, Class, Event)?**  
All calendar types support duplication and inherit their unique configurations.

**Q: Are workflows or automations duplicated too?**  
A: No, workflows must be recreated or reassigned to the new calendar manually.

**Q: Will existing booking links redirect to the new calendar?**  
No. The booking link from the original calendar remains tied to that calendar and continues pointing to it. The duplicate generates its own unique booking link.

**Q: Will the calendar’s time zone settings carry over?**  
Yes, the duplicate calendar retains the same time zone configuration as the original, ensuring bookings display at the correct local time.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Calendar: Email & In-App Appointment Notifications](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003441)
- [Getting Started – Set Up a Booking Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005061)
- [Integrating Google with HighLevel Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002369)
- [Integrating Outlook with HighLevel Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002371)
- [Adding Unassigned Calendars to Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003550)
- [Setting Up Linked & Conflict Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002374)

title_en: Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode
source_md:
Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode allow agencies to integrate their preferred payment providers via the App Marketplace. This flexibility empowers global SaaS onboarding and billing, especially in regions where native integrations like Stripe or Square are limited.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode?](#What-are-Custom-Payment-Providers-in-SaaS-Mode?)
- [Key Benefits of Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode](#Key-Benefits-of-Custom-Payment-Providers-in-SaaS-Mode)
- [Set up SaaS Mode with Custom Payment Providers](#Set-up-SaaS-Mode-with-Custom-Payment-Providers)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What are Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode?**

Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode empower agencies to select and integrate the payment provider that best fits their market needs. By leveraging this feature, agencies can automate sub-account creation during checkout, attach SaaS plans seamlessly, and manage recurring billing and wallet recharges, all while tapping into a diverse range of global payment solutions.

---

## **Key Benefits of Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode**

This feature drives efficiency and global reach by providing a tailored payment experience for SaaS businesses.

- Offers agencies the flexibility to choose from 50+ payment providers in the Marketplace.
- Unlocks global adoption in regions underserved by native payment integrations.
- Automates sub-account creation and seamless SaaS plan attachment during checkout.
- Supports recurring subscription billing to maintain reliable revenue streams.
- Enhances the Marketplace ecosystem by enabling add-on reselling.

---

## **Set up SaaS Mode with Custom Payment Providers**

Getting set up is a straightforward process that ensures your custom payment integration is ready to drive global SaaS success.

### **Step 1:** Mark an Agency Sub-Account

- From the **Agency View**, go to **Sub-Accounts**.
- Find the sub-account you want to use as your agency’s billing account.
- Click the **three-dots menu → Add as agency sub-account**.
- This sub-account will now serve as your **Agency Sub-Account**, where you’ll install payment providers, create SaaS products, and handle checkouts.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056921337/original/LWLQQPbkMalmRdgDJ39NCmpIFLh0TzYkxg.png?1761575862)

### **Step 2:** Install a Payment Provider App

- Go to the **App Marketplace** from your agency view.
- Search for and select the **payment provider app** you’d like to use. You can also search for payment providers under categories.
- Click **Install** and add it to your agency sub-account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056921626/original/HaOjaK-tIxCyJ_Bel4ZZ_ikT6rQyMDxhhQ.png?1761576036)

### **Step 3:** Configure the Integration

- After installation, go to the provider’s settings.
- Enter the required details, typically:
  - Account ID
  - Authorization / API token
- Save your configuration.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053365365/original/0M65QOepAKgw76Q7RwQaCZojvzksg_cIAw.png?1757412905)**

```
Note: Each provider’s requirements may vary slightly. Refer to the app’s documentation for exact fields.
```

### **Step 4:**Create and Sell SaaS Products

- In the Agency Sub-Account, create a SaaS product.
- Share the payment link or embed the checkout in funnels.
- On successful checkout:
  - A new sub-account is automatically created.
  - The selected SaaS plan is attached to it.

For more, refer to [Getting started with SaaS Configurator](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008015-getting-started-with-the-saas-configurator).

### **Step 5:**Convert Existing Sub-Accounts to SaaS

- From Agency View, go to Sub-Accounts → Manage Client.
- Navigate to SaaS → Add SaaS Subscription.
- Select the integrated payment provider.
- Choose the SaaS plan to apply, then confirm.

For more, refer to [Convert Existing Sub-Account to SaaS Mode Subscription Plan](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001188055-convert-existing-sub-account-to-saas-mode-subscription-plan)

```
Note: If the SaaS plan remains On Hold because payment has not been completed, an Agency Admin can detach the pending plan from Agency View → Sub-Accounts → Manage Client → SaaS without disabling SaaS Mode. Detaching the pending plan restores sub-account access while keeping the existing customer profile attached.
```

### **Step 6:** Wallet & Add-On Handling

- **Wallet Top-Ups**: Supports both auto-recharge and manual recharge.
- **Add-On Reselling**:  
    
  - Add-ons like AI Employee, WordPress, and Marketplace Apps can be sold.
  - Payment for add-ons is deducted from the sub-account wallet (not charged directly to the card).

For more, refer to  [SaaS Wallet Credit Management - Sub Account Level](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001207115-saas-wallet-credit-management-sub-account-level)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What are Custom Payment Providers in SaaS Mode, and why are they important?**

This feature lets agencies integrate their chosen payment provider to automate tasks such as account creation, recurring billing, and wallet management—enhancing flexibility in global SaaS deployments.

**Q: Which payment providers are compatible with this feature?**

Only providers that support recurring payments and off-session charging are compatible. Providers like Razorpay, which do not support these functionalities, are not supported.

**Q: How does recurring subscription billing work with a custom payment provider?**

Once set up, the system securely stores customer payment methods and automatically processes recurring charges for SaaS plans, ensuring uninterrupted service and revenue flow.

**Q: Can I convert an existing sub-account to use a custom payment provider?**

Yes. Existing sub-accounts can be converted by navigating to Agency → Sub-Accounts → Manage Client → SaaS → Add SaaS Subscription and selecting the integrated payment provider along with the desired plan.

**Q: Where can I find additional setup guidance?**

For more detailed instructions, please refer to HighLevel’s support documentation on Custom Payment Providers.

title_en: How to Set Up WordPress Hosting for Clients
source_md:
# 

HighLevel WordPress Hosting lets agencies create, migrate, and manage WordPress websites for client sub-accounts directly inside HighLevel.

This article explains how to create a WordPress site, give the appropriate users access, manage domains, backups, and advanced settings, and understand which features are available to agency users versus client users.

---

LeadConnector plugin (auto-installed on new hosted sites)

If your WordPress site is newly provisioned via HighLevel Hosting, HighLevel automatically installs the LeadConnector (LC) plugin during setup.

Use the Plugin Status indicator in your HighLevel WordPress dashboard to confirm whether the plugin is Connected or Disconnected.

### Setting up a new WordPress Site

1. To set up your WordPress site, you need to have purchased the WordPress hosting feature under the Sites tab. Once this has been done, you can get started by clicking the "+ Create Site" button.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587928/original/5Dc4BJsxtu_DvAlMygRPzMuPN4sLu-EkxQ.png?1783584600)
2. Choose if you wish to create a site from scratch, using a template, or clone an existing site  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587930/original/eSUQEFHq52gbTLuSCTOJSE4Z-oqsjejI_g.png?1783584600)
3. Fill in the Site and User details.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587926/original/vEsIn1DAW6-DYhUrwUGYeTvVL46G97xbzA.png?1783584600)

Wait for 2-5 minutes till the installation is complete.

4. After the installation is complete, you will have access to the WordPress dashboard, user management, backup & restore, and some additional settings.

### The WordPress Dashboard

Here you can access your site and admin portal, as well as manage your Additional Domains & Primary Domain.

Moving an existing site? Import an existing WordPress site seamlessly using our proprietary LC Migrator plugin, or take advantage of our free white-glove migration assistance.

You can also effortlessly Refresh Cache for the WordPress Site directly from this dashboard.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587932/original/nlEHid7iuHVt02AiKjuC-BltphjqAOSigg.png?1783584601)

### User Management

Here you can manage all users for the site.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587925/original/-SB9KXnAOwAL5pslun_fZC8vBlsX_EZS1Q.png?1783584600)

### Backup & Restore

Here you will see the backups for the last 30 days. Backups happen daily at 05:00 AM CST.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587934/original/-P52sspFbXASQA4_baupzvycSDlCE_1LkA.png?1783584601)

You can also initiate manual backups as needed as shown in the video below:

More Tutorials from the Community:

- https://youtu.be/zvfav4EXnE4
- https://youtu.be/7z9A0d4Ml4c
- https://youtu.be/ROQLp8\_D8Vc

### Advanced Settings

1. You can manage FTP Access and Communication Settings here.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587927/original/w-ymw15A09GbO1WRRD-HsnKmM3bw36xV6w.png?1783584600)
2. Cache Management can be accessed from Advanced Settings.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587933/original/Vs_yXRARxytJOOcBF9g90fRIoS2wtfDJGA.png?1783584601)
3. Enable or disable WordPress Debugging: Utilize this tool to access PHP error messages, warnings, notices, and other developer-related notifications on your website.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587931/original/KImBDfvvgutg8WrZK02L3mBl87Ebgm1hRg.png?1783584600)
4. Server Settings: Manage your WordPress Database using phpMyAdmin.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155075587929/original/0MkPak1ziSXw6lLLq6SQIzV8YcY87usARA.png?1783584600)

### Adding an Additional Domain

Once your site is ready to publish, you can connect your domain to the WordPress site.

Please follow our dedicated article for instructions on connecting your domain with the WordPress site.

### Common Issues & Troubleshooting

1. Plugin not installing

- Confirm you have admin access
- Check hosting restrictions

2. Site not displaying widgets

- Clear cache (plugin/server/CDN)
- Disable conflicting plugins temporarily

3. Connection errors

- Recheck credentials
- Ensure the correct location/account is selected in HighLevel

### Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I'm unable to add the same domain to my other subaccount/location.

A: The same domain/subdomain can't be used in 2 locations simultaneously.

Q: Why can't I update my primary domain?

A: The primary domain can be updated if you have successfully added an additional domain first.

Q: I've added the A / CNAME record, but the domain is still not being added.

A: This can happen due to a few reasons:

- There is a typo in your domain name: In this scenario, fixing the typo will resolve your issue.
- Your DNS changes haven't been propagated yet: In this case, you must wait longer and try again after a few hours or the next day to see if it works.
- Your DNS configuration is not set up correctly: Please get in touch with your Domain Provider and discuss the errors with their support team.
- Multiple conflicting records: Maybe you have conflicting records for the same subdomain (for example, if blog.mydomain.com has a CNAME record pointing to wp3.msgsndr.com but it also has an A record pointing to some other provider). In such cases, removing the duplicate record will fix your issue.

Q: I can't connect my root domain (ex., mydomain.com).

A: Please make sure there are no additional A, AAAA, TXT records, etc. if you plan to use that slug/root domain for WordPress.

Q: How many WordPress sites can I have per sub-account?

A: You can have as many sites as you wish under a single account, there are no limitations! :)

Q: How can I request to cancel a client's WordPress subscription?

A: To begin a WordPress Cancellation Request, you must navigate to "Delete Site" under the Advanced settings of your WordPress Dashboard.

title_en: Set Expiry Dates and Reminder Emails for Certificates and Badges
source_md:
You can control how long certificates and badges remain valid and notify recipients as their credentials approach expiration. You can configure the expiry period and pre-expiry reminder emails directly from the Credentials dashboard.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Credential Expiry for Certificates and Badges?](#What-is-Credential-Expiry-for-Certificates-and-Badges?)
- [Key Benefits of Credential Expiry and Reminders](#%E2%80%8BKey-Benefits-of-Credential-Expiry-and-Reminders)
- [How to Set Expiry Dates for Certificates and Badges](#How-to-Set-Expiry-Dates-for-Certificates-and-Badges)
- [How to Set Expiry Reminder Emails](#How-to-Set-Expiry-Reminder-Emails)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#%E2%80%8BRelated-Articles)

---

# **What is Credential Expiry for Certificates and Badges?**

Credential expiry lets you define how long a certificate or badge remains valid after it is issued. Applying an expiry period helps you manage credentials that require periodic renewal, while reminder emails can notify recipients before their credential expires.

Credential expiry and reminder settings are managed from the **Set Expiry** option for certificate and badge templates in the Credentials dashboard.

---

## **Key Benefits of Credential Expiry and Reminders**

- **Flexible Expiry Periods:** Choose from predefined expiry periods, set a custom expiry period, or allow a credential to remain valid indefinitely.
- **Automated Expiry Notifications:** Notify recipients automatically when their certificate or badge expires.
- **Custom Reminder Timing:** Choose how many days before expiry recipients should receive reminder emails.
- **Multiple Pre-Expiry Reminders:** Configure up to two reminder emails before a credential expires.
- **Centralized Management:** Manage expiry dates and reminder settings directly from the Credentials dashboard.

---

## **How to Set Expiry Dates for Certificates and Badges**

Setting an expiry period determines how long credentials created from a certificate or badge template remain valid. Choose an expiry option that matches your certification, training, compliance, or renewal requirements.

```
Note: Selecting Never keeps credentials created from the template valid indefinitely unless an expiry setting is applied at the individual issued-credential level.
```

1. Go to **Memberships > Credentials > Dashboard**.
2. Locate the **Templates/Issued Certificates/Badges** section.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/C7QL7oVOirtC1aeJ4FjK+/Screenshot+2026-09-17+at+14.38.29.png)
3. **Find** the **certificate** or **badge** **template** for which you want to **configure** **expiry**.
4. Click the **three-dot menu** next to the template.
5. Select **Set Expiry**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/rlp80jzHlsYcZY2O2zio+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-17+at+14.43.17.png)
6. **Select** the **required** **expiry** **option**.  
     
   Available options include:  
     
   - **Never** — The credential remains valid indefinitely and does not expire.
   - **3 Months**
   - **6 Months**
   - **9 Months**
   - **1 Year**
   - **2 Years**
   - **3 Years**
   - **4 Years**
   - **5 Years**
   - **Custom** — Set a custom expiry period based on your requirements.
7. Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vLA9RWTwzGbY9or6FX0R+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-17+at+14.45.01.png)

---

## **How to Set Expiry Reminder Emails**

Expiry reminder emails help recipients prepare for an upcoming credential expiration. HighLevel sends an email on the expiry date and also allows you to configure up to two additional reminders before the certificate or badge expires.

```
Important: An expiry notification email is sent on the day the credential expires. The timing of this expiry-day email cannot be changed.

Note: Reminder Email 1 and Reminder Email 2 are optional. When a reminder is enabled, specify how many days before expiry it should be sent.
```

After selecting an expiry period in the **Set Expiry** window:

1. Locate the expiry reminder email settings.
2. Enable **Reminder Email 1** if you want to send the first reminder before expiry.
3. Enter the number of days before the credential expires when the reminder should be sent.
4. Enable **Reminder Email 2** if you want to send an additional reminder.
5. Enter the number of days before expiry when the second reminder should be sent.
6. Disable either reminder if you do not want that reminder to be sent.
7. Click **Save** to apply the expiry and reminder settings.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/2yc2ziv12LvS8SExTBix+/GIF+Recording+2026-09-17+at+14.49.11.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can a certificate or badge be configured so it never expires?**  
Yes. Select **Never** when configuring the expiry settings to keep the credential valid indefinitely.

**Q: How many reminder emails can I send before a credential expires?**  
You can configure up to two pre-expiry reminder emails and specify how many days before expiry each reminder should be sent.

**Q: Can I disable one of the pre-expiry reminder emails?**  
Yes. Each pre-expiry reminder can be enabled or disabled independently.

**Q: Can I change when the email sent on the expiry date is delivered?**  
No. The expiry notification is sent on the day the credential expires, and its timing cannot be changed.

**Q: Can an individual issued certificate have a different expiry setting from its template?**  
Yes. HighLevel supports expiry settings at both the template and issued-certificate levels. The issued certificate's expiry setting takes priority over the template-level expiry.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [HighLevel Credentials Preview: Memberships](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006270-highlevel-credentials-preview-memberships?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

- [How to Download and Share Certificates & Badges](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005181-how-to-download-share-certificates-badges?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: How to Use Spintax for Email Variations in HighLevel
source_md:
Create personalized email variations automatically using Spintax in HighLevel. Spintax lets you rotate words, phrases, or sentences within a single email template, making your messages less repetitive.

This guide explains how to use Spintax, combine it with merge fields and Custom Values, and test your emails before sending.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Spintax](#What-is-Spintax)
- [Why Use Spintax?](#Why-Use-Spintax?)
- [Spintax and Email Deliverability](#Spintax-and-Email-Deliverability)
- [Spintax Syntax and Examples](#Spintax-Syntax-and-Examples)
- [How to Use Spintax in Emails](#How-to-Use-Spintax-in-Emails)
- [Using Custom Values Inside Spintax](#Using-Custom-Values-Inside-Spintax)
- [Important Considerations](#Important-Considerations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is Spintax**

Spintax is a text-formatting feature that generates different versions of email content from a single template. HighLevel randomly selects one of the available text options when the message is sent, allowing you to create varied messages without writing separate emails.

Spintax can be used in almost all email builders, across :

- Conversations
- Bulk Actions
- Workflows
- Email Builder

---

## **Why Use Spintax?**

Spintax is especially useful for cold email outreach, follow-ups, appointment reminders, and automated conversations. Spintax helps you in:

- Create unique message variations automatically
- Reduce repetitive content across campaigns
- Personalize messages at scale
- Test different messaging styles
- Improve engagement with more natural communication

---

## **Spintax and Email Deliverability**

When every recipient receives the exact same email, mailbox providers may identify the content as highly repetitive.

Spintax helps create variations in your messages by rotating words, phrases, and sentences. This can help reduce content uniformity across large campaigns.

For example, instead of sending: Hey {{contact.firstname}}, you can use - {**SPIN**| Hi|Hello|Hey}

#### 

#### **Important**

Spintax should be used thoughtfully. Modern email providers can recognize simple word substitutions, so changing only greetings may have limited impact.

For the best results:

- Spin complete phrases or sentences instead of single words.
- Combine Spintax with personalization and Custom Values.
- Keep all variations natural and conversational.
- Use Spintax to support testing and content variation, not as a replacement for good email practices.

---

## **Spintax Syntax and Examples**

Spintax uses curly braces, the `SPIN` keyword, and vertical bars (`|`) to separate text options. HighLevel randomly selects one option whenever the message is sent.

**Basic Syntax:**

`{SPIN|Hello|Hi|Hey}`

**Possible Outputs:**

- Hello
- Hi
- Hey

You can also combine Spintax with contact merge fields to personalize emails.

**Example:**

`{SPIN|Hello|Hi|Hey} {{contact.first_name}},`

**Possible Outputs:**

- Hello Sarah,
- Hi Sarah,
- Hey Sarah,

**Note:** Each Spintax block returns one randomly selected option. Use complete phrases or sentences when you need more meaningful content variations.

---

## **How to Use Spintax in Emails**

HighLevel supports Spintax in email content created through Conversations, Bulk Actions, Workflows, and Email Builder.

1. Open the email editor in HighLevel
2. Add your content variations inside curly braces after the keyword **"****SPIN"** `{SPIN|}` and separate each option with a pipe

   Example:

   {**SPIN**|Hey|Hello|Hi} {{contact.first\_name}}

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073131268/original/x067rUmLsZWN3ws9aHhTx0L32G1dosVfDQ.png?1780912219)
3. Save your message or template.
4. When the message is sent, HighLevel automatically selects one of the options at random.

---

## **Using Custom Values Inside Spintax**

You can include Contact Fields and Custom Values directly within your Spintax variations. Each variation can contain different merge fields, allowing you to personalize messages in multiple ways.

**Example: {SPIN | Hi {{contact.firstname}} | Hi {{contact.lastname}}}**

Possible outputs:

- Hi John
- Hi Smith

You can also use Custom Values within your variations:  
**{SPIN | Learn more about {{customvalue1}} | See how {{customvalue2}} can help your business}**

Possible outputs:

- Learn more about Website Design
- See how Website Design can help your business

**Tip:** Each variation can contain different text, Contact Fields, or Custom Values, giving you greater flexibility when personalizing emails.

---

## **Important Considerations**

Following Spintax formatting and email best practices helps ensure your content is generated and displayed correctly.

- **Correct Syntax:** Use `{SPIN|Option 1|Option 2}` with the correct braces and separators.
- **Random Selection:** HighLevel selects one option when sending. Different recipients may receive the same variation.
- **Supported Editors:** Spintax is documented for email content in Conversations, Bulk Actions, Workflows, and Email Builder.
- **Merge Fields:** Use the field picker to insert supported merge fields and avoid formatting errors.
- **Testing:** Preview and test your emails before launching campaigns. Preview tools may not display every possible Spintax variation.
- **Deliverability:** Spintax does not guarantee inbox placement or replace sender authentication and good email-sending practices.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use multiple Spintax blocks in one email?**

Yes. You can add separate Spintax blocks to different parts of your email, such as greetings, introductions, and calls to action.

**Q: Will every recipient receive a different email variation?**

Not necessarily. HighLevel randomly selects from the available options, so multiple recipients may receive the same variation.

**Q: Can I use Spintax with contact names and Custom Values?**

Yes. Spintax supports contact merge fields and Custom Values in supported email content.

**Q: Does Spintax prevent emails from going to spam?**

No. Spintax creates content variations but does not guarantee email deliverability. Sender reputation, authentication, list quality, and engagement also affect inbox placement.

title_en: Integrated Onboarding for Snapshots

- **Embedded micro-learning:** Watch short videos or jump to help docs from within the Snapshot module to stay focused on the task.
- **Consistent ramp-up for teams:** Give every new teammate a predictable path to learn Snapshot basics, reducing support and training time.
