This feature is designed for businesses with multiple branches or offices. To enable this: 1. Go to **Calendar Settings > Services**. 2. Under **Global Settings**, toggle on **Enable Multiple Locations**. 3. Once activated, you can add more locations under the **Locations tab**. ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054380709/original/D81sA1XuUhH-V0APmqA3W3e-23N1Rz935Q.png?1758628479) --- ## **How Location Details Appear in Mobile Service v2 Appointments** Configured location details are used throughout the booking experience, including the mobile appointment view. Clear location display helps staff and customers act faster when an appointment is tied to a physical address or a virtual meeting link. In mobile Service v2 appointments, location details can display as: - a full physical address - a virtual meeting URL - a location name when a full address is not available Depending on the appointment type, mobile users can also copy the displayed location value and use quick actions such as View Location or Join Meeting. For the mobile appointment workflow, refer to Manage Service v2 Appointments in the Mobile App. --- ## How to Add New Locations After enabling multiple locations, you can add new ones by following these steps: 1. Navigate to the **Locations tab**. 2. Click **Add New**. 3. Upload a location image (this will appear on the booking page). 4. Enter the location name, phone number, and address. 5. Click **Save Location**. **Note:** Online locations (e.g., Zoom, Google Meet) are not yet directly supported. As a workaround, you can generate a static video conferencing link and enter it in the **Address** field. ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054381074/original/dr9KM_9SWByEeO_BHq7_W7HEd3QbZPmDrg.png?1758628631) ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054381101/original/54DUoY3wcIi_1KBs3OuFWfnAhYHtnPweuA.png?1758628659) --- ## Setting Staff Availability for Locations Once locations are created, you need to configure **staff availability** so that services are properly assigned to the correct locations. To set this up: 1. Go to **Calendar Settings > Services >****Staff > Edit a staff member**. 2. Navigate to the **Assign Services** tab and assign the required services. 3. Then, navigate to the **Weekly Working Hours** tab. 4. Add the staff member’s working hours based on their availability for a particular service at a specific location. Staff members can be assigned to multiple locations with different schedules, giving flexibility in how services are offered. ⚠️ **Important:** For locations to appear during the booking process, they must be linked to staff availability in the **Staff Settings**. ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054381772/original/cKgg8nUEREa8Qq0qvgDCIKlq0laRrKd2DQ.png?1758629005) --- ## FAQs **1. Do I need to create a location if I only operate from one place?** No. A default location is automatically created using the address in your **Business Profile**. You only need to create new locations if you operate from multiple places. **2. Can I edit the default location?** Yes. Go to **Calendar Settings > Services > Locations tab**, click **Edit**, and update the details. **3. Can I use an online location like Zoom or Google Meet?** Online locations are not directly supported yet. However, you can paste a static video conferencing link (e.g., Zoom, Google Meet) in the **Address** field as a workaround. **4. What happens if I don’t assign staff availability to a location?** If staff availability is not linked to a location, that location will not appear as an option during the booking process. **5. Can staff members work in multiple locations?** Yes. Staff can be assigned to more than one location with different schedules, giving you flexibility across branches. **6. Where will customers see the location information?** Customers will see the selected location details (including the image, name, and address) on the booking page and in their appointment confirmation. **7. Can I delete a location?** Yes, you can delete additional locations created in your account. **However, the default location cannot be deleted**. You can only edit its details if needed.

title_en: Show Popup on Entering Funnel/Website
source_md:
This article explains how to configure a popup to appear automatically after a visitor lands on a Funnel or Website page. HighLevel supports multiple popups on the same page, and each popup can have its own trigger, including a time delay. This feature helps boost conversions by capturing attention right away—without waiting for the user to click or scroll.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is a Popup That Shows on Page Load?](#What-Is-a-Popup-That-Shows-on-Page-Load?)
- [Key Benefits of Using a Page Load Popup](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-a-Page-Load-Popup)
- [How to Set a Popup to Show on Page Load](#How-to-Set-a-Popup-to-Show-on-Page-Load)
  - [Step 1: Navigate to the Popup](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Navigate-to-the-Popup)
  - [Step 2: Configure the Popup Settings](#Step-2%3A-Configure-the-Popup-Settings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is a Popup That Shows on Page Load?**

A page load popup is a type of message or form that automatically appears shortly after a visitor arrives on your website or funnel page—without them clicking or scrolling. This kind of popup is triggered by a timing setting (like a 2-second delay) and is used to grab the visitor’s attention right away. It’s commonly used to promote time-sensitive offers, capture leads, or display welcome messages that encourage action early in the visit. If a page contains multiple popups, the delay is configured separately for each popup.

---

## **Key Benefits of Using a Page Load Popup**

- **Automation:**Automatically launch popups without requiring the user to click anything.
- **Lead generation:**Perfect for growing email lists or offering limited-time deals the moment a user lands.
- **Conversion optimization:**Use immediate popups to boost funnel conversions with time-sensitive CTAs.
- **Behavior targeting:**Choose exactly when the popup should appear with a customizable delay timer.
- **Broad compatibility:**Works on both Funnels and Websites inside the HighLevel platform.

---

## **How to Set a Popup to Show on Page Load**

HighLevel supports multiple popups on the same Funnel or Website page. Each popup can have its own content, styling, and trigger.

Available trigger options include:

- **Delay** — displays the popup after the configured number of seconds.
- **Exit Intent** — displays the popup when desktop cursor behavior indicates that the visitor may be leaving the page.
- **None** — keeps the popup available for manual triggers, such as a button, image, or text link.

If multiple popups use the same trigger condition, the popup with the higher priority in the Popup Settings panel appears first.

Follow these steps to configure a popup that automatically appears after a user lands on a page.

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Popup Settings

- In the left-hand menu of your sub-account dashboard, click on **Sites**. Then choose either Funnels or Websites tab in the upper navigation bar.
- Open your chosen funnel or website and click on the specific step or page where the popup should be added.
- Click the blue button labeled **Edit** to launch the page editor.
- In the top menu bar of the website builder, click the **Popup****Settings** icon to open the popup settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046955271/original/a195Uqak0HIUOVjM8Ts8xT_xMOhgN_OkgQ.png?1747767733)

**Step 2:** Configure the Popup Settings

- In the Popup Settings panel, select the popup you want to configure. Open its Settings tab, then under Show Popup On, select Delay.
- Enter the number of seconds to wait before the popup appears.
- Save or publish the page after configuring the popup.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046955315/original/bpbwilGX2PGqGsAk5ylcztjZsUhBKkVMKA.png?1747767821)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

****Q: Can I set the popup to show only once per visit or session?****HighLevel’s documented popup settings currently focus on trigger types such as Delay, Exit Intent, and manual triggers. Session-level display limits are not documented in the current popup setup flow.

**Q: What if I want the popup to show when someone tries to leave?**  
Use the **Exit / Exit Intent** trigger under **Show Popup On** to display the popup when desktop cursor behavior indicates that the visitor may be leaving the page.

```
Note: Exit-intent detection uses mouse cursor movement, so it works on desktop and does not function the same way on mobile touchscreens.
```

**Q: Can I use this on both Funnels and Websites?**  
Yes. Popup triggers are supported in both Funnels and Websites within the HighLevel Page Builder.

**Q: What happens if the popup is opened manually before the delay time is reached?**  
If the same popup is opened manually before the delay timer finishes, the delayed display is canceled for that page view. This prevents the popup from appearing twice.

**Q: Can I use more than one popup on the same page?**  
Yes. HighLevel supports multiple popups on the same Funnel or Website page. Each popup can have its own content, styling, and trigger.

**Q: What happens if multiple popups use the same trigger?**  
If multiple popups use the same trigger condition, the popup with the higher priority in the Popup Settings panel appears first.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Create an Exit-Intent Pop-Up in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004553)
- [Sites Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001633)

title_en: Add Conversation AI & Chat Widgets to Funnels & Website
source_md:
HighLevel makes it easy to add chat widgets and set up Conversation AI directly within the funnel and website builder. You can add an existing widget or create a new one, automatically train an AI agent using your funnel content, and connect it to your widget without custom code. This streamlined process helps you launch AI-powered conversations faster while keeping full control over your agent's settings.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview of the AI & Chat Widget Element](#Overview-of-the-AI-&-Chat-Widget-Element)
- [How to Add a Chat Widget and Set Up Conversation AI](#How-to-Add-a-Chat-Widget-and-Set-Up-Conversation-AI)
- [Managing Your Conversation AI Agent](#Managing-Your-Conversation-AI-Agent)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Overview of the AI & Chat Widget Element**

The AI And Chat Widget element combines chat widget placement and Conversation AI setup into one workflow. You can create or select a chat widget, automatically configure an AI agent, train it using your funnel content, and connect it to the widget without custom code.

With Scan & auto-configure, HighLevel scans the pages in your funnel, identifies your business information, and automatically generates an AI agent with:

- **Knowledge Base:** Content collected from your funnel pages to answer visitor questions.
- **Personality:** A communication style and tone based on your business.
- **Goals:** Objectives that guide the agent's conversations.
- **Instructions:** Behavioral guidelines and relevant business details, such as operating hours.
- **Opening Message:** An automatically generated greeting for visitors.

The agent is connected to your selected chat widget when configuration is complete. You can also connect an existing Conversation AI agent instead of generating a new one.

---

## **How to Add a Chat Widget and Set Up Conversation AI**

The **AI And Chat Widget** element lets you add chat widgets and configure Conversation AI without leaving the funnel or website builder. HighLevel completes the agent configuration in the background, allowing you to continue editing while the setup runs.

1. Open your funnel or website in the builder and navigate to **Add Elements → AI And Chat Widget**.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255840/original/nu6fMgX58xfF6wOsW3HuF7FzVboZaffI_A.png?1793055426)*
2. Under the **Chat widgets** tab, select an existing widget to add it to the page, or click **Create new chat widget** and select **Live Chat** to create a widget for Conversation AI. Click a selected chat widget again to remove it from the page.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255833/original/YzqWAxW931V6GmBmYD96B-Ycw2CATg4WPw.png?1793055413)*
3. Open the **AI agents** tab and click **Setup Conversation AI**. If you already have a Conversation AI agent, you can connect it instead of creating a new one with Scan & auto-configure.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255852/original/-VXT0oEh5QGCYxFJrcz2eNb0WgXMlhYpsA.png?1793055471)*
4. Review the detected funnel pages and click **Scan & auto-configure** to create a new agent..

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255861/original/9Q2plYeO_jQ4drKzM7ug2_kgiCRaK-kj2g.png?1793055493)*
5. HighLevel will configure your agent in the background. You can return to the builder and continue editing your funnel while the setup completes.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255866/original/uTqimKp2X-F_2D2ZirzRU7hvLBDhnRpykw.png?1793055508)*
6. Once **Conversation AI is live!** appears, click **Manage agent** to review the automatically generated configuration.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255870/original/lutAlYJAhm00LUsPMHHCKYTceMeNdmUIHQ.png?1793055525)*
7. Review the agent's settings, save any changes, and publish your funnel or website.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255871/original/fVR2W7iSRPL_J_hNKGNLFN_5MEpGZPYGmg.png?1793055542)*

---

## **Managing Your Conversation AI Agent**

After setup, you can review and customize your generated agent to ensure it accurately represents your business. From **Manage agent**, you can update its personality, goals, instructions, and knowledge base content.

You can also test the agent's responses before publishing your funnel or website and manage its trained content as your business information changes.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084255877/original/WARpgJLHi4uWaEiKCs3G1fMea7ib7SLheg.png?1793055581)*

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started with Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004102)
- [Getting Started – Set Up a Live Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005067)
- [How to Manage Conversation AI Bot Channels and Routing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008266)
- [Training Your Conversation AI Bot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008470)
- [Review and Edit Website Content Used by Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003215)
- [Auto Refresh of Knowledge Base Trained Links](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006539)

title_en: Connect TikTok in Social Planner
source_md:
Connect your TikTok Personal or Business account to HighLevel Social Planner to easily create, schedule, and publish videos. This guide walks you through connecting your TikTok account and managing supported features, including Post Sync and Comment Management.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is TikTok Integration in Social Planner?](#What-is-TikTok-Integration-in-Social-Planner?)
- [Key Benefits of Connecting TikTok to Social Planner](#Key-Benefits-of-Connecting-TikTok-to-Social-Planner)
- [TikTok Personal and Business Accounts](#TikTok-Personal-and-Business-Accounts)
- [How to Connect TikTok to Social Planner](#How-to-Connect-TikTok-to-Social-Planner)
- [TikTok Post Sync and Comment Management](#TikTok-Post-Sync-and-Comment-Management)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is TikTok Integration in Social Planner?**

Connecting TikTok to HighLevel Social Planner allows you to create, schedule, and publish TikTok videos from one place. You can connect a TikTok Personal or Business account and manage your content alongside other social media platforms.

## **Key Benefits of Connecting TikTok to Social Planner**

Connecting TikTok makes it easier to plan and manage your content without switching between platforms.

- **Easy Publishing:** Create, schedule, and publish TikTok videos directly from Social Planner.
- **Centralized Management:** Manage TikTok alongside other connected social accounts.
- **Post Sync:** Import previously published TikTok videos into Social Planner.
- **Comment Management:** View and reply to supported comments using a TikTok Business Profile.

---

## **TikTok Personal and Business Accounts**

Social Planner supports both TikTok Personal and Business accounts. While both account types support video publishing and scheduling, some features require a Business Profile.

| Feature | Personal | Business |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Video Publishing and Scheduling | Yes | Yes |
| Post Sync | Yes | Yes |
| Comment Management | No | Yes |

**Important:** TikTok Comment Management is available only for Business Profiles and supports comments on posts published through Social Planner.

---

## **How to Connect TikTok to Social Planner**

Connecting your TikTok account authorizes HighLevel to publish and manage supported TikTok content. Follow these steps to complete the connection.

**Step 1:** Navigate to **Marketing → Social Planner** in your HighLevel sub-account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084740152/original/GxEqt7VAGj1ErN57HZ10TUPCNNrkI2CL9Q.png?1793623079)

**Step 2:** If you're connecting your first social account, use the initial setup wizard. Otherwise, navigate to**→ Socials → + Connect Social,**and select **Connect TikTok.**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084749311/original/g0TNt6SPKD1atKNxptEPbCSm_mxYT-Lzbg.gif?1793627727)**

**Step 3:** Sign in to your TikTok account and approve the requested permissions.

Select your TikTok profile and complete the connection.

**Step 4:** Return to **Social Planner → Settings → Social Accounts** to confirm that your TikTok account is connected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084749469/original/6odyCkswBvF6O3k-7su1zdCXVVIQeG780Q.png?1793627815)

```
Note: If your TikTok account becomes disconnected, follow the Re-integrate prompt to restore access.
```

---

## **TikTok Post Sync and Comment Management**

Once TikTok is connected, you can enable additional features to manage existing content and audience engagement.

- **Post Sync:** Navigate to **Social Planner → Settings → Social Accounts**, locate your TikTok account, and enable **Sync posts** to import previously published videos.
- **Comment Management:** TikTok Business Profiles can view and respond to supported comments on posts published through Social Planner.

For additional details, see [Social Planner - Post Sync](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007733-social-planner-instagram-post-sync) and [Social Planner - Manage Comments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006433-manage-comments-in-social-planner).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I connect a TikTok Personal account?**

Yes. Both TikTok Personal and Business accounts are supported.

**Q: Why can't I manage TikTok comments in Social Planner?**

Comment Management requires a TikTok Business Profile and supports comments on posts published through Social Planner.

**Q: Will my existing TikTok videos appear automatically?**

No. Enable **Sync posts** for your connected TikTok account to import supported previously published videos.

**Q: What should I do if my TikTok account disconnects?**

Open Social Planner and use the **Re-integrate** option when prompted to reconnect your account.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Setup Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005063-launchpad-setup-social-planner)
- [Social Post on TikTok](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001554-direct-posting-for-tiktok-forget-push-notifications)
- [Social Planner - Manage Comments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006433-manage-comments-in-social-planner)
- [Social Planner - Post Sync](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007733-social-planner-instagram-post-sync)

title_en: Voice AI for Whatsapp Calls
source_md:
Voice AI can now answer incoming WhatsApp calls in HighLevel, helping businesses respond to customers when their team is busy or unavailable. You can choose whether calls are answered by your team, automatically routed to Voice AI, or handled by Voice AI when nobody picks up. Each WhatsApp number can have its own answering preferences, giving you greater flexibility over how incoming calls are managed.

---

## **What is Voice AI for WhatsApp Calls?**

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/LY7rM4v5WYWWdYTJvDV8)

Voice AI for WhatsApp Calls lets businesses route incoming WhatsApp calls to existing HighLevel Voice AI agents. With three answering modes - Team only, Team, then Voice AI, and Voice AI only - businesses can decide when their team or Voice AI handles incoming calls. 

For example, you can let your team answer first and have Voice AI automatically step in if nobody picks up within 20 seconds.

---

## **WhatsApp Call Answering Modes**

WhatsApp call answering modes determine whether incoming calls are handled by team members, Voice AI, or a combination of both. Choosing the appropriate mode helps businesses manage call volume while ensuring customers have an opportunity to connect with someone when they call.

### **Team only**

Team only allows incoming WhatsApp calls to ring your selected team members without involving Voice AI. This mode is ideal for businesses that prefer their staff to handle incoming calls directly.

- Incoming calls ring the selected team members.
- You can select up to six team members.
- Voice AI does not answer calls in this mode.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083891456/original/7raKoeDhx-WgtkynUgz4AxIcGT0AKe3esg.png?1792599031)

### **Team, then Voice AI**

Team, then Voice AI gives your team the first opportunity to answer incoming WhatsApp calls. If nobody picks up within the configured wait time, the selected Voice AI agent automatically answers the call.

This mode is useful for businesses that want to prioritize human interaction while ensuring unanswered calls are handled by Voice AI.

- Team members: Select up to six team members who should receive incoming calls.
- Voice AI agent: Choose an existing Voice AI agent to answer calls when your team is unavailable.
- Voice AI answers after: Set how long the call should ring your team before Voice AI takes over. Available options are 10, 15, 20, or 30 seconds, with 20 seconds as the default.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083891492/original/VE0qL6JAgN5Lhx_PPHS34HqVf8OrR5C5Uw.png?1792599054)

### **Voice AI only**

Voice AI only routes incoming WhatsApp calls directly to your selected Voice AI agent without ringing team members first. This mode is suitable for businesses that prefer automated call handling.

- Incoming calls are routed directly to Voice AI.
- Select an existing Voice AI agent to handle calls.
- Team-member selection and answer-delay settings are not required.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083891535/original/7py-GLKTApBhnxkNErzacQkyKVzZI9KoIg.png?1792599090)

---

## **How to Set Up Voice AI for WhatsApp Calls**

Configuring Voice AI for WhatsApp Calls allows you to control how incoming calls are answered for each connected WhatsApp number. Before starting, ensure WhatsApp Calling is available for your number and that you have an existing Voice AI agent ready to handle calls.

1. In your sub-account, go to **Settings > WhatsApp > Calling** and open the number you want to configure.
2. Make sure **Allow voice calls** is enabled.
3. Under **Who answers WhatsApp calls?**, select **Team, then Voice AI** or **Voice AI only**.
4. Select your **Voice AI agent** from the dropdown.
5. If you selected **Team, then Voice AI**, choose the team members to ring (up to six) and set **Voice AI answers after**.
6. Click **Save**.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I configure different answering modes for different WhatsApp numbers?**

Yes. Each WhatsApp number has its own calling preferences. You can configure one number to use Team, then Voice AI and another to use Voice AI only without affecting the other number's settings.

**Q: Do I need to create a separate Voice AI agent for WhatsApp calls?**

No. You can select an existing Voice AI agent from the Voice AI agent dropdown. Use Edit agent to access its configuration if changes are needed.

**Q: Can I switch between Team only, Team, then Voice AI, and Voice AI only after setup?**

Yes. You can change the answering mode at any time by returning to the WhatsApp number's calling settings and saving your updated preferences.

**Q: What happens if my team doesn't answer an incoming WhatsApp call?**

If you're using Team, then Voice AI, the selected Voice AI agent automatically answers after the configured wait time (10, 15, 20, or 30 seconds). If you're using Team only, Voice AI does not answer the call.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [WhatsApp Calling in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007253-whatsapp-calling)
- [WhatsApp Voice Calling in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007989-whatsapp-voice-calling-in-highlevel)
- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004107-how-to-create-voice-ai-agents)
- [Voice AI - How to Configure Inbound Call Flow](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003431)

title_en: Add Location Tagging to Social Post
source_md:
Add location tags to your Facebook and Instagram posts using HighLevel Social Planner. Location tagging lets you associate social media content with specific places, providing geographic context for your audience. This guide explains how to add location tags and manage the required permissions.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/mkWVBQ7r-Bs?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Location Tagging in Social Planner?](#What-is-Location-Tagging-in-Social-Planner?)
- [Key Benefits of Location Tagging](#Key-Benefits-of-Location-Tagging)
- [Supported Social Platforms](#Supported-Social-Platforms)
- [How to Add Location Tags to Social Posts](#How-to-Add-Location-Tags-to-Social-Posts)
- [Important Considerations](#Important-Considerations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is Location Tagging in Social Planner?**

Location Tagging allows you to attach a place or location to supported Facebook and Instagram posts created through HighLevel Social Planner. This helps viewers identify the location associated with your content.

**Why it Matters:**

- For social media engagement, location tagging helps to improve the visibility and chances of better insights like followers, likes and comments.

---

## **Key Benefits of Location Tagging**

Adding locations to social media posts helps provide geographic context and makes your content more relevant to location-specific audiences.

- **Location Context:** Show the place associated with your social media content.
- **Local Relevance:** Connect posts with relevant businesses, venues, or destinations.
- **Simplified Publishing:** Add location tags directly while creating posts in Social Planner.
- **Centralized Management:** Manage content and location settings from one platform.

---

## **Supported Social Platforms**

Location tagging is available for supported Facebook and Instagram posts. The available options depend on the connected account, publishing permissions, and post format.

- **Facebook:** Supports location tagging for eligible posts.
- **Instagram:** Supports location tagging for eligible posts published through connected Business or Creator accounts.

**Note:** Location tagging is not documented as available for every Social Planner platform or post format.

---

## **How to Add Location Tags to Social Posts**

Location tags can be added while creating a Facebook or Instagram post in Social Planner. Selecting the correct social account and location helps ensure that the tag is included when publishing.

1. Navigate to **Marketing → Social Planner**.
2. Click **+ New Post → Create New Post**.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084959264/original/Dj_Pu6ejieEC-ba7yhifTyLqMjvJ-etmCg.png?1793805091)
3. Select your connected **Facebook or Instagram account** under **Post to**.
4. Add your caption, media, and other post details.
5. Locate the **Location Tagging** option, search for the desired place, and select an available location.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084959660/original/yqKTfrddbOzzE1-GzX6HZqld7hqtFpS3Mw.png?1793805240)
6. Review the selected location and post details, then **Publish Now** or **Schedule** your post.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084959732/original/sLYS6g4Y0OTljRh-kGVzK26-OHD89wanQg.png?1793805272)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084959828/original/Y3PmeMoJ_pGnxap6hpSJhNPrVRAMz_N7iA.png?1793805339)

     
     
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084959804/original/AvfgqaxsOE5hIz87-5bGf8RLkyZf67AJxQ.png?1793805324)

**Important:** You may be prompted to reauthorize your Facebook or Instagram account to grant additional location-tagging permissions. Complete the authorization process before publishing.

---

## **Important Considerations**

Location tagging depends on platform permissions and the availability of locations through the connected social account.

- **Account Permissions:** Additional Facebook or Instagram authorization may be required.
- **Location Availability:** Only locations returned by the supported platform's location search can be selected.
- **Post Formats:** Location-tagging availability may vary depending on the platform and post type.
- **Account Connections:** If your social account becomes disconnected, reconnect it through Social Planner Settings.
- **Post Sync:** Location information may not appear on synchronized Instagram posts because of API limitations.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I add location tags to all social media platforms?**

No. HighLevel currently documents location tagging for supported Facebook and Instagram posts.

**Q: Why can't I find the location I want to tag?**

The location may not be available through the connected platform's location search. Try searching using the full business or place name.

**Q: Why am I being asked to reconnect my Facebook or Instagram account?**

Location tagging may require additional permissions. Reauthorizing the account allows HighLevel to request the necessary access.

**Q: Can I add location tags to Instagram Personal accounts?**

Social Planner publishing requires a supported Instagram Business or Creator account. Personal accounts are not supported through the documented Instagram publishing integrations.

title_en: Create a New Sub-Account Using Snapshot
source_md:
This article will show you how to quickly create a new sub-account in HighLevel using a snapshot. This process automatically loads assets like funnels, workflows, and settings into the new account, saving you setup time and ensuring consistency across sub-accounts.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview of Creating a Sub-Account Using a Snapshot](#Overview-of-Creating-a-Sub-Account-Using-a-Snapshot)
- [Key Benefits of Creating a Sub-Account Using a Snapshot](#Key-Benefits-of-Creating-a-Sub-Account-Using-a-Snapshot)
- [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
- [How To Create a New Sub-Account Using a Snapshot](#How-To-Create-a-New-Sub-Account-Using-a-Snapshot)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Overview of Creating a Sub-Account Using a Snapshot**

Creating a sub-account using a snapshot allows agencies to easily create a new account that includes all the tools, workflows, settings, and assets packaged in the selected snapshot. Once the sub-account is created, the snapshot is automatically loaded into it, eliminating the need for manual loading of a snap-shot after creation. This streamlines the onboarding process and ensures the new account starts with a consistent, prebuilt setup.

---

## **Key Benefits of Creating a Sub-Account Using a Snapshot**

Using snapshots to create sub-accounts helps agencies set up standardized sub-accounts faster.

- **Faster onboarding:** Pre-loads all essential assets and settings, reducing manual setup.
- **Consistency Across Accounts:** Ensures desired accounts include the same assets and settings.
- **Time savings:** Eliminates repetitive configuration for each new sub-account after creation.
- **Error reduction:** Reduces the risk of setup mistakes or missing assets.

---

## **Prerequisites**

Understanding the setup requirements helps ensure the process is successful the first time.

- Must have **Agency Admin** access
- Snapshot must already exist in your account
- Snapshot should include the key assets you want duplicated (funnels, triggers, calendars, etc.)
- Optionally, import or create the snapshot beforehand:

  - [How to Import Snapshots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982581)
  - [How to Create a Snapshot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982512)

---

## **How To Create a New Sub-Account Using a Snapshot**

These steps will walk you through creating a new sub-account based on the desired snapshot.

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Account Snapshots

- From your Agency Dashboard, click **Account Snapshots** on the left-hand menu

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049966392/original/uHmwc-IKJ0-JgoaXVruZL5RLaXtK_qnveA.png?1752695024)

#### **Step 2:** Select Snapshot

- Locate the snapshot you'd like to use as the base for the new sub-account
- Click the blue**Create New Account (+)**button beside the snapshot

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049966457/original/mHW513SBk2GVrKrvd5IshTz5MDVOXGyJnA.png?1752695169)

#### **Step 3:** Create Sub-Account

- A new window will open to fill out the new sub-account information
- Once all information has been entered, click **Add Sub-Account**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049966494/original/NI-WY8pXakXgcO7ipkMbHwE57UlMXkMgIg.png?1752695281)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I delete a snapshot from an account after it's created?**  
No, once applied, a snapshot cannot be “unloaded" or "deleted". You can delete or modify specific elements manually.

**Q: What access is needed to create sub-accounts using snapshots?**  
Only users with Agency Admin permissions can perform this action.

**Q: What assets are included in snapshots?**  
Funnels, forms, workflows, calendars, settings, and more depending on what was saved in the snapshot. For more information, read [Snapshot Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982511).

**Q: Will the snapshot overwrite anything in the new sub-account?**  
No. Since the sub-account is being created fresh, there is nothing to overwrite. The snapshot is applied during account creation, so its contents become the initial setup.

**Q: Can I apply more than one snapshot to a new sub-account?**  
Not during the creation process. Only one snapshot can be selected when creating a sub-account. However, you can manually apply additional snapshots after the sub-account has been created.

**Q: What happens to funnels and websites after loading from a snapshot?**

When you load a snapshot into a sub-account, all included funnels and websites are copied over as drafts. They won’t be live until you connect a**custom domain and publish them.**

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Load Snapshots into Existing Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982582)
- [Creating New Snapshots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982512)
- [How to Import Snapshots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982581)
- [Snapshot Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982511)
- [Snapshot Management – Selective Assets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005146)
- [Load Snapshots with Dashboards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002280)

title_en: Collaborator Posts support for Instagram
source_md:
This article will walk you through how to create Instagram Collaborator Posts directly from HighLevel’s Social Planner! Collaborator Posts are a powerful way to increase engagement, boost visibility, and team up with influencers or brand partners — all in one shared post that appears on both profiles.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is an Instagram Collaborator Post?](#What-is-an-Instagram-Collaborator-Post?)
- [Key Benefits of Instagram Collab Posts](#Key-Benefits-of-Instagram-Collab-Posts)
- [How To Use Instagram Collaborator Posts in Social Planner](#How-To-Use-Instagram-Collaborator-Posts-in-Social-Planner)
- [Instagram Collaborator Post Settings](#Instagram-Collaborator-Post-Settings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is an Instagram Collaborator Post?**

Instagram Collaborator Posts (Collab Posts) allow two accounts to share the same post in their feed or Reels. This joint-posting feature increases visibility and engagement by showing the content to both users’ audiences, making it perfect for partnerships, influencer campaigns, or brand collaborations.

---

## **Key Benefits of Instagram Collab Posts**

Collab posts boost your organic reach while streamlining brand partnerships.

    •    Post simultaneously to two Instagram accounts with one upload.

    •    Expand reach to both sets of followers.

    •    Drive higher engagement and community growth.

    •    Simplify influencer campaigns and co-marketing strategies.

    •    Collaborator approval is handled natively on Instagram, reducing friction.

    •    Available for both Feed and Reels post types.

---

## **How To Use Instagram Collaborator Posts in Social Planner**

Learn how to set up and schedule Instagram Collab posts using HighLevel’s Social Planner so they appear on both your account and your collaborator’s.

**Step-by-Step Instructions**

    1.    **Go to Marketing → Social Planner**

Navigate to the left-hand menu and click **Marketing**, then select **Social Planner**.

    2.    **Connect Your Instagram Account**

Click the **gear icon** next to “New Post” to open Social Planner Settings.

If your Instagram account isn’t connected yet, click **Add Account** and complete the connection process.

    3.    **Click “New Post” to Create Content**

    •    Select your Instagram profile from the list of connected accounts.

    •    Add your caption, hashtags, location, and any images or videos for the post.

    4.    **Choose Post Type: Feed or Reel**

For Collaborator posts to work, the content **must be posted as a Feed or Reel**.

Use the dropdown menu to select the correct post format.

    5.    **Add a Collaborator**

Scroll to the **Collaborator** section and enter the **exact Instagram handle** of the person or brand you wish to collaborate with (e.g., @partneraccount).

    6.    **Schedule or Publish Your Post**

    •    Choose a publish date and time, or click **Post Now**.

    •    The post will appear on both accounts’ feeds or Reels tabs.

---

## **Instagram Collaborator Post Settings**

To ensure your collaborator posts go live without issues, follow these requirements:

    •    **Post Type Requirement:** Only **Feed** and **Reels** support collaboration — Stories and Carousels are not supported.

    •    **Correct Instagram Handle:** Enter the handle exactly as it appears. Invalid handles will result in failure to invite.

    •    **No Pre-Approval in HighLevel:** Collaborator invites are managed entirely on Instagram, after the post is published.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I tag multiple collaborators in one post?**

A: No, Instagram currently allows only **one collaborator** per post using the Collab feature.

**Q: What happens if the collaborator doesn’t accept the invite?**

A: The post will still appear on your Instagram profile, but will not be visible on the collaborator’s profile unless they accept the collaboration request.

**Q: Can I schedule a Collaborator post in advance?**

A: Yes! Collaborator posts can be scheduled just like any other Instagram post in Social Planner. The collaborator will be notified when it goes live.

**Q: Does the collaborator need to be connected in Social Planner?**

A: No. The collaborator only needs to have a valid Instagram handle. The collaboration happens natively on Instagram after the post is published.

**Q: Can I edit the collaborator after posting?**

A: No. The collaborator must be set **before** publishing. You cannot modify collaborators after the post is live.

**Q: Does this work for Instagram Business and Creator accounts?**

A: Yes. Both account types support the Collaborator feature as long as they’re eligible for Collab posts on Instagram.

---

**Related Articles**

    •    [Connect Instagram Business or Creator to Facebook](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001213003-connect-instagram-business-or-creator-to-facebook-allows-posting-to-ig-)

    •    [How to Mention or Tag Profile in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002679--mention-or-tag-profile-in-social-planner)

---

**Next Steps**

    •    Connect your Instagram account in Social Planner if you haven’t already.

    •    Create a test post with your own alternate account or a teammate to test Collab functionality.

    •    Plan your next influencer or brand partnership campaign using Collaborator posts to boost shared engagement.

---

title_en: Guide to click tracking in email campaigns
source_md:
## [동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/zM6X3Ahpmig?&wmode=opaque)

## This guide would explain the basic of click tracking and how to use it.

### **What is Click Tracking?**

Click tracking is a feature that provides insights into how recipients interact with the links in your emails. By enabling click tracking, you can:

- See which specific links in your emails are being clicked.
- Identify which recipients are engaging with your content.
- Determine how many times each link is clicked.

### **Default Behaviour**

By default, click tracking is disabled in our system. If you wish to utilize click tracking for your email campaigns, you can enable it manually for each campaign.

### **Why Do We Need Click Tracking?**

1. **Understand Subscriber Engagement**: Click tracking helps you understand how your subscribers are engaging with your content. By knowing which links are being clicked, you can gauge interest levels and tailor your content accordingly.
2. **Analyse Link Performance**: Click tracking allows you to analyze which links are most popular among your subscribers. This can help you optimize your email layout and content strategy to focus on the most engaging elements.

**Where Click Tracking Does Not Work?**

Click tracking functionality may not operate under certain conditions. Here are scenarios where click tracking does not function as expected:

**1. Disabled Click Performance**: If click performance tracking is not enabled during the email send or scheduling process, click tracking data will not be collected.  
**2. Test Emails**: Click tracking does not apply to test emails. For accurate testing of click tracking functionality, it is recommended to send a dummy campaign to selected contacts.  
**3. Trigger Links**: Click tracking is not supported for trigger links in the current version. Trigger links already use redirection and tracking under a centralized system.  
**4. Non-HTTP/HTTPS URLs**: Click tracking only functions for URLs that begin with `http://` or `https://`. Links without these prefixes, such as direct links or those saved in custom values, cannot be tracked.  
**5. Unsupported Links**: Click tracking does not cover clicks on email addresses (`mailto:`) or anchor links. Ensure all links in your campaign use absolute paths to enable tracking.  
**6. System-Generated Links**: Links such as preview links, unsubscribe links, or affiliate links generated by the system will not be tracked.  
**7. Syntax Errors or Typos**: Links with syntax errors or typos may result in broken links, preventing accurate click tracking. It is advisable to verify all URLs for correctness to ensure effective tracking.  
**8. Magic Links:**For some use cases where the link has the custom values or fields, the link might not work. It is ideal to test it by sending some dummy email campaigns.  

### How to use it?

1. Navigate to the Email Marketing section.
2. Create a new campaign and click on send or schedule.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033861774/original/nJC2cWPFqwd2EB_5G1bc8QsZASbIApFxBA.png?1727776312)

3. Enable click tracking before sending.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155034300590/original/pOEkGaFZO4QcrMXVYpPmsbgEuy-ZRLRtsw.png?1728383549)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155034294790/original/ULjfL5Kw7Cyvzhx8vICcUGJs44ZgTlBeDg.png?1728380667)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155034294813/original/_nQXeqXRmvkyNPMHtpvatOxgidf8Vu8vgw.png?1728380681)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155034298568/original/fcl1NWGme_duzlj89CCf0tCv5jmh17TRcg.png?1728382625)

6. Click on individual links to view contact-specific click details.

## **FAQs**

### **Does it work for all campaigns?**

No, click tracking does not work for RSS and A/B testing campaigns as now, we are working on it.

### **Would custom value or trigger links work?**

Custom values are supported with click tracking. However, trigger links are not supported yet.

### **Would campaigns executed through workflows show these metrics?**

No, click tracking is not supporting automated campaigns executed through workflows. As of now, this feature is working for use with standard email marketing campaigns only.

### **Would it work for all campaigns?** No, the current implementation would not show any results in Click Performance tab for those emails sent before 13th June, 2024 or for those email campaigns where you have not enabled the option to track.

title_en: How do I find my Agency's Relationship Number?
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/j3ZZ1bS4Ef4?&wmode=opaque)

Your **Agency Relationship Number** is a unique 7-digit identifier assigned to your HighLevel agency account. It typically appears in this format:

`X-XXX-XXX`

HighLevel Support, Services, Customer Success, or Product teams may ask for your Relationship Number to identify the correct agency account.

```
Important: Every agency has a different Relationship Number. Only Agency Admins and Agency Owners have permission to view it.
```

---

## **Method 1: Find the Relationship Number in Company Settings**

You can find your agency's Relationship Number from your Company settings:

1. Click the **Sub-Account Switcher** in the upper-left corner of the navigation menu.
2. Select **Switch to Agency View**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078719175/original/YUYQqVy1PSQhByEMfced66vdvh3ZR7NDdw.png?1787066638)
3. Click **Settings** at the bottom-left of the navigation menu.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078719234/original/A4KQ13s7Of7FlXYPKj_lgRgYQ9Ox7BzFDw.png?1787066680)
4. Select **Company**.
5. Locate the **Relationship Number** under **Company Data**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078721062/original/jlxycwkf_S_ich1Z1ydVcfg3VTHTUJ2tCQ.png?1787067820)
6. Click the **copy icon** next to the Relationship Number to copy it.

```
Tip: If you have access to multiple agencies, confirm that you're in the correct Agency View before copying the Relationship Number.
```

---

## **Method 2: Find the Relationship Number From the Help Menu**

Agency Admins can also quickly access the Relationship Number from the Help menu:

1. Make sure you're logged in with the appropriate agency-level access.
2. Click the **blue question mark (?)** in the upper-right corner of HighLevel.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078721213/original/H-q-Ly6o3pX51B0SYAtAM_bPOcInxhaxqA.png?1787067882)
3. Locate your agency information and **Relationship Number**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078721638/original/Y8enY3m07tn8i3l4cHy6nDOEPMgYJdonSg.png?1787068105)
4. Copy the Relationship Number as needed.

---

## **Can't Find Your Relationship Number?**

If the Relationship Number isn't visible, check the following:

### 

### **Confirm Your User Permissions**

Only **Agency Admins and Agency Owners** can view the Relationship Number. If you don't have one of these roles, contact an Agency Admin or Agency Owner and ask them to retrieve the Relationship Number for you.

### 

### **Make Sure You're in Agency View**

The Relationship Number identifies the **agency**, not an individual sub-account. If you're currently inside a sub-account:

1. Open the **Sub-Account Switcher**.
2. Select **Switch to Agency View**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078721750/original/y-k6zBuIPf2QOgkKy6bsKbK5vrriWr5ecw.png?1787068174)
3. Go to **Settings → Company**.
4. Look for the Relationship Number under **Company Data**.

### 

### **Verify the Correct Agency**

If you have access to more than one agency, make sure you're viewing the correct agency before copying the Relationship Number. Because each agency has its own unique Relationship Number, copying the number from the wrong Agency View could identify a different agency account.

---

## **Relationship Number vs. Location ID**

A **Relationship Number** and a **Location ID** identify different levels of your HighLevel account.

| Identifier | What It Identifies | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Relationship Number** | Your HighLevel **agency account** | `X-XXX-XXX` |
| **Location ID** | A specific **sub-account/location** within an agency | Unique alphanumeric ID |

If HighLevel Support or another HighLevel workflow asks you for an identifier, make sure you provide the specific type requested.

```
Not sure which one you need? If you're being asked to identify your agency, use the Relationship Number. If you're being asked to identify a specific sub-account/location, use its Location ID.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### 

**Q. Who can view the Agency Relationship Number?**

A. Only **Agency Admins and Agency Owners** have permission to view the Relationship Number.

**Q. Does every sub-account have a different Relationship Number?**

A. No. The Relationship Number identifies the **agency account**. Individual sub-accounts are identified using their respective **Location IDs**.

**Q. I have access to multiple agencies. Which Relationship Number should I use?**

A. Switch to the Agency View for the agency you need to identify and retrieve its Relationship Number from **Settings → Company → Company Data**.

**Q. What should I do if I'm not an Agency Admin or Agency Owner?**

A. Contact an **Agency Admin or Agency Owner** for the appropriate agency and ask them to retrieve the Relationship Number for you.

**Q. Where is the most reliable place to find my Relationship Number?**

A. Go to **Agency View → Settings → Company** and locate the Relationship Number under **Company Data**.

title_en: Audit & Fix Consent Text Across All Your Assets
source_md:
This guide explains how to scan all your lead‑capture assets for compliant consent language, review issues at a glance, and bulk‑apply standardized consent text where needed. You’ll learn where to run the audit, how the results are categorized, and how to fix non‑compliant assets quickly. 

---

# **What is Audit & Fix Consent Text Across All Your Assets?**

Audit & Fix centralizes consent maintenance by scanning supported assets for compliant opt‑in language and helping you correct issues in bulk. This reduces risk and keeps your capture points consistent so downstream messaging and calling respect contact preferences.

---

## **Key Benefits of Audit & Fix Consent Text**

Understanding the advantages helps you decide when to run the audit and what outcomes to expect—especially if you manage many assets or multiple locations.

- **Complete Visibility**: See consent status across Forms, Surveys, Calendars, Facebook Lead Forms\* and Chat Widgets in one place.
- **Bulk Corrections**: Apply compliant consent text to supported assets with one click to standardize language fast.
- **Outbound Recognition**: Ensure contacts who opted in via surveys, appointment bookings, FB forms, or chat widgets are recognized for outbound calling/messaging.
- **Time Savings**: Replace manual, asset‑by‑asset checks with a single audit workflow.
- **Risk Reduction**: Reduce missed or inconsistent consent language that could impact deliverability or compliance.

---

## **Supported Assets**

Knowing what’s covered prevents surprises and helps you prioritize which assets to fix first.

- Forms
- Surveys
- Appointment Forms / Calendars
- Facebook Lead Forms
- Chat Widgets

---

## **How To Setup Audit & Fix Consent Text**

A structured setup ensures that the first audit yields accurate results and that bulk fixes apply exactly as intended.

1. **Open the Voice AI** — Locate the AI Agent option in the Left Pane of your sub account and choose Voice AI Page. If Outbound is enabled, you will see the same tooltip in the page.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066386700/original/snLRVGvxJBhLzdS7oa-s8sJwUSZob_EP_w.png?1772810710)
2. **Complete Verification:**If the Verification is not done before, Click on **"Update Disclosure"**to complete the verification process.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066387433/original/Oyb8LFVxKNl0goOuUIflHLDTgj0caODHPQ.png?1772810921)
3. **Run Audit** — Select location(s) and asset types to include. Start the scan and wait for the results to populate.
4. **Review** — Filter by Needs Attention. Click an asset to preview its current consent language.
5. **Select assets** — Check the boxes for the assets you want to update now.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066178254/original/sWjPywos0kUei8IBvhTRVuFne-8fTPOajg.png?1772625682)
6. **Preview fix** — Open the Bulk Fix modal to review the standardized consent text and placement.
7. **Apply** — Confirm to apply compliant text to the selected assets.
8. **Verify** — Spot‑check a few assets and, if needed, re‑run the audit to confirm status.
9. **Facebook Lead Forms** — Edit consent on Facebook; then return and re‑scan to refresh status.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does the audit change my existing custom legal language?**A: You can choose whether to replace or append when applying a bulk fix. Review the preview before confirming.

**Q: Can I undo a bulk fix?**A: If your account offers change history or versioning for the asset type, revert there. Otherwise, manually edit the asset to your preferred text and re‑run the audit.

**Q: Are Facebook Lead Forms auto‑fixed by the tool?**A: No. They appear in results for visibility, but you must update their consent language directly on Facebook.

**Q: How often should I run the audit?**A: Run after creating or importing new assets, after major policy updates, and periodically as part of compliance hygiene.

**Q: Does the audit evaluate language for every region’s law?**A: The tool checks for standard elements of compliant consent. Because laws vary, confirm final wording with legal counsel.

**Q: Will this update double opt‑in settings?**A: The audit focuses on consent language in assets. Manage double opt‑in and related messaging settings in your messaging/compliance configuration.

**Q: Where do I see a contact’s consent status once captured?**A: Check the contact record and any outbound messaging/calling eligibility indicators supported by your account.

**Q: Can I exclude certain assets from bulk updates?**A: Yes. Use selective apply—only the assets you select are updated.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Best Practices for SMS deliverability and Avoiding SMS Restrictions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000079)
- [Recommendations and Best Practices for Maintaining a Positive Caller Reputation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002944)
- [Gain Consent With Custom Checkboxes In Forms (GDPR Compliance)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001185523)
- [Adding Custom Forms to Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001076135)

title_en: Best Time to Post Feature in Social Planner
source_md:
The Best Time to Post feature in HighLevel's Social Planner is a smart tool that uses your audience’s engagement data to optimize your posting schedule. Now you can ensure your posts go live at the perfect time to maximize reach and engagement.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Best Time to Post Feature?](#What-is-Best-Time-to-Post-Feature?%C2%A0)
- [Key Benefits of the Best Time to Post Feature](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Best-Time-to-Post-Feature)
- [How To Use the Best Time to Post Feature](#How-To-Use-the-Best-Time-to-Post-Feature%C2%A0)
- [Feature Availability and Platform Support](#Feature-Availability-and-Platform-Support%C2%A0)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Best Time to Post Feature?**

The Best Time to Post feature in Social Planner is a data-driven tool designed to analyze your audience’s engagement patterns and suggest the optimal times for posting on social media. This feature enables you to plan your social content effectively, ensuring posts reach the largest possible audience when engagement is at its peak.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Best Time to Post Feature**

This section explains the advantages of using the Best Time to Post feature, emphasizing how it improves scheduling efficiency and increases reach on social media platforms.

- **Optimized Posting:** Recommendations based on audience engagement boost your content’s visibility.
- **User-Friendly Process:** Easily integrated into your existing post creation with simple “Schedule” options.
- **Multi-Platform Support:** Works seamlessly across all connected social accounts through Social Planner.
- **Enhanced Engagement:** Posting during peak engagement times increases the chances of reaching a larger audience.

---

## **How To Use the Best Time to Post Feature**

This guide breaks down the setup process into clear, sequential steps, ensuring you correctly enable and utilize the feature for optimal results in your social planning.

 

### **Step 1:** Create a New Post

1. Navigate to **Marketing from your sub-account.**
2. Click on the **Social Planner** tab.
3. Click on the **+ New Post** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/Vn3OO6VDp5h2JBo1VvWD+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-22+at+10.29.13+PM.png)
4. Select **+ Create New Post** or **Upload From CSV**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/NYAharnGzhlvmbsGWWgC+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-22+at+10.31.52+PM.png)
5. Choose the social platforms under the **Post to** section where you intend to post.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/k6JOOu2cvrT3UqRd3XAn+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-22+at+10.34.08+PM.png)

### **Step 2:**Add Your Post Content

1. Create your post by adding:  
     
   - Text
   - Image or media
   - Hashtags, mentions, etc.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/yaXnFXZ89cH3ZwiPtNwA+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-23+at+12.02.51+AM.png)

### **Step 3:**Use “Best Time to Post” Scheduling

1. Click on the **down arrow beside post button** and select **Schedule Post**option from the popup.
2. Review the **suggested Best Time to Post** options displayed based on your audience’s engagement trends.
3. Select a **recommended time frame**from the options.|
4. Click on the **Schedule Post** button.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/M5hFexFIqNcgAiZ6Iec3+/GIF+Recording+2025-07-23+at+12.05.52+AM.gif)

---

## **Feature Availability and Platform Support**

Understanding where and how you can use the Best Time to Post feature is crucial. This section highlights its availability across different interfaces in social planner.

- Available in Post Composer and CSV Bulk Action for both basic and advanced post scheduling.
- Not available in the mobile app, ensuring desktop-focused functionality for detailed planning.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

 

**Q: What exactly does the Best Time to Post feature do?**

It analyzes your audience’s engagement data to recommend the optimal posting times on your selected social platforms.

**Q: Is the Best Time to Post feature available in the mobile app?**

No, this feature is currently only available on the desktop version within the post composer and CSV bulk action interfaces.

**Q: Can I manually change the suggested posting time?**

Yes, after the recommendation is shown, you can adjust the time to better suit your posting strategy.

**Q: Which social platforms does this feature support?**

It is available for all social media accounts connected to Social Planner through HighLevel.

**Q: Will there be updates to include other formats?**

Yes, upcoming releases will expand support to include Recurring Posts, Review, RSS feeds, and Category Queue formats.

---

title_en: Tagging Courses in a Communities Post/Comment
source_md:
Make community conversations actionable by tagging your Courses directly inside posts and comments. Members can discover and jump to the right course with a quick “#” tag, keeping discussions focused and learning momentum high.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Tagging Courses?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Tagging-Courses?)
- [Key Benefits of Tagging Courses](#Key-Benefits-of-Tagging-Courses)
- [How to Tag Courses: Posts & Comments](#How-to-Tag-Courses%3A-Posts-&-Comments)
- [Navigating with Tagged Courses](#Navigating-with-Tagged-Courses)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Tagging Courses?**

Tagging Courses lets anyone composing a post or comment in Communities quickly reference an existing course by typing “#” and selecting it from a searchable picker. The tag renders as a clickable label with a course icon, allowing readers to navigate to the course for more details or enrollment, depending on the course’s configuration.

---

## **Key Benefits of Tagging Courses**

Understanding the practical advantages helps teams decide when to use course tags and how they improve discovery, navigation, and engagement inside discussions.

- **In‑context discovery:** Surface relevant courses at the exact point of conversation.
- **Faster navigation:** Clicking a course tag takes members straight to the course page.
- **Cleaner posts:** Replace long URLs with compact, readable course tags.
- **Guided next steps:** Recommend the right lesson or program without leaving the thread.
- **Consistent UX:** Use the same “#” pattern you already know for Channels and Events.

---

## **How to Tag Courses: Posts & Comments**

Course tags can be added in two places—the post editor or a reply—so you can guide learners at the exact moment questions arise or recommendations are made. Mastering both entry points keeps discovery consistent across new threads and ongoing conversations.

**Option A — While creating a post**

1. From your Sub-Account, Go to **Memberships >** **Communities** and Login to the desired **group**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056916805/original/A5Z6rNgUZOzAKDTjUy378l4cgXG1Yttk5w.png?1761573678)
2. Click **New Post**. In the editor, type **#** to open the object picker.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056917254/original/TWNb_G0_Fk-LVTXP1koBoBuvipGLjk2azQ.png?1761573949)
3. Search or scroll to find the **Course**, then click to insert the tag (a course icon appears next to the label).
4. Finish your post and click **Post**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056917300/original/Jqw0-UGf2hkhD9Tl0v_7e3MWTyH_NRSuXw.png?1761573982)

**Option B — While writing a comment**

1. Open the post you want to reply to and click **Reply**.
2. Type **#** to open the picker and select the **Course**.
3. Add your message and click **Post**.

---

## **Navigating with Tagged Courses**

Know what readers can expect after clicking a course tag so you can set the right expectations for access and next steps.

- Clicking a tagged course navigates the user to the corresponding **course page**.
- What a member sees after clicking depends on how the course is configured (e.g., free, paid, or restricted).
- Members with access can view the course details or curriculum; others may be prompted to obtain access per your course settings.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can tag a course?**  
Any member who can create a post or comment in the group can add course tags. Access to view the course after clicking depends on the course’s configuration.

**Q: Which courses appear in the “#” picker?**  
Courses available to the member based on visibility and access settings. Naming clarity and search terms affect what’s easy to find.

**Q: Can I tag more than one course in a single post/comment?**  
Yes. Insert as many course tags as needed to guide members through a learning path.

**Q: What happens if a member doesn’t have access to the tagged course?**  
They’ll be guided by your access model (e.g., purchase required or request access). The exact experience depends on your course setup.

**Q: Does this work on mobile?**  
Tagging is supported wherever the Communities post/comment editor supports the “#” picker.

---

## **Related Articles**

- ## [Communities – Tagging Channels and Events in Posts/Comments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006288-communities-tagging-channels-and-events-in-posts-comments)
- [Learning Tab (Courses)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001238-learning-tab-courses-)
